  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint) and planning tools (Outlook, Teams), with flexibility to learn new digital platforms

title: Junior Account Representative
description:
Kaplan International Languages is seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Junior
Account Representative to support student recruitment growth across the Americas.
Reporting to the Account Manager, this role will focus on strengthening agent partnerships,
identifying new business opportunities, driving student enrollments, and supporting
regional sales and marketing initiatives.
We also require you to have excellent organizational skills and be a self-starter. KLG is a
leading provider of English language courses. We take great pride in ensuring that our
students have the opportunities and tools to succeed, and our educators offer consistently
high standards of teaching.
We have language schools in the UK, Ireland, USA, Canada, Germany, France, and
Switzerland filled with students from all over the world.
As a Junior Account Representative, key job responsibilities include, but are not limited
to:
• Achieving individual targets, both market-based and for specific relationships, to
make a significant contribution towards the success of the region.
• Deliver agent training programs, webinars, and workshops to improve partner
product knowledge and conversion performance.
• Represent Kaplan International Languages at industry conferences, agent
workshops, recruitment fairs, and student-facing events.
• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify growth opportunities and
emerging trends.
• Identify, recruit, and onboard new recruitment partners, educational institutions,
and corporate clients.
• Organizing presentations for the new business prospects.
• Travelling to strategically important cities in the Americas with agents’ presence or
strong business potential.
• Assist with designing and implementing the strategy of offline marketing, such as
networking activities.
• Promoting KLG on an ongoing basis to generate new leads in the market by working
with established key stakeholders, as well as identifying and pursuing new business
opportunities.
• Liaising effectively with all Kaplan agents and the international KLG colleges to
ensure that the targets are met.
• Developing market-specific collateral to support sales and recruitment in the
Americas (liaising with the marketing department).
• Maintain accurate records of partner activity and sales opportunities within the
CRM system.
• Monitor conversion rates, enrollment performance, and partner KPIs.
• Provide regular sales forecasts and performance reports.
• Providing support on market-based projects and regional strategy as specified by
the Account Manager.
• Other related activities as required by the Account Manager.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, International Relations, Education, or
related field.
• Demonstrated experience managing external partners or client relationships.
• Fluent English and Spanish (written and verbal).

• Intrinsic motivation with a strong work ethic.
• Ability to work in a diverse environment.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Must be authorized to work in Colombia.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience within the international education or study abroad sector.
• Existing network of education agents in Latin America.
• Experience delivering virtual and in-person trainings.
• Portuguese language skills are a plus

description:

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Project Manager

Location: Bangalore (PAN India coverage)

Reports To: Account Director

Business Line: Real Estate & Workplace Services (REWS)

Employment Type: Full-Time


ROLE PURPOSE

The Project Manager will serve as the Single Point of Ownership (SPOC) for PAN India project coordination, governance, and execution tracking. The role requires end-to-end ownership of projects from planning through closure, with strong emphasis on stakeholder management, fiscal discipline, procurement integration, and compliance with JLL's governance standards. The incumbent will act as the primary liaison between JLL site teams, client stakeholders, procurement, finance, and vendors to ensure seamless project delivery across the account.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Project Ownership & Governance

  • Act as the Single Point of Ownership for PAN India project coordination, governance, and execution tracking.
  • Drive structured project reviews, ensuring timely FC (Forecast) and quarterly submissions.
  • Maintain robust risk management protocols and decision-tracking logs across all active projects.

2. End-to-End Project Management

  • Own the complete project lifecycle: planning, approvals, procurement, execution, invoicing, and closure.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with defined scope and quality standards.

3. Stakeholder Management

  • Build and sustain strong working relationships with JLL site leads, SAP client teams, Procurement, Finance, vendors, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for cross-functional coordination and alignment.

4. Fiscal Discipline & Cash Flow Management

  • Monitor and manage project budgets, financial commitments, utilization, and invoice approvals.
  • Ensure disciplined financial tracking to support accurate forecasting and cash flow visibility.

5. Procurement Integration

  • Align project planning and execution timelines with procurement activities, including vendor onboarding and sourcing schedules.
  • Coordinate closely with the Procurement/Sourcing function to avoid execution delays.

6. Documentation & Audit Readiness

  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, project records, and benchmarking data.
  • Ensure reporting accuracy and continuous audit readiness across all project files.

7. Issue & Escalation Management

  • Act as the gatekeeper for identifying, tracking, and resolving project risks and dependencies.
  • Escalate critical issues proactively to the Account Director with clear resolution pathways.

8. Resource & Schedule Coordination

  • Coordinate resources and schedules across multiple concurrent projects to ensure timely delivery.
  • Balance competing priorities across stakeholders without compromising project timelines.

9. Vendor Management

  • Support vendor pool development, capability assessments, onboarding, and ongoing performance tracking.
  • Ensure vendor engagement aligns with JLL SCMP guidelines and quality benchmarks.

10. Data & Reporting Management

  • Maintain project dashboards and support PPM (Project Portfolio Management) reporting requirements.
  • Provide regular status reports and support management reviews with accurate, timely data.

11. Communication & Executive Reporting

  • Lead project review meetings with clarity and structure.
  • Maintain transparency across stakeholders and provide concise, executive-level updates to senior leadership.

12. Operational Rigor & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive governance, process adherence, and accountability across all project activities.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in project execution and reporting processes.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business
  • Minimum 8–12 years of experience in project management, preferably within Corporate Real Estate, Facilities Management, or Workplace Services.
  • Demonstrated experience managing PAN India multi-location projects with cross-functional stakeholder involvement.
  • Prior experience working within a corporate client account environment (IFM/REWS) is highly desirable.

KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with proficiency in PPM tools and dashboard reporting.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities across internal and client teams.
  • Sound financial acumen with experience in budget tracking, invoicing, and cash flow management.
  • Working knowledge of procurement processes, vendor onboarding, and sourcing cycles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present confidently to senior leadership.
  • High attention to detail with strong documentation and audit-readiness discipline.
  • Proactive problem-solver with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Project, and relevant PPM/reporting platforms.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • On-time, on-budget project delivery across PAN India locations.
  • Accuracy and timeliness of FC/quarterly financial submissions.
  • Vendor onboarding and performance tracking compliance.
  • Audit readiness score and documentation completeness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and escalation resolution turnaround time.

title: Technical Product Manager - Payments
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
﻿
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission, serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
We are seeking a highly hands-on and Technical Product Manager to lead the building and scaling of our next-generation payments platform, the infrastructure that moves money from the moment a customer funds a payment to the moment it settles with our banking partners. This role requires a unique blend of deep technical depth, platform-level strategic thinking, and a resourceful, bias-for-action mindset to build the payments platform that powers multiple Félix products requiring money movement, while improving conversion, authorization rates, and unit economics.
You will own our payment orchestration layer and the ecosystem around it: multiple payment processors, banking and settlement partners, tokenization, and reconciliation. You will be a doer, not just a delegator, working closely with engineering to build sophisticated real-time systems while owning critical business metrics like authorization rate, processing cost, and GMV. This is a role for a builder who thrives on extreme ownership in a high-growth, ambiguous environment.

What you'll focus on
  • Define & Execute Payments Product Strategy – Work with Product and Engineering leadership to develop and own the payments roadmap, focused on unifying our processors, banking partners, and payment methods into a single, scalable orchestration platform for pay-ins, routing, and settlement. This requires a platform-first, reusable-component mindset.
  • Own the Payment Orchestrator – Drive the evolution of our in-house orchestrator and its rules engine: intelligent routing across processors, and fallback and resilience logic. Balance authorization rates, cost per transaction, and reliability. Own reconciliation and settlement health across processors and banking partners, driving toward automation.
  • Hands-On Data Analysis & Experimentation – Own payment metrics and have a hands-on relationship with the data. You must be able to navigate complex dashboards, run simple to medium-complexity SQL queries to validate hypotheses, and partner with Data Analysts and Engineers to drive improvements in conversion, acceptance, and authorization.
  • Expand Payment Methods & Rails – Partner directly with engineering to design, build, and launch payment methods and integrations across cards, wallets, ACH, cash, and additional processors and settlement banks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with Engineering, Finance (reconciliation, treasury, revenue recognition), and Operations (payment ops, disputes) to develop scalable solutions.
  • Fraud Coordination – Partner with Fraud to monitor fraud performance by payment method and supply the data needed for fraud checkpoints.
  • Partner & BD Coordination – Partner with Business Development on processor and banking partner negotiations.
  • Stakeholder & Partner Management – Communicate payments strategy and impact to executive leadership, and manage relationships with payment processors, acquiring and banking partners, and card networks.

What you'll bring
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on payments, ideally in a fast-paced growth environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Proven technical fluency & resourcefulness. Ability to work with engineering teams on API-based payments solutions, demonstrated ability to run simple SQL queries, and a clear understanding of data pipelines and system resilience (e.g. timeouts, fallbacks, service dependencies).
  • Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem (payment orchestration, processors/PSPs, acquiring and banking partners, card networks, authorization and settlement flows, tokenization, and reconciliation), or a track record of rapidly acquiring deep domain knowledge in a new technical area.
  • Experience owning payment performance metrics (authorization rate, conversion, processing cost, GMV) and using them to drive product improvements.
  • Experience working with payment processors and orchestration, and familiarity with alternative rails (ACH, BNPL, wallets, stablecoins) is a strong plus.
  • Strong ownership and a bias towards action; comfortable working hands-on rather than delegating.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, especially with fraud, finance, compliance, and exec teams, as well as external partners.
  • Passion for fintech and digital finance innovation.
  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $170,000 and $220,000 USD in San Francisco, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

Equal Opportunity Employer

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

title: Senior Pricing Administrator
description:
Who We Are


At Firestorm, we are building the future of expeditionary defense manufacturing and autonomous systems. Modern conflict has exposed a fundamental problem: the systems needed most by operators are often too expensive, too slow to produce, and too difficult to sustain at scale. Firestorm exists to change that.

We develop mission-adaptable aerial systems and deployable manufacturing infrastructure designed to put capability directly into the hands of the warfighter. From modular unmanned aircraft to xCell — our deployable microfactory — our goal is to make defense systems rapidly deployable, adaptable, and producible at the point of need.


About the Role


Firestorm is seeking a Pricing Specialist to join our organization. This person will own the development and execution of competitive, compliant, and data-driven pricing for proposals across a dynamic portfolio of programs. You will work closely with Business Development, Finance, Contracts, Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain to analyze cost and market data, build and refine pricing models, and produce accurate, compelling cost volumes that meet government contracting requirements.

This role goes beyond transactional pricing support. You will align pricing with technical solutions, delivery approaches, and customer requirements, including U.S. military acquisition and sustainment frameworks, and translate complex financial, technical, and market data into clear insights that strengthen proposal quality, enable price-to-win strategies, and protect long-term program viability.

The ideal candidate combines a strong government contracting knowledge base with an accountant's or finance analyst's rigor and exceptional attention to detail. You will understand how indirect rates, cost accounting, and audit expectations shape a price, and you will be able to explain those tradeoffs to BD leaders in plain language. As a fast-growing company, Firestorm offers a chance to build processes and tools from the ground up, with a path toward senior pricing, capture and BD finance, program finance, or FP&A roles.

What You'll Do


Pricing strategy and analysis
  • Partner with Business Group Leadership, the broader BD team, and cross-functional stakeholders to develop cost and price-to-win strategies aligned to program objectives
  • Analyze DRFP/RFP requirements to determine appropriate pricing strategies, contract structures, and execution approaches
  • Perform financial analysis to assess pricing impacts on revenue, margin, and profitability, including scenario and what-if modeling
  • Conduct compliance, strategic, and risk-based reviews of pricing submissions to identify gaps and improve proposal quality

Pricing models and cost inputs
  • Build, refine, and own pricing models, including labor and material cost estimates, that support competitive and compliant proposals
  • Apply and explain indirect rate structures (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, IRAD), including provisional billing and forward pricing rates, in proposal pricing, and analyze variances between proposed and actual rates
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance to develop accurate bases of estimate and integrated pricing solutions, and translate technical requirements into a compliant cost proposal
Proposal development and execution
  • Develop cost volumes, pricing narratives, and supporting documentation for a variety of contract types
  • Organize cost proposals into the required format, ensuring all cost elements are accounted for, assumptions are documented, and cross-references are complete
  • Support multiple concurrent proposals, often under tight deadlines, while ensuring accuracy and compliance
  • Coordinate with leadership to prioritize proposal efforts and manage competing deadlines
  • Coordinate with Contracts and Program Management on proposal documents and responses to government requests, adhering to submission requirements
  • Ensure consistent and accurate pricing information across cost proposals
Compliance, audit, and records
  • Ensure pricing adheres to FAR, DFARS, and CAS requirements and supports compliance with U.S. government acquisition rules
  • Support Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA) and Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) audits and reviews, including preparing audit-ready pricing support
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of pricing templates, proposal files, supporting documentation, and historical pricing data
Continuous improvement
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of pricing models, tools, processes, and best practices
  • Document and standardize pricing processes to support scalability as Firestorm grows
  • Support pricing and finance system upgrades or ERP integrations (such as Deltek/Costpoint) to streamline reporting and data flow

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Mathematics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of progressive, relevant pricing experience in government and commercial contracting
  • U.S. citizenship required due to ITAR regulations, with the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD security clearance
  • Strong understanding of government contracting regulations (FAR, DFARS, CAS, etc.) and proposal financials
  • Working knowledge of indirect rate structures and project-based cost allocation
  • Knowledge of and experience working with DCAA and DCMA
  • Experience supporting a wide range of contract types (FFP, CPFF, T&M, IDIQ, CPAF, etc.)
  • Advanced proficiency with Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and advanced functions, and with pricing tools such as ProPricer or similar systems
  • Demonstrated expertise in international pricing and contracting
  • Exposure to project planning or program controls
  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong organization, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in a related field
  • CPA or other relevant certification
  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems (e.g., Deltek/Costpoint, Unanet, NetSuite)
  • Experience preparing incurred cost submissions, forward pricing rate proposals, or supporting DCAA audits
  • Direct experience in national security, defense tech, aerospace, or adjacent dual-use technology sectors
  • Familiarity with timekeeping, labor distribution, and cost pool allocation methodologies
  • Experience scaling processes in high-growth or startup environments
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective communicator who collaborates well across technical, operational, and financial teams
Work Environment
  • Based at our HQ in San Diego, CA; this role requires an on-site presence
  • Willingness and ability to travel 10%
Who We Are
Firestorm is a defense technology company building the future of contested logistics and small unmanned aerial systems (sUAS). We design, build, and field affordable, attritable, mission-configurable platforms that give U.S. and allied warfighters an asymmetric edge in environments where traditional logistics break down and air superiority can no longer be assumed.
Our customers are operators. We move at their tempo — from concept to flight test to forward employment — and we measure ourselves on whether we put capability in their hands when it matters.
Why Firestorm
  • Mission that matters. We build for operators, and they use what we build.
  • Real ownership. You will shape the SOCOM/CENTCOM portfolio and drive product market fit and procurement of Firestorm technologies across these commands.
  • Fast tempo, short cycles. Engineering, product, and BD sit at the same table — decisions happen in days, not quarters.
  • Equity in a growth-stage company building category-defining capability.
  • A team of operators, builders, and serious professionals who care about the warfighter.

Export Control Compliance
To conform to U.S. government export control regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and Export Administration Regulations (EAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or otherwise eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State or U.S. Department of Commerce.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Firestorm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, and upholding equitable hiring practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic under federal, state, or local law, including those with a criminal history, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the CA Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance. We actively encourage members of recognized minorities, women, Veterans, and those with disabilities to apply, and we work to create a welcoming and supportive environment for all applicants throughout the interview process.
Firestorm is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require accommodations or assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at careers@launchfirestorm.com so we can provide the support you need.

The Building Operating Engineer (1st Shift) is responsible for maintaining the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of all base building systems throughout One Main Place while delivering exceptional customer service to tenants. This position serves as one of the primary engineering contacts for tenant service requests, performing preventative maintenance, troubleshooting building systems, and responding to operational issues that affect occupant comfort and building performance. Essential Duties and Responsibilities


  • Respond promptly and professionally to tenant service requests, ensuring timely resolution and a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Troubleshoot HVAC, plumbing, electrical, lighting, and other building-related issues affecting tenant spaces.
  • Perform preventative maintenance and corrective repairs on base building mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and life safety systems.

  • Perform routine inspections of tenant floors, common areas, mechanical rooms, rooftops, and equipment spaces to identify deficiencies.

    • Air handling units (AHUs)

    • Domestic water systems
    • Electrical distribution equipment

  • Work closely with vendors and contractors performing maintenance, repairs, and tenant improvement projects.
  • Complete assigned work orders while maintaining accurate documentation of labor, materials, and completed work.
  • Assist with after-hours emergency response for mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and life safety issues as required.
  • Support seasonal equipment changeovers and scheduled shutdowns.
  • Maintain clean, organized mechanical rooms, shops, and equipment spaces.
  • Follow all company safety policies and OSHA requirements.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience as a Building Engineer, Operating Engineer, or Maintenance Engineer in a commercial office environment.
  • Experience responding to tenant service requests.
  • Strong working knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, and building automation systems.
  • Ability to diagnose and repair building equipment with minimal supervision.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple service requests in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to read mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and architectural drawings.

Licenses & Certifications (Preferred)

  • EPA Universal CFC Certification
  • HVAC, electrical, or mechanical certifications
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30
  • Stationary Engineer License (if applicable)

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during shift hours.
  • Ability to climb stairs and ladders and access mechanical rooms and rooftops.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to work in varying environmental conditions typical of a central plant and high-rise facility.

Work Environment

  • Frequent interaction with tenants, property management, contractors, and vendors.
  • Daily travel throughout the building, including occupied office spaces, mechanical rooms, rooftops, and loading dock areas.
  • Fast-paced environment requiring excellent customer service, sound technical judgment, and the ability to respond effectively to changing priorities.

title: QA & Support Specialist
description:
Gillar du att upptäcka fel som är lätta att missa och prata med kunder för att förstå vad som har hänt? Hos Defentry får du testa en ny molnplattform, påverka vilka tester teamet automatiserar och hjälpa företagskunder när något krånglar.

Edge of Talent söker en QA & Support Specialist till Defentry. Internt kan rollen beskrivas som en internhacker. Du provar hur produkten fungerar när användaren tar en annan väg än den teamet tänkt sig. Fokus ligger på funktionell testning, produktkvalitet och teknisk kundsupport.

Om Defentry

Defentry är ett svenskt SaaS-bolag som hjälper människor att skydda sin identitet och sina personuppgifter på nätet. Plattformen bevakar dark web efter läckta uppgifter och hjälper användare att få personuppgifter borttagna från upplysningssajter och sökresultat. Tjänsterna når användare runt om i Europa via banker, försäkringsbolag och telekombolag som erbjuder skyddet under eget varumärke.

Defentry bygger en ny plattform i Google Cloud där säkerhet och automatiserade tester ingår från början. Samtidigt utvecklar bolaget nya tjänster för företagskunder, bland annat domänbevakning och sårbarhetsskanning av webbplatser.

Om rollen

Ungefär halva tiden arbetar du med testning och kvalitetssäkring och halva med tekniska ärenden från Defentrys företagskunder. Du ingår i utvecklingsteamet och arbetar nära produktteamet och de kollegor som ansvarar för kundrelationerna.

Teamet använder redan AI-verktyg för att skriva kod och ta fram tester. Din uppgift blir att bedöma om testerna täcker det som är viktigt för användaren och själv undersöka de situationer som är svåra att förutse. I kunddialogen hjälper du företagens kontaktpersoner att förstå vad som hänt, vad de kan göra och vad teamet behöver undersöka vidare.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Testa nya och befintliga funktioner på webben och i mobilappen, både med planerade testfall och genom att utforska hur produkten beter sig i oväntade situationer.

  • Tillsammans med utvecklarna avgöra vad som ska testas, vilka kontroller som kan automatiseras och när de ska köras.

  • Hitta säkra sätt att upprepa tester, även när en funktion är beroende av externa tjänster som Google eller Bing.

  • Utreda tekniska kundärenden, skilja produktfel från användarfrågor och hålla kunden uppdaterad. När ett fel har rättats testar du att flödet fungerar igen.

  • Föra återkommande frågor och förbättringsförslag vidare till produktteamet.

Vi söker dig som

  • Trivs i kontakten med kunder. Du lyssnar, ställer frågor för att förstå vad kunden behöver och följer upp så att kunden vet vad som händer.

  • Kommunicerar väl på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift och kan förklara tekniska frågor på ett sätt som är lätt att förstå för både kunder och kollegor.

  • Har praktisk erfarenhet av att testa mjukvara, undersöka vad som har gått fel och dokumentera vad du kommit fram till.

  • Har använt AI-verktyg i arbetet och vill bidra till testautomation genom att bedöma om testfallen täcker det som behöver kontrolleras.

Du kan ha arbetat med QA eller mjukvarutestning i en roll med kundkontakt. Du kan också komma från teknisk produktsupport eller en roll som applikationsspecialist där du har testat funktioner och utrett produktfel. Vi är öppna för olika erfarenhetsnivåer och tittar på hur du arbetar med testning och kundärenden i praktiken.

Det är meriterande om du har

  • Skrivit eller underhållit automatiserade tester.

  • Arbetat i en molnmiljö, gärna med Google Cloud eller serverless-tjänster.

  • Erfarenhet från SaaS, digitalt identitetsskydd, cybersäkerhet eller fintech.

Vem är du?

Du blir nyfiken när något fungerar ena gången men krånglar nästa. Du tar initiativ till att undersöka vad som skiljer fallen åt och delar det du kommer fram till så att kollegorna kan arbeta vidare. Du tycker också om att prata med kunder och vill förstå hur de använder produkten. När samma fråga dyker upp flera gånger funderar du på vad teamet kan förbättra.

Det här får du möjlighet till

  • Påverka hur Defentry testar sin nya plattform medan den byggs.

  • Utveckla testarbetet tillsammans med utvecklarna och påverka hur teamet använder AI och automation.

  • Följa ett kundärende från första samtalet till en lösning och använda det du lär dig för att göra produkten bättre.

Om anställningen

Placeringsort Stockholm, med kontor i centrala Stockholm
Arbetsupplägg Hybrid. Teamet ses på kontoret två dagar i veckan.
Önskad start Januari–mars 2027, enligt överenskommelse

Ansökan

Känner du igen dig i kombinationen av testning, problemlösning och kundkontakt? Då vill vi gärna höra mer om dig. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande. Har du frågor om rollen eller rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta Elnaz på Edge of Talent via email: elnaz.tajahmadi@edgeoftalent.com

Rekrytering via Edge of Talent

Edge of Talent ansvarar för rekryteringen på uppdrag av Defentry. Vi håller dig uppdaterad under processen och svarar gärna på frågor om rollen och nästa steg.



Transparens och ansvarsfull AI-användning
På Edge of Talent strävar vi efter att arbeta effektivt och professionellt. Vi använder därför ibland AI-baserade verktyg som stöd i vår administration, exempelvis för att strukturera och sammanfatta information.

Vi vill dock vara tydliga med att AI aldrig fattar beslut åt oss. Alla beslut om vilka kandidater som går vidare i våra processer fattas av en människa som noggrant utvärderar varje kandidat utifrån kompetenskriterier och hur dessa matchar kundens kravspecifikation för rollen.

Vår ambition är att säkerställa en rättvis och transparent rekryteringsprocess där alla kandidater bedöms utifrån sina faktiska meriter och erfarenheter.

title: Exempt to Permanent – Manager IV (0932) – Citywide (E10197)
description:
Under general administrative direction, incumbents in this class function as senior managers operating within a broad policy framework and typically manage a division of a medium/large department. Incumbents assume sole responsibility for a functional area(s) of service; coordinate and implement program planning; and define organizational structure, staffing requirements, resource allocation and identification of future resource needs. Incumbents also interface with all managerial levels of city/county government and outside agencies, and serve as representatives of the division or department in meetings involving administrative systems, policies or procedures; and perform related duties as required.

Supervision Exercised: These Managers typically manage mid-level staff or line managers.

Essential Functions: Essential functions of the 0932 Manager IV class include but are limited to the following:

1. Plans, monitors, evaluates, and supervises the operation of a division of a city department; coordinates the work of the various subdivisions; advises and consults with section managers; meets with appropriate staff to identify and resolve problems or conflicts; makes or recommends final decisions regarding policy, operations, and administrative procedures.

2. Develops, implements and maintains procedures, administrative monitoring practices and controls in order to obtain smooth and effective operation of a division; coordinates work activities of one division with other divisions within the department to prevent delays in required actions or to improve programs or services; assists in the identification, development and implementation of departmental goals, objectives, policies, and priorities; assists in the determination of resource allocation and levels of service according to established policies.

3. Receives and analyzes division and departmental reports; directs the preparation of monthly and annual reports; directs the gathering and analysis of information and reports necessary to document and evaluate processes.

4. Monitors the work of and coaches subordinates to improve performance.

5. Directs the allocation of resources to achieve timely outcomes and measurable goals within budget; adjusts plans and programs to meet emerging or new programs, while continuing to address major departmental priorities.

6. Monitors and evaluates the effectiveness and efficiency of the division's service delivery system, organizational structure, staffing levels, financial systems, and other internal operations; identifies and recommends alternative approaches or improvements; implements revisions, adjustments and changes.

7. May serve as liaison for the Department with a variety of other City/County staff, policy-making officials, and officials of outside agencies; explains and justifies Departmental or administrative procedures, policies, or programs; negotiates and resolves difficult and complex issues and problems.

8. May plan, develop, implement or direct major or complex projects or programs which span a number of the department's established sections or divisions; directs the research of complex, highly technical issues; analyzes alternative solutions or approaches; recommends most effective course of action.

9. Participates in budget development by providing detailed justification and persuasive arguments for proposals or initiatives. Oversees and administers division budget; directs and monitors expenditures in accordance with the approved budget; directs the preparation and maintenance of a wide variety of statistical, fiscal, and operational reports and studies; and provides executive management with an early warning and practical options to potential cost overruns.

Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications requirement by the final filing date unless otherwise noted.

  1. Current Category 16, 17, or 18 Exempt Employee in Class 0932 who has worked at least 2,080 hours in class 0932; AND
  2. Education: Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university; AND
  3. Experience: At least five (5) years of professional experience, of which three (3) years must include experience supervising professionals (except for public safety and trades).

Education Substitution: Additional experience may be substituted for the required degree on a year-for-year basis (up to a maximum of two (2) years). One (1) year is equivalent to thirty (30) semester units/forty-five (45) quarter units.

Experience Substitution: Possession of a Juris Doctorate (J.D.) or Master’s degree may substitute for one (1) year of the required professional experience.

Verification: Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process.

Preliminary Questionnaire – Training and Experience Assessment (100% weight)- During the application process, candidates will be prompted to complete a Preliminary Questionnaire as part of the online employment process. Please answer the Preliminary Questionnaire carefully and thoroughly. It will serve as the Training and Experience Assessment for this recruitment and will be used to determine your eligibility for this recruitment as well as your score and rank on the eligible list. Qualified applicants will be ranked on the eligible list based on the length of their exempt City service (in Category 16, 17, and/or 18) in the 0932 Manager IV class, along with any additional qualifying points (e.g., promotive status), as outlined in Civil Service Commission (CSC) rules. title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer / IT (PTX11926)
description:
Company Overview:

RealManage is a prominent national firm recognized on the Inc. 5000 list, operating across 16 states + Washington DC and serving a diverse array of clients including homeowners’ associations (HOAs), condominium associations, cooperatives, luxury high-rises, municipal utility districts, and master-planned communities. Our client base also includes nationally renowned developer and builder clients.

Ranked among the top firms in the community management industry (#3 out of 5,000+), RealManage distinguishes itself by delivering exceptional solutions at competitive prices. We leverage cutting-edge cloud-based technologies and mobile apps, supported by industry-leading practices and a highly skilled workforce.

Our mission at RealManage is to offer comprehensive and innovative solutions that consistently surpass customer expectations. We prioritize transparency and visibility in all client interactions, continuously measuring our performance to achieve rapid improvement. We foster a workplace culture that promotes professionalism, encourages growth, and embraces diversity. By maintaining financial strength and focusing on continual innovation, we aim to lead the industry with pioneering advancements.

Role Overview

Role Overview

The Principal Infrastructure Engineer is a senior technical leader who combines architectural vision with hands-on engineering execution. This role is responsible for defining the infrastructure strategy and technology standards that support RealManage’s operations across 24 states—then rolling up their sleeves to implement those designs using Infrastructure as Code and modern cloud practices.

You will take a holistic view of RealManage’s technology landscape, evaluating how systems, platforms, and services interconnect across the organization. You’ll establish reference architectures, design patterns, and governance frameworks that bring consistency and scalability to our infrastructure—while remaining close enough to the work to write the Terraform, build the pipelines, and ship the changes yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams and recommendations; you will own the full lifecycle from strategic vision through production implementation.

We are looking for someone who thinks in cloud concepts rather than being tied to any single provider. The ideal candidate understands foundational principles—IAM, virtual networking, DNS, load balancing, compute, and storage—and can translate those concepts fluidly across AWS, Azure, or any platform our growing portfolio demands. You approach technology decisions with a methodology-first mindset: evaluating trade-offs, aligning infrastructure choices with business objectives, and building frameworks that scale across a multi-entity, acquisition-driven organization.

This is an individual contributor role with a strong mentoring component. You will guide and elevate systems administrators and engineers across the team, helping them grow into more strategic thinkers themselves. For those who desire it, there is a clear path into people management.

Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain the organization’s infrastructure strategy, establishing reference architectures, design patterns, and technology standards that ensure consistency, security, and scalability across all environments.
  • Evaluate the broader technology landscape across the enterprise, identifying interdependencies between systems and platforms and developing integration strategies that reduce complexity and technical debt.
  • Develop technology roadmaps for infrastructure services, aligning technical direction with business objectives, growth plans, and M&A activity.
  • Create and maintain governance frameworks for infrastructure decisions, including guidelines for platform selection, service adoption, and architectural review processes.
  • Conduct technology evaluations and make recommendations grounded in methodology—assessing trade-offs around cost, performance, security, and operational complexity rather than defaulting to any single vendor or toolset.
  • Lead technical due diligence efforts for M&A integrations, assessing acquired infrastructure environments and developing migration and consolidation strategies that align with enterprise standards.
  • Architect, design, and implement cloud infrastructure solutions across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure), with an emphasis on reliability, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Champion and advance Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep, ensuring repeatable, version-controlled, and auditable infrastructure deployments.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD (or equivalent platforms) to enable automated testing, deployment, and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Define and enforce best practices for cloud networking, identity and access management (IAM), security groups, and virtual network architecture.
  • Develop and maintain containerization strategies using Docker, supporting development and production workloads.
  • Establish and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability standards to ensure proactive identification and resolution of infrastructure issues.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with DevOps, security, application, and business teams to ensure infrastructure capabilities are aligned with organizational needs.
  • Author and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including architecture decision records, reference designs, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Mentor and coach systems administrators and engineers, providing technical guidance, architectural thinking, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing to elevate the team’s capabilities and develop more strategic contributors.
  • Participate in incident response and root cause analysis, driving continuous improvement in infrastructure resilience and feeding lessons learned back into architectural standards.

Disclaimer

This description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. The employee may perform other duties as assigned to meet the ongoing needs of the organization. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of this position.

title: General Manager
description:

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

title: Technical Product Manager - Platform
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.
Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission, serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
We are seeking a highly hands-on and Technical Product Manager to build and scale the core platform services that power Félix. These are the APIs, integrations, and real-time systems that every Félix product depends on to move money and data reliably between our users, our partners, and our internal teams. This role is for someone who thinks in systems, reusable components, and service contracts, not individual features.
You will own a set of platform capabilities end to end: partner and provider integrations, routing and orchestration logic, service reliability, and the data that tells us how the platform is performing. You will be a doer, not just a delegator, working side by side with engineering on architecture and tradeoffs while owning the metrics that matter.

What you’ll focus on
  • Define & Execute Platform Strategy – Work with Product and Engineering leadership to own the roadmap for core platform services, unifying external providers and internal systems into scalable, reusable building blocks that multiple product teams consume.
  • Own Core APIs & Integrations – Drive the design and evolution of the APIs and partner integrations at the heart of our infrastructure, including service contracts, versioning, error handling, and developer experience for internal consumers.
  • Build for Resilience – Partner with engineering on routing, fallback, and retry logic across multiple providers. Balance success rates, cost, latency, and reliability, and drive monitoring and automation that catch issues before users feel them.
  • Hands-On Data Analysis – Own platform health metrics and have a hands-on relationship with the data.
  • Scale New Capabilities – Launch new integrations, providers, and services as Félix expands into new products and markets, including real-time disbursement and money movement across borders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud, and Compliance to turn complex requirements into clean platform solutions.
  • Partner Management – Evaluate, integrate, and manage relationships with external technology and financial partners, and communicate platform strategy and impact to executive leadership.

What you’ll bring
  • 5+ years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Deep technical fluency. You are comfortable discussing system design, API architecture, and service dependencies with engineers,
  • Experience owning platform-level metrics (reliability, latency, success rate, cost) and using them to drive improvements.
  • Experience integrating and managing third-party providers or partners via API.
  • Strong ownership and a bias toward action; comfortable working hands-on rather than delegating.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences, including executives and external partners.

These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $170,000 and $220,000 USD in San Francisco tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

Equal Opportunity Employer
At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

title: Medior Frontend Developer (React/Typescript)
description:
The WES UI Team, part of the R&D department, is responsible for delivering and maintaining software tools used across all company departments and by customers.
The team focuses primarily on developing and maintaining frontend applications using React and TypeScript, ensuring high-quality, user-friendly, and scalable solutions.

While the main expertise lies in frontend development, some applications also include backend components built with C# and .NET. Two applications involve backend development, while others are primarily frontend-focused and used both internally and by customers.

Advantages of working in the WES UI Team:

  • Frontend Focus: Strengthen your expertise in React and TypeScript by building production-grade applications used across the company.
  • Occasional Full-Stack Exposure: Gain experience with C# and .NET backends in selected projects, broadening your technical perspective.
  • Diverse User Interaction: Collaborate with multiple departments and user types, ensuring your work has a direct, company-wide impact.
  • Innovation Opportunities: Contribute ideas and improvements in an environment that encourages creativity and continuous learning.
  • Collaborative Team Culture: Work alongside skilled, motivated, and supportive colleagues who share a passion for delivering quality software.

By joining the WES UI Team, you will have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, shape the company’s software infrastructure, and develop cutting-edge solutions in a collaborative and innovative environment.

Tasks & Responsibilities

Tool Development: Designing and developing modern web-based software solutions to support various company functions. The main focus lies on building and maintaining React and TypeScript frontends, ensuring performant, scalable, and user-friendly applications.
Some tools also include backend components built with C# and .NET, handled within the team when necessary.

Examples of developed tools include:

  1. Warehouse Configurator: Enables the creation and visualization of warehouse layouts enriched with metadata, making them compatible with the traffic controller.
  2. Handling Unit Configurator: A calculation tool that determines the optimal positions of handling units within the warehouse.
  3. WES-UI: A key application used both internally and by customers to monitor and interact with warehouse operations. (And many more tools tailored to the company's needs.)

Full Software Lifecycle: Responsible for the software development process from A to Z, including analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering training for end users.

Optimizing and Enhancing: Focus on refactoring, improving code quality and efficiency, and maintaining a highly performant software architecture.

Cross-Department Collaboration: Collaborate with various departments to gather requirements, ensure the software aligns with business needs, and provide ongoing support to enhance operational efficiency.

Medior : 4–5 years of experience in software development, preferably in an industrial or technical environment.

Required knowledge and experience in one or more of the following technologies:

  • React and TypeScript (core focus)
  • Modern frontend practices such as component-based architecture, state management, and responsive design
  • Frontend tooling such as Vite, Webpack, or similar build tools
  • Version control and CI/CD using Git and Azure DevOps
  • Unit testing and integration testing with frameworks such as Jest or React Testing Library
  • Clean code principles and software maintainability

Additional experience (nice to have):

  • Basic understanding of .NET Core and C# for integration with backend services
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON-based data exchange

Fluent in Dutch and English.

What do we offer you?

  • A place in an enthusiastic, young organisation with the necessary ambitions
  • The necessary freedom and opportunity to take initiative.
  • An intensive training by experienced people.
  • An attractive salary in an international environment with many benefits:
    • Company car with fuel card/charging pass
    • Group & health insurance
    • Meal vouchers (8€)
    • Net allowances
    • CAO90 Bonus
    • Laptop
    • iPhone + subscription
    • 20 days of vacation plus 12 extra days for working a full year on 40h-workweek instead of 38h (32 leave days in total)
  • Satellite office in Berchem ( Antwerp )

Any T&Cs from these third parties will not be accepted unless upon signature of the T&Cs by a person in charge of HR.

title: Electronics Engineer ATLAS ITk Pixel OB (EP-ATL-TRK-2026-256-GRAE)
description:
The ATLAS experiment constructs a new silicon tracking detector, the ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN team focuses on the development of the Pixel Outer Barrel. The responsibilities relate to the type-1 services as well as test equipment for quality control and electrical testing of detector structures and the final detector integration.

Your responsibilities:

  • Type-1 power and data reception activities.
  • T1UT (custom test equipment) user support.
  • Quality control testing of custom cable assemblies for the detector, with a focus on type-1 data.
  • Type-1 environmental cable production testing and supervision, including commissioning after installation during detector construction.
  • Electronics testing and development support.
  • Software development support.

Your profile:

  • Experience in the design of PCBs, their production and verification/debugging.
  • Experience in programming microcontrollers.
  • Hands-on experience in soldering and handling of electrical equipment.
  • Experience in writing technical reports, user documentation and manuals.

Skills:

  • PCB design software, preferably Altium or KiCad.
  • Programming in C/C++ and Python.
  • Ability to operate multimeters, oscilloscopes and a VNA.
  • Demonstrating flexibility: adapting quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
  • Achieving results: delivering high-quality work on time and fulfilling expectations; being rigorous and producing quality results at first attempt.
  • Working in a mixed team of engineers, technicians and physicists.
  • Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility criteria:

  • You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
  • By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Electronics Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree.
  • You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
  • Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
  • Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 29.11.2026 at 23:59 CET

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

Target start date: 01-February-2027

This position involves:

  • Work in Radiation Areas.
  • Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Job reference: EP-ATL-TRK-2026-256-GRAE

Field of work: Electronics Engineering

Benchmark job: 200050 - Electronics Engineer

Global Benefits

  • A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
  • 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.

  • Project Management: Capability to coordinate projects, communicate changes and progress, complete projects on time and within budget, and manage project team activities.

  • Managing People: Inclusion of staff in planning, decision-making, and process improvement, taking responsibility for subordinates' activities, providing regular performance feedback, developing subordinates' skills and encouraging growth, soliciting and applying tenant feedback, fostering quality focus in others, improving processes, products, and services, and continually working to improve supervisory skills.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • Must have a current Real Estate sales license or obtain it within six months of employment.


WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Join an industry leader and shape the future of commercial real estate.
  • Deep investment in cutting-edge technology to power your work.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer at Nexthink, you will be responsible for the security of our internal environment. You won't just be monitoring logs; you will be architecting the security fabric that enables our rapid growth.

Working in close partnership with IT, business teams and, partnering with our Cloud and Application Security teams, you will secure the identity, devices, and applications used by "Nexthinkers" worldwide. You will own the security of a complex SaaS ecosystem, and lead detection and response for the corporate environment.

What You Will Do

Identity-Centric Security Architecture

  • Contribute to the design and support the implementation of passwordless authentication and Zero Trust principles.
  • Manage secure provisioning and lifecycle management, ensuring least-privilege access across all business systems.
  • Partner with HR and IT to streamline onboarding/offboarding workflows, ensuring timely access revocation and auditability.

Endpoint & Infrastructure Security

  • Define and enforce security baselines for our diverse fleet of endpoints (Windows, macOS) and mobile devices via MDM (Intune/Jamf).
  • Manage and tune EDR/XDR solutions to ensure high-fidelity detection on workstations and servers (Windows, Linux, macOS).
  • Secure the corporate Azure footprint, ensuring proper configuration of subscriptions, networking, and resources distinct from our production product environment.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate security risks in our corporate environment, conducting regular security assessments and vulnerability scans.
  • Coordinate vulnerability management and patch management
  • Collaborate with IT to automate endpoint compliance checks and remediation workflows.

Security Engineering

  • Support the development and maintenance of Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Ensure hardening and compliance of endpoints and servers.

SaaS Security & Integration

  • Assess and secure third-party SaaS integrations (e.g., Salesforce apps, browser extensions, productivity tools) to prevent data leakage and over-privileged access.
  • Collaborate with Legal and Compliance to vet new vendors and tools.
  • Configure and maintain CASB and DLP policies to safeguard sensitive corporate data without hindering productivity.

Detection, Response & Automation

  • Lead incident response activities for corporate security events (phishing, malware, lost devices).
  • Develop automation scripts (Python/PowerShell) and workflows (SOAR) to automate manual security tasks, evidence collection, and response actions.
  • Proactively hunt for threats within the corporate network and identity providers.
  • Develop incident response playbooks including technology specific procedures and forensics collection

Audits and Compliance

  • Design and implement security controls to safeguard corporate resources, including endpoints, data storage, networking, computing and identity and access management.
  • Support and automate evidence collection for audits.

Culture & Collaboration

  • Act as the primary security liaison to the IT Department and business teams, helping them build security into their operations (DevSecOps for IT).
  • Design and deliver technical security training and awareness campaigns for engineering and business teams.
  • 5-8 years of hands-on experience in Corporate Security, IT Security Engineering, or a SOC role in a cloud-first environment.
  • Endpoint Mastery: Experience hardening operating systems (macOS/Windows) and managing security via MDM/UEM tools.
  • Vulnerability management: Proven experience in helping IT and business teams patching systems and infrastructures.
  • Coding Skills: Proficiency in Python and Terraform for automating APIs and security workflows.
  • Security Ops: Proven experience with EDR tools and SIEM log analysis.
  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to explain complex risks to non-technical stakeholders.

title: Mech and Robotics Tech
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Mechatronics & Robotics Technician – JLL

What this job involves:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will have the opportunity to mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures

  • Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

  • Maintain a positive working relationship across all the Operations facility

  • Track and store department inventory

  • Move up to 49lbs as well as stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, with or without reasonable accommodation

  • Possible travel up to 20% at a minimum.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights and/or holidays

  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment

  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus in the Mechanical or Electrical field

  • 2+ years of experience with automated conveyor systems and controls

  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading

  • 1+ year of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles

  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards

  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)

  • Experience with robotic or electromechanical operation and maintenance

  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions

Physical Demands

  • Repetitive bending, crouching, kneeling, reaching, twisting, sitting, standing, and walking

  • Lifting parts and tools weighing on average 20 pounds, occasionally weighing up to 49 pounds

  • Dexterity in eye/hand coordination, feet (foot pedals) manual (picking, pinching, holding, grasping), and wrist motion (repetitive flexion/rotation)

  • Working conditions may include small spaces, dust, fumes/odors, hot/cold temperatures, inside/outside noise, vibration, standing on concrete for long hours and wet or uneven surfaces

  • Standing/walking on concrete surfaces for 10+ hour shifts

  • Working at heights (as stated previously)

  • Pushing/pulling wheeled equipment and carts up to 100+ pounds

  • Maneuvering awkward or bulky equipment parts

  • Working in cramped positions under/behind machinery

  • About 40%: Hands-on asset leader. For the assigned asset, the Head of Medical personally owns the regional scientific agenda, working directly with affiliates and top KOLs. This follows the working model of the Medical Lead CEE role: translating Sobi strategy into scientific communication, KOL engagement, evidence generation and field execution.
  • About 60%: Leader of the portfolio team. The Head of Medical builds, coaches and directs the CEE+ medical platform Medical Leads who are accountable for the remaining therapeutic areas in the Sobi portfolio, and ensures consistent standards, prioritisation and execution quality across affiliates and partner markets.

The role is a matrix leadership position. Success depends on partnership and stakeholder alignment around one coherent science agenda for CEE. The holder is expected to be agile, to anticipate change, and to bring clarity in a fast-moving environment.

Main responsibilities:

  • Lead the development, resourcing, execution, and follow-up of CEE+ Medical Affairs plans and support affiliate LMIP plans, aligned with global strategy, brand plans, launch priorities, partner-market needs, and business objectives, with 40% focus on driving designated asset & BD agenda
  • Provide matrix medical leadership to CEE+ affiliates and partner markets, leading CEE+MLT, support CEERJ Medical Agenda (participant in Core Medical Team), and support local planning, execution quality, prioritization, launch readiness.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the CEE+ medical platform team, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, objectives, KPIs, performance expectations, and development plans.
  • Ensure Medical Affairs delivers strong external and internal value through high-quality scientific engagement, impactful field execution, structured insight generation, evidence-based activities, and compliant medical communication.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Cross-functional team CEE+ and other Commercial, PACE, RDMA, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Geo-Expansion, Portfolio Management, Finance, HR, partner organizations, other functions.
  • Represent CEE+ Medical Affairs in relevant regional, global, and local forums, including CEERJ ELT, strategic projects (e.g. Field capabilities); back up line manager in CEE Grant committee, CEERJ LT & workflows ISS, MAP approvals, Veeva
  • Ensure governance and compliance across all CEE+ medical activities, including medical plans, deliverables, materials, external interactions, field engagements, partner-market activities, advisory boards, medical education, & cross-functional initiatives
  • University degree in a medical-science background or other relevant discipline; medical, clinical or research experience in the assigned disease area is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in both pre-launch and launch activities, in country and above country, with increasing responsibility.
  • Strong track record in engagement with KOLs locally and internationally.
  • Knowledge of health system and healthcare decision-making, including the regulatory, safety, legal and compliance environment.
  • Multi-stakeholder project management and leadership experience, delivering on time and within budget
  • Proven matrix leadership: influencing affiliates, general managers and global teams without formal authority.
  • In-depth people leadership: recruiting, managing and developing a medical team with a performance plan, including coaching across different capability levels and country maturity.
  • Personal accountability and ownership, with continuous focus on performance and operational excellence.
  • Ability to exchange scientific ideas with KOLs and HCPs and to present scientific data to small and large audiences.
  • Ability to quickly build therapeutic area competency of the assigned asset, and ability to oversee other disease areas through the team.
  • Experience with evidence generation, publications and scientific dissemination, .
  • Experience of reimbursed patient access projects is highly desirable.
  • Effective listening skills; ability to work in virtual and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills; above-average computer skills.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English; other CEE languages are an asset.

Additional Information:

  • Frequent regional and international travel is required, approximately 30% of working time.
  • Availability for external meetings, congresses and internal meetings outside standard hours with advance notice.
  • Valid driver's license may be required depending on local role set-up.
  • The role may be home-based or hybrid depending on country, local employment set-up and business requirements.

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

title: Industrial Wastewater Treatment Operator
description:
Woodard & Curran is an employee-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.


Woodard & Curran draws on the experience of hundreds of certified operators across the country, backed by the knowledge and skills of hundreds more engineers, scientists, and regulatory experts, to quickly tackle the most challenging operational issues and keep treatment plants running efficiently and in full compliance. Woodard & Curran also aids employees in earning, upgrading, and keeping their certifications within the industry.

What will you be doing at Woodard & Curran?

Come join our team supporting the wastewater treatment needs for a high-profile client at the Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport! In this unique role you will have the chance to work in Industrial Wastewater treatment allowing you the opportunity to grow and develop your skill set in the field. Each day presents different challenges and learning opportunities as we strive to maintain compliance and produce the highest quality of treated wastewater. If you enjoy protecting nature’s precious resource, water, then this position is for you! Woodard & Curran is dedicated to our employees’ growth and development and wants to help you on your career path.

We are seeking a full-time Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) Operator in Atlanta, GA. This position is responsible for operating the WWTP in compliance with applicable local, state, and Federal environmental requirements, including performing daily rounds, preventive maintenance and assisting with equipment repairs, and troubleshooting and correcting operational problems. Other responsibilities include grounds keeping, pressure washing, light painting, sweeping, cleaning, and shoveling. The schedule for this position may occasionally involve rotating twelve-hour shifts.. Shifts may include nights, weekends or legal holidays with the opportunity for overtime pay.

Schedule: This position is shift work and is eligible for overtime. The shift will be 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM Monday – Friday, but may involve on-call response on off days/off hours.

Pay range: $23/hr - $33/hr based on experience and licensure level

What will you need to succeed?

  • Georgia (or equivalent) Grade III or higher or Industrial wastewater operator’s license.
  • 1-3 years’ experience in the operation of a wastewater treatment facility preferred.
  • High School graduate or equivalent required.
  • Mechanical aptitude is a plus.Knowledge of computer applications, and ability to use & learn various software programs [Hach WIMS, NEXGEN CMMS].
  • Applicant must possess a valid driver’s License and maintain a good driving record.
  • Must be able to lift or move up to 40 pounds on a regular basis.
  • Successful candidates will be required to complete a background check, pre-placement physical and drug screen before employment.
