title: Clinical Independent Rater - Mexico
description:
Clinical Independent Rater - Mexico

Location: Remote/Virtual
Hours: Estimated 10–16 hours per month
Role: Clinical Independent Rater for Clinical Trials


About IQVIA

IQVIA is a global leader in advanced analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services, dedicated to driving healthcare forward. We partner with the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to improve patient outcomes and accelerate innovation. Our team combines deep scientific expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver high-quality data and insights that shape the future of clinical trials.


Position Overview

The CIR plays a key role in ensuring the integrity and reliability of clinical trial data. This position involves reviewing scales administered by raters to confirm standardized assessment practices. Responsibilities include evaluating assessment quality, engaging in live discussions with raters to provide guidance on methodology and scoring techniques, and supporting rater performance through functional assessments (e.g., mock interviews). Additional tasks may include assisting with communication materials and documentation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in all required orientation, training, and calibration activities.
  • Review case data and prepare for rater discussions, ensuring all relevant documents and assessment materials are available.
  • Conduct patient interviews and clinical assessments with study participants.
  • Administer, score, and interpret clinical rating scales and structured interviews.
  • Provide feedback and guidance to raters on assessment methodology, interview techniques, and scoring accuracy through live interactions.
  • Complete assigned assessments, rater interactions, and related activities according to study timelines and schedules.
  • Work directly with study participants while maintaining protocol compliance and data quality standards.
  • Submit all required documentation, reports, and assessment records accurately and within required timelines.

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Master’s degree (MA/MS) in Psychology, Counseling, Psychiatric Nursing, or Social Work (or equivalent). MD, DO, or PhD preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Minimum 3 years administering psychiatric assessments, rating scales, and/or structured clinical interviews (specifically HAM -A; SCID-5; CGI; MADRS and CSSSRS)
    • Minimum 3 years of clinical trial experience with psychiatric populations.
    • Minimum 3 years administering scales in clinical research trials (excluding graduate/doctoral research).
    • Experience in CNS trials preferred.
  • Skills:
    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills for professional interaction at all levels.
    • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, time management, and problem-solving ability.
    • Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office applications.

Language Requirement

Current openings require fluency in English and native-level proficiency in Mexican.

title: GRAIL Galleri Consultant 1 (Las Vegas) # 5004
description:
Our mission is to detect cancer early, when it can be cured. We are working to change the trajectory of cancer mortality and bring stakeholders together to adopt innovative, safe, and effective technologies that can transform cancer care.
We are a healthcare company, pioneering new technologies to advance early cancer detection. We have built a multi-disciplinary organization of scientists, engineers, and physicians and we are using the power of next-generation sequencing (NGS), population-scale clinical studies, and state-of-the-art computer science and data science to overcome one of medicine’s greatest challenges.
GRAIL is headquartered in the Bay Area of California, with locations in Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and the United Kingdom. It is supported by leading global investors and pharmaceutical, technology, and healthcare companies.
For more information, please visit

This is a great opportunity to join the growing commercial team at GRAIL, as a GRAIL Galleri Consultant (GGC1), working hand in hand with sales leadership and internal stakeholders to execute the go to market sales strategy for GRAIL’s revolutionary MCED (multi-cancer early detection) product Galleri.
This is a customer-focused position that requires a “market builder” mindset. A successful GGC1 acts with urgency and passion to engage physicians and their staff to think differently about cancer screening and change the way they practice, integrating MCED technology into their office workflow, and consistently offering it to appropriate patients with the goal to identify more cancers sooner.
GRAIL is the first company in the world to bring MCED technology to patients and clinicians - this is a rare opportunity in one's career!
The GGC1 role is an in-person selling role, with the expectation that candidates spend the majority of their time (>85%) making in-person visits to targeted physician practices, planning and supporting events, and executing on Company initiatives.
This is a field-based role located in your city and state, currently covering the following territory: Las Vegas, NV and surrounding areas. While you will primarily operate in the field, travel to a GRAIL office or other locations may be required to support business needs.
We’re building a world-class team to take on one of healthcare’s most important challenges. Are you ready to join us?

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a business plan to drive territory growth and meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Expand breadth and depth of prescribing, optimize promotional budgets, and execute the national sales strategy in line with GRAIL standards.
  • Prospect and target primary care practices to generate interest in Galleri and identify/onboard early adopters.
  • Represent and collaborate with a diverse, cross-functional team to enhance competitiveness and innovation.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders (sales leadership, marketing, customer service, billing, and other customer-facing teams) to provide field insights that shape strategy and execution.
  • Identify market opportunities, share best practices, and communicate successful selling approaches with peers, management, and the Commercial Team.
  • Implement promotional activities that support sales and marketing strategies in compliance with industry standards and company policies.
  • Collaborate with Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) to educate providers on the science behind MCED technology and build relationships with Key Opinion Leaders.
  • Manage complex customer accounts by engaging healthcare providers, administrators, and clinical staff through advanced consultative selling and solution-oriented discussions.
  • Lead high-level product conversations, clinical education sessions, and value-based presentations tailored to specific therapeutic and operational needs.
  • Apply in-depth knowledge of diagnostic tools, laboratory processes, and clinical applications to support informed decision-making among customers.
  • Analyze territory performance trends, competitive dynamics, and customer behavior to shape strategy and identify growth opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate customer documentation within the CRM system.
  • Build and sustain long-term customer relationships by providing consistent follow-up, operational support, and clinically relevant insights.
  • Ensure that all sales activities comply with legal requirements, company policies, and healthcare industry standards.
These responsibilities summarize the role’s primary responsibilities and are not an exhaustive list. They may change at the company’s discretion.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3+ years of successful sales experience or 2+ years accepted if candidate possess direct GRAIL experience.
  • Ability to travel as required approximately 85% and may include overnight stays.
  • Valid driver’s license.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or a related healthcare field.
  • Background in medical or biological sciences.
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales goals.
  • Recognition for sales performance (e.g., awards, rankings, or consistent overachievement) strongly preferred.
  • Exceptionally motivated, flexible, and results-oriented with strong interpersonal and analytical skills.
  • Ability to think strategically and execute tactically in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong sense of urgency with the ability to work independently and manage a territory with minimal supervision.
  • Desire to work in a startup or high-growth environment.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills (written and verbal), with demonstrated ability to present to internal and external customers.
  • Strong time management skills with the ability to assess priorities and manage competing demands.
  • Working knowledge of geography and customer base.
  • Proficiency in Google Suite (Sheets, Doc, Forms, Slides).

Physical Demands & Working Environment:

  • Hours and days may vary depending on operational needs.
  • Working with dry ice may be necessary.
  • Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary.
  • May be exposed to hazardous materials, blood specimens and instruments with moving parts, heating or freezing elements, and high speed centrifugation.
  • Some lifting (up to 25 pounds) may be necessary.
  • Ability to travel 85% as required.
The expected, full-time, annual base pay scale for this position is $94k-$125k.

At GRAIL, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the contributions our employees make to our mission and success. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for additional compensation, including an annual bonus and/or other incentives, in accordance with applicable plans and the company's discretion. The posted range reflects our good-faith estimate of the base pay we expect to offer for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and other relevant considerations.

description:
• ontwerpen en aansturen van verandermanagement bij verschillende transformaties, zoals digitale, technologie-gedreven transformaties, cultuurtransformaties en organisatietransformaties (bijvoorbeeld reorganisaties, fusies en overnames);
  • richting geven aan het programma op basis van de impact van een verandering (zoals nieuwe digitale oplossingen of nieuwe manier van werken en processen) op de organisatiestructuur, competenties en vaardigheden, organisatiecultuur en bereidheid tot verandering;

  • ontwikkelen van een plan voor leiderschap en senior stakeholders om betrokkenheid te verhogen en het managen van de uitvoering en effectiviteit hiervan;
  • managen en bijsturen op basis van de uitkomsten van succesmetingen van verandermanagement programma’s door middel van data-gedreven analyses;
  • ontwerpen, faciliteren en leiden van focusgroepen en workshops voor (senior) management.

Natuurlijk ​ontdek je graag nieuwe manieren om complexe problemen op te lossen​ en ​leg je graag de verbinding tussen mensen​. Bovenal ben je jezelf. Met je eigen sterke punten, (professionele) blik op de wereld en persoonlijkheid. Verder heb jij als Manager Transformational Change:

  • minimaal 6 - 9 jaar aantoonbare (internationale) werkervaring op het gebied van verandermanagement, inclusief ervaring met grootschalige (digitale) transformaties;
  • aantoonbare ervaring en vaardigheden bij het leiden van verandermanagement bij verschillende transformaties, zoals digitale, technologie-gedreven transformaties, cultuurtransformaties en organisatietransformaties (fusies en overnames). Concrete ervaring met digitale transformaties zoals ERP implementaties (bijvoorbeeld SAP, Oracle) is een pre;
  • aantoonbare ervaring met het vertalen van strategische doelstellingen in grootschalige, complexe organisatieveranderingen, het leiden van succesvolle, multidisciplinaire teams en het managen van grote opdrachten op tijd en binnen budget, en veel zin om naast het adviseren van klanten, jezelf verder te ontwikkelen in inhoudelijke, projectmatige, zakelijke en commerciële vaardigheden en te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons Transformational Change team;
  • aantoonbare ervaring met het commerciële proces van scopen, budgetteren en verwerven van opdrachten, met een actieve rol in het uitbreiden en verdiepen van sectorspecifieke kennis in samenwerking met andere collega's;
  • uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en vloeiend in Nederlands en Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk);
  • bereidheid tot binnen- en buitenlandse reizen, afhankelijk van projectvereisten.

Als Manager Transformational Change, werk je samen met de meest prestigieuze klanten uit verschillende sectoren. Als Manager ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de uitvoer en de begeleiding van verandermanagement voor (digitale, technologie-gedreven en organisatorische) transformaties in multidisciplinaire teams en de aansturing van collega's op projecten. title: Director, Government & Defense (USP5)
description:
SUMMARY: VSE Aviation is building a dedicated Government & Defense Business Unit within our Distribution Group, and this role will have responsibility over it. This is a build and scale opportunity: the Director owns the full P&L, sets the strategy and annual targets, and builds the team, processes, and operating model to grow our US and foreign government aftermarket distribution business. The Director partners with our OEMs to expand the product lines and programs we support for military and government end users, and leads the team responsible for business development, government bidding and contracting, product line management, and supply chain execution, while ensuring compliance with government contracting, export control, and OEM requirements. This is a true general manager role with visibility, leadership support, and runway to grow the business and the team, as part of a leading and fast-growing global aerospace distributor.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Own the full P&L of the Government & Defense Business Unit, including revenue, margin, inventory, and budget performance, and deliver against the annual plan and long-term growth targets.
  • Build and scale the business unit: define the organization structure, hire and develop the team, and stand up the processes, systems, and KPIs needed to grow the business.
  • Make staffing, budget, and pursuit decisions, balancing revenue and profit targets against headcount and team capacity.
  • Develop and execute the multi-year growth strategy for VSE’s government and defense distribution business across legacy and newly acquired entities, including direct US government (DLA and military services), prime contractor, Foreign Military Sales (FMS), and foreign government channels.
  • Lead the capture and bid process, including identification, research, and bid/no-bid decisions on government solicitations. Approve and oversee large-scale proposals, pricing strategy, and long-term agreements and contract vehicles.
  • Serve as the senior point of contact with government contracting officers and agency representatives and negotiate in the company’s best interest.
  • Ensure compliance with government contracting requirements, including FAR/DFARS, registrations and renewals (e.g., CAGE, SAM.gov), ITAR/EAR export control, cybersecurity requirements (NIST SP 800-171, CMMC), supplier intake and traceability, and contractual obligations and reporting.
  • Develop and sustain senior-level relationships with OEM partners, and lead negotiation and renewal of distribution agreements that support military and government sales.
  • Pursue and lead new business development opportunities with OEMs, prime contractors, and government customers to win additional product line and program scope and build a qualified pipeline.
  • Direct escalation of late deliveries from manufacturing partners and hold partners accountable to delivery commitments.
  • Direct market intelligence efforts, identify key threats and opportunities, and approve and oversee execution of strategic plans.
  • Approve forecasts and ensure the internal ordering strategy maximizes profit while maintaining appropriate inventory levels, including oversight of the aging inventory plan in accordance with company policy and acceptable risk levels.
  • Monitor key performance indicators, analyze results, and direct strategic actions in line with company direction.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales, Legal, Trade Compliance, Quality, and Supply Chain to implement margin improvement initiatives and manage risk.
  • Communicate Government & Defense performance, metrics, and strategy to internal and external stakeholders and senior leadership at business reviews or as needed.
  • Ensure OEM and customer reporting is produced, analyzed, and distributed accurately and on time.
  • Represent VSE at government and defense industry events and trade shows and travel for OEM and customer visits.
  • Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing team, and build a bench of future leaders for the business unit.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Technical Product Manager - Payouts
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.
Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
Félix moves money for millions of transactions from the US to LatAm. The Payouts Platform is the shared service every Félix product uses to send money out, across bank transfers, instant payment rails, wallets, cards, cash networks, and crypto rails.
As PM for Payouts Platform, you'll own the vision, roadmap and results for how money gets to its destination. Your goal is to make paying out fast, reliable and low-cost for every product, in every market we serve.

What you'll focus on
  • Set the vision and roadmap. Define where the Payouts Platform goes next, and balance new capabilities, reliability and cost in your priorities.
  • Build a platform every product can use. Turn payouts into a shared, self-serve capability that any product team can adopt quickly, so Félix can launch new products without building payouts from scratch each time.
  • Expand reach. Decide which markets and rails to invest in next, across Latin America and beyond, including instant payments, wallets, cash networks and crypto rails. Lead the platform side of each launch with FX, Compliance and Treasury, and shorten the time to go live.
  • Shape partner strategy. Define what the platform needs from payout partners, compare their performance, and decide which ones to integrate or route more volume to. That includes building direct connections to major payout providers alongside aggregator partners. Make partner decisions for new capabilities alongside the Business Development team, which owns the commercial relationships.
  • Improve performance. Define the routing and validation strategy that raises success rates and speed while lowering cost per payout.
  • Reduce manual work. Prioritize product improvements that remove manual handling of failed and returned payouts, working with Ops and the Ops Platform. Give product teams real-time visibility into every payout.
  • Align across teams. Make sure every payout is compliant, funded and supportable. That means working with Compliance on screening, Treasury on liquidity, and product teams on the experience they build on top of the platform.
  • Set service commitments. Define the reliability and performance levels product teams can count on, and prioritize the work to meet them with the engineering team, which owns delivery. Report on the success, speed and cost of payouts.

What you'll bring
  • Product experience: 5+ years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Platform and API experience: you've owned a product whose main customers were other teams or developers.
  • Partner integrations: a track record of taking third-party integrations from evaluation to production, with engineering and commercial teams.
  • Data fluency: comfortable with SQL and with defining and tracking reliability and cost metrics.
  • Clear communication: you can explain trade-offs to engineers, ops teams and executives alike.
  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $170,000 and $220,000 USD in New York, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

Equal Opportunity Employer
At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

title: Sterile Processing Technician (104893)
description:
SECTION 1: Job Summary (Summary of the basic functions of the position)

Under the general direction of the Medical Director, the Central Sterile Processing Technician receives,
cleans, decontaminates, and sterilizes items for reprocessing. Assemble and tests equipment for issue
as requested, as well as orders supplies as needed.

SECTION 2: Duties and Responsibilities (Responsibilities necessary to accomplish job functions)

title: Resident Care Aides (Casual)
description:
Job Summary:

Under the direction of the Registered Nurses/Registered Psychiatric Nurse (RN/RPN) and Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), the Resident Care Attendant carries out a variety of established care programs for complex care residents.

The RCA assists with activities of daily living such as personal, psychological, physical and recreational needs. The RCA promotes activities that encourage resident participation and independence within their interests and abilities.

  • Commitment to providing the highest quality of service

  • Minimum grade 10 graduation plus graduation from a recognized Resident Care Aide program

title: Technical Product Manager - Platform
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.
Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
We are seeking a highly hands-on and Technical Product Manager to build and scale the core platform services that power Félix. These are the APIs, integrations, and real-time systems that every Félix product depends on to move money and data reliably between our users, our partners, and our internal teams. This role is for someone who thinks in systems, reusable components, and service contracts, not individual features.
You will own a set of platform capabilities end to end: partner and provider integrations, routing and orchestration logic, service reliability, and the data that tells us how the platform is performing. You will be a doer, not just a delegator, working side by side with engineering on architecture and tradeoffs while owning the metrics that matter.

What you’ll focus on
  • Define & Execute Platform Strategy – Work with Product and Engineering leadership to own the roadmap for core platform services, unifying external providers and internal systems into scalable, reusable building blocks that multiple product teams consume.
  • Own Core APIs & Integrations – Drive the design and evolution of the APIs and partner integrations at the heart of our infrastructure, including service contracts, versioning, error handling, and developer experience for internal consumers.
  • Build for Resilience – Partner with engineering on routing, fallback, and retry logic across multiple providers. Balance success rates, cost, latency, and reliability, and drive monitoring and automation that catch issues before users feel them.
  • Hands-On Data Analysis – Own platform health metrics and have a hands-on relationship with the data.
  • Scale New Capabilities – Launch new integrations, providers, and services as Félix expands into new products and markets, including real-time disbursement and money movement across borders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud, and Compliance to turn complex requirements into clean platform solutions.
  • Partner Management – Evaluate, integrate, and manage relationships with external technology and financial partners, and communicate platform strategy and impact to executive leadership.

What you’ll bring
  • 5+ years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Deep technical fluency. You are comfortable discussing system design, API architecture, and service dependencies with engineers,
  • Experience owning platform-level metrics (reliability, latency, success rate, cost) and using them to drive improvements.
  • Experience integrating and managing third-party providers or partners via API.
  • Strong ownership and a bias toward action; comfortable working hands-on rather than delegating.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences, including executives and external partners.

These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $170,000 and $220,000 USD in New York, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

Equal Opportunity Employer
At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy.

title: Business Optimisation Manager (m/f/x)
description:
Your daily pitch

Do you enjoy connecting the dots across an organisation and turning ideas into scalable business solutions? Are you someone who looks at opportunities from every angle — commercial, operational, compliance, and customer impact — before making the call?

In this role, you’ll be the playmaker of new initiatives, connecting departments and making sure every move counts. Whether it’s a new feature, process, or operational change, you’ll assess the impact across the business, keep everything in line with regulatory rules and commercial interests, and guide stakeholders toward the best play. Reporting to the Head of Business Process Excellence, you’ll make sure every new development is fit for the big league that is scalable, compliant, commercially strong, and fully aligned with our winning strategy.

At Tipico, we believe in owning our game. Are you ready to step onto the pitch, bring your best self, and become a champion? Then show us your game face – because we're looking for a Business Optimisation Manager (m/f/x) to join the team!

  • Define and monitor process KPIs, identify opportunities to improve performance, and optimise how your processes support overall business objectives.
  • Act as the cross-functional connector between Product, Operations, Compliance, Commercial, and other teams when introducing new initiatives or product features.
  • Evaluate and challenge new proposals from a business perspective, ensuring they are operationally feasible, compliant, and commercially viable.
  • Analyse the impact of new features and changes on business performance, operational processes, and customer experience.

  • Assess cost, operational efficiency, and return on investment when reviewing new initiatives.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements and ensure business, operational, and regulatory impacts are understood before implementation.

Which skills should you bring to the pitch

  • Qualification. You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience. You bring experience in Business Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Development, or Country Management, ideally within fast-paced digital businesses. Experience within the Gaming, Fintech, or Payments industry would be an advantage.
  • Business Mindset. You are comfortable assessing initiatives from multiple perspectives including commercial viability, operational impact, compliance, and customer value.
  • Strategic Thinking. You are able to connect the big picture with operational realities, ensuring new initiatives align with business strategy and deliver tangible value.
  • Analytical skills. You have strong analytical capabilities and enjoy working with data to evaluate performance, identify trends, and support decision-making.
  • Stakeholder management. You are confident working across departments and influencing stakeholders to drive alignment and progress.
  • Ownership. You take full responsibility for initiatives and processes, ensuring they are well-governed and executed effectively.
  • Language Skills. English is the official language at the office, therefore fluency in English is essential. As the #1 sports betting provider in Germany, German would be a plus.
  • Customer-centric mindset. You always consider the customer impact when evaluating changes and improvements.

This is how we score with you:

  • Relocation Support. To make your move to Malta as smooth as possible
  • Competitive Package. We care for our employees, offering an indefinite contract, competitive salary, insurances (private health, dental, private accident, sickness and life) and free parking.
  • On-site childcare. We’ve got a game plan to support you and your 3+ year old kids.
  • Sports Incentive. We want you to remain active and will subsidise a gym membership of your choice.
  • Modern offices. Our very own Tipico tower provides an open plan space with the latest technology.
  • Events. Sponsored Charity and Team gatherings, we like to have fun together as one team and reinforce our connections.
  • Supportive Environment. We believe in collaboration and working together as a team but we also give importance to the uniqueness of each and every one of us.

Think a career at Tipico is right for you? Apply now and join our winning team.

If you have any questions or comments about this role, our TA team is happy to help you! Feel free to reach out to us on our social media channels

We look forward to your application!

title: Product Design Intern
description:
We are evolving Artemis, Nexthink's Design System, to help the product team deliver consistent, accessible, high-quality experiences across a complex B2B software platform. You will help make our components, interaction patterns, and documentation easier to use and scale.

As an intern you will:

  • Review existing Figma libraries, UI patterns, and documentation to identify inconsistencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Create and refine reusable Figma components, including variants, states, and usage examples, with guidance from the UX team.

  • Turn design decisions into clear component specifications, interaction guidelines, and structured documentation.

  • Work with designers and engineers to improve design-to-development handover, and explore ways to make it more efficient through tooling and automation.

This internship offers hands-on experience in:

  • Contributing to a production design system used by cross-functional product teams; working with Figma, component-driven design, and modern UX documentation practices; and collaborating directly with UX, product management, and engineering colleagues.

You will gain experience in:

  • Building scalable UI foundations, documenting interaction patterns, understanding accessibility and consistency requirements, and translating designs into implementation-ready guidance for a real SaaS product.

  • Currently studying at university or freshly graduated in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Digital Humanities, Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.
  • Familiarity with Figma and basic user interface design principles, with an interest in design systems and reusable components.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills; curiosity, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and collaborate.

Nice to have

  • Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS, front-end development, or a framework such as Angular.
  • Experience with Figma components, variants, variables, auto layout, or digital accessibility principles.
  • Interest in AI-assisted design workflows, design-to-code tooling, or automated documentation.

Previous professional experience is not required. We value curiosity, initiative, and thoughtful problem-solving. It is a paid internship.

description:

Account & Strategic Leadership

Growth & Agency Contribution

title: Product Manager
description:
You’ll own one or more parts of the traveller journey across app and web; we’ll set the exact charter with you. Work on our roadmap includes:

Search and booking — comparing buses, smarter filters, a cleaner seat layout and fewer payment drop-offs.

The trip — an AI-powered Trip Mode, live tracking, delay alerts and boarding-point guidance.

Cancellations and refunds — alternatives before a cancel, clear refund tracking and easy reschedules.

Growth and monetisation — rewards and referrals, cross-sell and upsell, and supply-side monetisation through operator ads and sponsored listings.

What you’ll do

Own outcomes — set the roadmap and KPIs for your area, and own the results.

Find the real problem — talk to travellers, bus operators, sales and on-ground teams and support, and keep asking why until you reach the root cause.

Design the experience — sketch and prototype, and work with designers to craft “aha” moments and delightful nudges.

Build with AI — prototype faster, and turn manual, support-heavy journeys into self-serve ones.

Let data decide — pull your own data, run A/B tests and challenge assumptions.

Ship end to end — write clear specs, launch smoothly, keep improving, and keep engineering, design and business aligned.

What success looks like

Measurable gains in your metrics — conversion, repeat bookings, app ratings, fewer support contacts.

Superlative experiences, with clear “aha” moments and delightful nudges that travellers notice.

At least one manual journey made self-serve with AI.

Who you are

A PM who thinks like a designer and notices friction others miss.

Deeply empathetic — you feel the traveller’s worries before you design for them.

A design thinker who frames the problem before jumping to a solution, and tests early with real users.

Comfortable with data and AI tools, a clear communicator, and high on ownership.

2–4 years of product management experience on customer-facing (B2C) app or web products.

A track record of shipping features end to end and moving a metric you can name.

Hands-on SQL and analytics — funnels, cohorts, A/B tests (tools like Mixpanel, CleverTap, GA or similar).

Practical use of AI tools in product work — e.g. ChatGPT or Claude for research and specs, and Figma AI, Lovable, Cursor or similar for prototyping.

Hands-on with design thinking and user research — interviews, usability tests, journey mapping — and able to create wireframes and clickable prototypes in Figma or similar tools.

Clear written and verbal communication.

Strongly preferred

A UX, UI or product design background. Please include a portfolio if you have one.

An MBA from a reputed business school.

Good to have

Experience in travel, mobility, e-commerce, payments or marketplaces.

Experience with conversational AI, offers or loyalty products.

  • Proficient in developing and maintaining complex C++ software applications

Client Service Delivery

  • Assist clients with life skills, problem solving, utilizing effective coping skills for managing and coordinating their own care needs when living independently

  • Practice Trauma-Informed Care and Motivational Interviewing when meeting with clients weekly

  • Conduct crisis and risk assessments in consultation with Navigation Supervisor and site team as needed

Administration

title: Assistant Manager - FT-8608
description:
Summary/Objective:

FullSpeed Automotive is one of the largest multi-brand automotive service platforms in the country, operating locations nationwide under brands customers know and trust. Every great customer experience starts at the store level — and the Assistant Manager plays a critical role in making that happen every single day.

The Assistant Manager supports the Store Manager in leading day-to-day operations, ensuring the team delivers fast, friendly, and high-quality automotive service while maintaining a safe, clean, and well-run location. This role is hands-on — splitting time between the service bay, the front counter, and the back office — and is a key developmental step for those looking to grow into store leadership.

We are looking for someone who leads by example, takes pride in a job done right, and genuinely enjoys building a team that customers and coworkers can count on.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Supervision

  • Support the Store Manager in supervising daily operations, stepping in to lead the location in the manager's absence.

  • Coach, train, and motivate technicians and service advisors to deliver consistent, high-quality service.

  • Assist with scheduling team members to ensure proper coverage during peak hours and busy seasons.

  • Help onboard and train new team members on service procedures, point-of-sale systems, and customer service standards.

  • Foster a positive, team-oriented work environment that reflects FullSpeed Automotive's values.

Customer Experience & Sales

  • Greet customers, explain services, and ensure every visit reflects FullSpeed Automotive's commitment to speed, quality, and trust.

  • Recommend additional services based on manufacturer guidelines and vehicle needs, helping customers make informed decisions.

  • Resolve customer concerns or complaints promptly and professionally, escalating to the Store Manager when needed.

  • Support efforts to build repeat business through excellent service and genuine customer care.

Store & Shop Operations

  • Assist in managing daily store operations, including opening/closing procedures, cash handling, and point-of-sale transactions.

  • Help monitor and maintain inventory levels for parts, fluids, and supplies — placing orders as directed by the Store Manager.

  • Ensure the shop and customer areas are clean, organized, and presentable at all times, reflecting brand standards.

  • Support compliance with all safety protocols, environmental regulations, and company policies.

  • Assist with tracking daily sales, productivity, and key performance metrics, helping the team stay focused on store goals.

Quality & Safety

  • Help ensure all services are performed correctly, safely, and in accordance with brand and manufacturer standards.

  • Conduct or support quality checks on completed work to maintain a high standard of service.

  • Promote a safety-first culture, ensuring team members follow proper procedures for equipment use, chemical handling, and shop safety.

  • Assist in identifying and addressing maintenance needs for shop equipment and facilities.

title: Forward Deploy Staff Software Engineer
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

#JLLTechAmbitions

JLL, an international real estate management company, is building AI into the way its teams work with enterprise data. As an AI Engineer you will turn proofs of concept into reliable, governed, production services: agents that can call tools, remember context, respect user permissions, and be traced, evaluated, and costed.

You will work across both technology tracks as project priorities shift: agent engineering on AWS (Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore) and data and AI engineering on Oracle (AI Data Platform and AI Database). The ideal candidate is a hands-on builder with a “Get it done” attitude, strong engineering discipline, and a habit of asking the right questions before building.

Responsibilities

  • Build agents on AWS: design, deploy, and operate AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using AgentCore Runtime for hosting, Gateway to expose APIs and Lambda functions as tools (including MCP), Memory for short- and long-term context, Identity for secure agent access, and Observability for tracing and debugging.
  • Build RAG and agent solutions with Amazon Bedrock: implement foundation-model integrations, Knowledge Bases, Agents, and Guardrails, and manage prompts and model selection for cost, latency, and quality.
  • Build on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP): develop in the AIDP Workbench using Master Catalog assets, Spark notebooks, and workflows; apply medallion (bronze, silver, gold) data patterns; and build knowledge bases and agent flows on governed enterprise data.
  • Build on Oracle AI Database: implement AI Vector Search, hybrid (vector + relational) retrieval, Select AI natural-language-to-SQL interfaces, and in-database ML, with embedding pipelines and PL/SQL where needed.
  • Integrate across platforms: connect Oracle data services with AWS-hosted AI applications through secure, well-defined APIs and swappable service interfaces.
  • Engineer retrieval quality: own chunking and embedding strategy, metadata filtering, reranking, and retrieval tuning, and measure results with repeatable evaluations.
  • Secure and govern AI: apply IAM least privilege, database-enforced access control (such as role-based access and data redaction), PII handling, and guardrails that screen for prompt injection and unsafe output. Keep audit trails of agent actions and outcomes.
  • Test and evaluate: build evaluation and regression suites for LLM output, track hallucination and accuracy, and verify behavior end to end against real services, not only with unit tests.
  • Deploy and operate: ship Python services (for example FastAPI) to production on AWS using Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, and Secrets Manager. Monitor latency, quality, and cost with CloudWatch and AgentCore Observability.
  • Collaborate and document: take part in sprint ceremonies and code and design reviews, and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-transfer material.

Experience & Education

  • 4-8 years of software, data, or AI/ML engineering experience, with hands-on delivery of generative AI or LLM-based applications in production or near-production.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is preferred.
  • Proven experience building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows, including tool calling and multi-step orchestration.
  • Experience with Amazon Bedrock and AWS-native deployment. Hands-on AgentCore experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Oracle Database or Oracle AI Database. Experience with the Oracle AI Data Platform is strongly preferred.
  • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, including tracing non-deterministic model behavior.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed team.

Technical Skills & Competencies

  • Generative AI on AWS: Amazon Bedrock foundation models, Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, prompt engineering, and model evaluation; Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Observability, and built-in tools such as Code Interpreter).
  • Oracle data and AI: Oracle AI Database (AI Vector Search, Select AI, in-database ML, PL/SQL) and Oracle AI Data Platform (Master Catalog, notebooks, workflows, knowledge bases, agent flows, OCI Generative AI integration).
  • AI application engineering: RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex, Model Context Protocol (MCP), embedding strategy, chunking, reranking, and structured LLM output.
  • AWS cloud: Lambda, API Gateway, S3, ECS/EKS, Step Functions, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and Secrets Manager.
  • Programming: Python (primary), REST APIs, and SQL; FastAPI or similar async frameworks.
  • Security and governance: IAM least privilege, data privacy controls, PII handling, and responsible-AI guardrails.
  • Delivery: Agile/Scrum, Git and CI/CD, Docker, Jira and Confluence, and clear documentation.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with AgentCore Identity and Gateway for secure, tool-enabled agents.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Apache Spark, or medallion-architecture data pipelines.
  • Infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and Kubernetes experience.
  • Experience with agent frameworks such as Strands Agents, or with migrating Bedrock Agents to a code-first framework.
  • Experience with LLM gateways, token and cost tracking, and usage analytics.
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI certifications.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Remote position, open for professionals based in Argentina.
At Ryz Labs, we are looking for an experienced Tech Lead to provide technical direction and leadership within an existing engineering scrum team responsible for a major platform modernization initiative.
This person will be responsible for guiding technical decisions, defining and reviewing software designs, ensuring code quality, mentoring engineers, and helping the team successfully deliver complex engineering initiatives.
The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on software engineering experience with technical leadership capabilities, particularly in C#, .NET, microservices architecture, and Microsoft Azure.
The Tech Lead will work closely with the existing Engineering Manager, Product Owner, and other technical stakeholders, contributing to architectural discussions and ensuring that engineering solutions align with the platform's long-term technical strategy.
Key Responsibilities
• Provide technical leadership and direction within an established engineering scrum team.
• Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions related to platform modernization.
• Guide the decomposition of monolithic application components into independent microservices.
• Define and review service boundaries, API contracts, integration patterns, and technical implementation approaches.
• Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards, coding practices, and architectural guidelines.
• Mentor and support software engineers, helping them solve complex technical challenges and improve engineering practices.
• Identify technical risks, dependencies, and blockers, proactively proposing solutions.
• Drive improvements in code quality, application performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
• Support the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices.
• Promote secure software development practices, automated testing, documentation, and technical traceability.
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure technical solutions meet product and business requirements.
• Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
• Demonstrate completed work during sprint showcases.
• Leverage approved AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development productivity, code reviews, testing, and documentation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work.
Required Technical Skills & Experience
• Strong experience with C# and .NET in production environments.
• Solid understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
• Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and service integrations.
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based application architectures.
• Experience working with SQL databases, particularly SQL Server.
• Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery processes, particularly Azure DevOps.
• Strong understanding of Git workflows, pull requests, and code review practices.
• Experience with software architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
• Familiarity with TypeScript and React Native to support cross-team technical discussions and integration needs.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
• Strong technical communication, problem-solving, and mentoring skills.
Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience migrating monolithic applications into microservices using incremental modernization approaches, such as the Strangler Pattern.
• Knowledge of event-driven architectures and asynchronous messaging.
• Experience with API gateways, distributed tracing, observability, and application monitoring.
• Familiarity with infrastructure as code and cloud automation.
• Experience implementing resilience patterns, including retries, circuit breakers, and health checks.
• Previous experience in regulated software environments, particularly GxP, life sciences, or quality management SaaS.
• Knowledge of data integrity principles, ALCOA+, audit trails, and change control.
• Experience with AI-assisted software engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot.
AI-Assisted Engineering & Regulatory Compliance
Our client is an AI-forward engineering organization. The Tech Lead is expected to promote the effective use of approved AI tools across development, testing, code review, and documentation.
At the same time, the role requires ensuring that AI-generated code and engineering artifacts follow the same standards as manually produced work.

title: Exempt to Permanent - 0933 - MANAGER V (E10198)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Under general administrative direction, incumbents in this class function as senior managers operating within a broad policy framework and typically manage a division of a medium/large department. Incumbents assume sole responsibility for a functional area(s) of service; coordinate and implement program planning; and define organizational structure, staffing requirements, resource allocation and identification of future resource needs. Incumbents interface with all managerial levels of city/county government and outside agencies, and serve as representatives of the division or department in meetings involving administrative systems, policies or procedures; and perform related duties as required.

Supervision Exercised: These Managers typically manage mid-level staff or line managers.

Essential Functions: Essential functions of the 0933 Manager V class include but are limited to the following:

1. Plans, monitors, evaluates, and supervises the operation of a division of a city department; coordinates the work of the various subdivisions; advises and consults with section managers; meets with appropriate staff to identify and resolve problems or conflicts; makes or recommends final decisions regarding policy, operations, and administrative procedures.

2. Develops, implements and maintains procedures, administrative monitoring practices and controls in order to obtain smooth and effective operation of a division; coordinates work activities of one division with other divisions within the department to prevent delays in required actions or to improve programs or services; assists in the identification, development and implementation of departmental goals, objectives, policies, and priorities; assists in the determination of resource allocation and levels of service according to established policies.

3. Receives and analyzes division and departmental reports; directs the preparation of monthly and annual reports; directs the gathering and analysis of information and reports necessary to document and evaluate processes.

4. Monitors the work of and coaches subordinates to improve performance.

5. Directs the allocation of resources to achieve timely outcomes and measurable goals within budget; adjusts plans and programs to meet emerging or new programs, while continuing to address major departmental priorities.

6. Monitors and evaluates the effectiveness and efficiency of the division's service delivery system, organizational structure, staffing levels, financial systems, and other internal operations; identifies and recommends alternative approaches or improvements; implements revisions, adjustments and changes.

7. May serve as liaison for the Department with a variety of other City/County staff, policy-making officials, and officials of outside agencies; explains and justifies Departmental or administrative procedures, policies, or programs; negotiates and resolves difficult and complex issues and problems.

8. May plan, develop, implement or direct major or complex projects or programs which span a number of the department's established sections or divisions; directs the research of complex, highly technical issues; analyzes alternative solutions or approaches; recommends most effective course of action.

9. Participates in budget development by providing detailed justification and persuasive arguments for proposals or initiatives. Oversees and administers division budget; directs and monitors expenditures in accordance with the approved budget; directs the preparation and maintenance of a wide variety of statistical, fiscal, and operational reports and studies; and provides executive management with an early warning and practical options to potential cost overruns.

Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications requirement by the final filing date unless otherwise noted.

  1. Current Category 16, 17, or 18 Exempt Employee in Class 0933 who has worked at least 2,080 hours in class 0933; AND
  2. Education: Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university; AND
  3. Experience: At least five (5) years of professional experience, of which three (3) years must include experience supervising professionals (except for public safety and trades).

Education Substitution: Additional experience may be substituted for the required degree on a year-for-year basis (up to a maximum of two (2) years). One (1) year is equivalent to thirty (30) semester units/forty-five (45) quarter units.

Experience Substitution: Possession of a Juris Doctorate (J.D.) or Master’s degree may substitute for one (1) year of the required professional experience.

Verification: Applicants may be required to submit verification of qualifying education and experience at any point during the recruitment and selection process.

Please review our articles on Employment Application and Minimum Qualifications and Verification of Experience and/or Education for considerations taken when reviewing applications.

Special Requirements: Special Qualifications including specialized knowledge, abilities, education, experience, or license may be established for individual positions.

Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of a completed City and County of San Francisco application. Applications completed improperly may be cause for ineligibility, disqualification or may lead to a lower score.

SELECTION PROCEDURES:

  1. Job Application - Applicants must fully complete the job application for this recruitment on the City and County of San Francisco's website. Information from resumes does not substitute for the information on the job application or preliminary questionnaire.
  2. Preliminary Questionnaire – Training and Experience Assessment (100% weight)- During the application process, candidates will be prompted to complete a Preliminary Questionnaire as part of the online employment process. Please answer the Preliminary Questionnaire carefully and thoroughly. It will serve as the Training and Experience Assessment for this recruitment and will be used to determine your eligibility for this recruitment as well as your score and rank on the eligible list. Qualified applicants will be ranked on the eligible list based on the length of their exempt City service (in Category 16, 17, and/or 18) in the 0933 Manager V class, along with any additional qualifying points (e.g., promotive status), as outlined in Civil Service Commission (CSC) rules. All work history will be verified using official City records, which will serve as the final authority in determining qualifying service.

Additional information

Eligible List/Score Report:

A confidential eligible list of qualifying candidates will be created and used for certification purposes only. A score report will be established, so applicants can view the ranks, final scores and number of eligible candidates. Applicant information, including names of applicants on the eligible list, shall not be made public unless required by law. However, an eligible list shall be made available for public inspection upon request once the eligible list is exhausted or expired and referrals resolved. The eligible list/score report resulting from this selection process is subject to change after adoption (e.g., because of appeals), as directed by the Human Resources Director or the Civil Service Commission.

The duration of the eligible list resulting from this examination process will be 6 months and may be extended with the approval of the Human Resources Director.

Certification Rule

The certification rule for this selection process will be Rule of the List.

title: Technical Product Manager - Platform
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.
Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission, serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
We are seeking a highly hands-on and Technical Product Manager to build and scale the core platform services that power Félix. These are the APIs, integrations, and real-time systems that every Félix product depends on to move money and data reliably between our users, our partners, and our internal teams. This role is for someone who thinks in systems, reusable components, and service contracts, not individual features.
You will own a set of platform capabilities end to end: partner and provider integrations, routing and orchestration logic, service reliability, and the data that tells us how the platform is performing. You will be a doer, not just a delegator, working side by side with engineering on architecture and tradeoffs while owning the metrics that matter.

What you’ll focus on
  • Define & Execute Platform Strategy – Work with Product and Engineering leadership to own the roadmap for core platform services, unifying external providers and internal systems into scalable, reusable building blocks that multiple product teams consume.
  • Own Core APIs & Integrations – Drive the design and evolution of the APIs and partner integrations at the heart of our infrastructure, including service contracts, versioning, error handling, and developer experience for internal consumers.
  • Build for Resilience – Partner with engineering on routing, fallback, and retry logic across multiple providers. Balance success rates, cost, latency, and reliability, and drive monitoring and automation that catch issues before users feel them.
  • Hands-On Data Analysis – Own platform health metrics and have a hands-on relationship with the data.
  • Scale New Capabilities – Launch new integrations, providers, and services as Félix expands into new products and markets, including real-time disbursement and money movement across borders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with Engineering, Finance, Operations, Fraud, and Compliance to turn complex requirements into clean platform solutions.
  • Partner Management – Evaluate, integrate, and manage relationships with external technology and financial partners, and communicate platform strategy and impact to executive leadership.

What you’ll bring
  • 5+ years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Deep technical fluency. You are comfortable discussing system design, API architecture, and service dependencies with engineers,
  • Experience owning platform-level metrics (reliability, latency, success rate, cost) and using them to drive improvements.
  • Experience integrating and managing third-party providers or partners via API.
  • Strong ownership and a bias toward action; comfortable working hands-on rather than delegating.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences, including executives and external partners.

These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $145,000 and $185,000 USD in Miami, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

Equal Opportunity Employer
At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Cabinet Maker / Millwork Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Cabinet Maker / Millwork Specialist to join a newly established millwork shop operated by a growing automotive group diversifying into new business opportunities.

This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled tradesperson to contribute their expertise in custom cabinetry and millwork while helping establish shop operations, production processes, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Fabricate, assemble, and finish custom cabinetry and millwork.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, shop drawings, and specifications.
  • Operate woodworking machinery, power tools, and precision equipment.
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and efficiency in all work.
  • Assist with shop set up, work flow development, and production standards.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and efficient work environment.

Qualifications:
  • Extensive experience manufacturing, assembling, and installing residential and commercial cabinetry, including complex custom projects.
  • Strong experience operating CNC routers, edge banders, table saws, and other woodworking machinery safely and independently.
  • Experience working with laminate, Formica, MDF, melamine, veneers, and other cabinetry materials.
  • Ability to handle site measurements, leveling, fitting, adjustments, and installation challenges.
  • Ability to read shop drawings, understand measurements, troubleshoot problems, and complete complex projects independently.
  • Physically capable of demanding workshop duties, including safely lifting and handling heavy materials.
  • Hardworking, energetic, patient, reliable, proactive, safety-conscious, and an excellent problem-solver.
  • Valid Class 5 driver's license and reliable transportation.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on craftsman who takes pride in quality workmanship and is ready to help build and grow a new millwork operation.

Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada.
