title: Director of Operations
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Operations leads the operational and financial performance of EEIC's EPC projects and service divisions (Maintenance Contracts and Secondment Services), owning the Operations P&L, budgets, forecasts, OPEX, gross profit, cash flow and resources, and ensuring delivery to contract, schedule, HSE, quality and profit targets.

The role protects and improves margins through robust budgeting, monitoring, corrective action, cost optimisation and variation recovery, ensuring forecasts are backed by validated progress, realistic cost-to-complete and quantified risks. It resolves issues within delegated authority and escalates material matters to the General Manager with impact and recommendations.

Leading the Head of Projects, Engineering Manager and Head of Division, and through them Project Managers and teams, the role strengthens leadership, governance and execution standards. It requires a commercially astute EPC professional with contractor-side experience managing multiple projects across planning, engineering, procurement, construction, subcontracting and clients

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial, Budget & P&L Management

  • Own the financial performance and P&L of the Operations Department, including the EPC project portfolio and operational service divisions, ensuring achievement of approved revenue, gross profit and profitability targets, and provide the General Manager with timely visibility of material financial deviations, risks and opportunities.
  • Lead preparation of the annual Operations Department budget (revenue, gross profit, OPEX, manpower and other cost assumptions), provide reliable operational inputs to the General Manager and Finance for business planning, and control OPEX within approved budgets.
  • Lead and challenge individual project budgets following award, ensuring they reflect the approved commercial baseline, execution strategy, resources, procurement and subcontracting strategy, risks and expected profitability, and endorse budgets and revisions in accordance with the Delegation of Authority.
  • Review project P&Ls regularly – revenue, actual and committed costs, accruals, cost-to-complete, EAC, gross profit, margin and cash flow – and hold Head of Projects and Project Managers accountable for budget ownership and financial performance.
  • Ensure accurate monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts of revenue, cost, GP and cash flow, supported by validated progress, realistic cost-to-complete, contractual entitlements, committed costs and quantified risks and opportunities.
  • Identify margin erosion and cost overruns early, establish root causes and drive corrective action, and lead initiatives to protect and improve gross profit – through cost optimisation, productivity, procurement savings, variation recovery and improved execution methods – without compromising HSE, quality, contractual or client requirements.
  • Monitor billing, certification, unbilled revenue, receivables and cash collection in coordination with Commercial and Finance, ensuring alignment with physical progress and revenue recognition.
  • Ensure operational managers own and validate their financial assumptions, delivery commitments and recovery plans. Finance supports reporting and validation; the Director of Operations remains accountable for operational forecasts and performance commitments.

Project Delivery & Operational Management

  • Lead and oversee the execution of EEIC's EPC project portfolio from award through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and close-out, in accordance with contractual requirements, approved budgets, baseline schedules, HSE and quality standards.
  • Oversee the Maintenance Contracts and Secondment Services divisions, ensuring service levels, manpower utilisation, contract renewals and divisional profitability meet approved targets.
  • Ensure appropriate execution strategies, mobilization plans and project management structures are established for newly awarded projects.
  • Conduct structured project performance reviews covering progress, schedule, cost, profitability, cash flow, engineering, procurement, construction, subcontracting, resources, commercial matters and key risks, maintaining portfolio-level visibility of status, milestones and priorities.
  • Identify underperforming projects early and lead the development and implementation of corrective action and recovery plans.
  • Ensure effective coordination between Projects, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Planning & Project Controls, Commercial, Finance, HSE and Quality functions.
  • Optimize manpower, equipment and other resources across the project portfolio according to operational priorities.
  • Provide visible HSE leadership across all projects and service sites, ensuring HSE plans, resources and performance meet company and client (including ADNOC) requirements.
  • Provide timely, accurate reporting to the General Manager and escalate material operational, financial, contractual and client risks with quantified impact, actions taken and clear recommendations, after review and challenge through the management hierarchy.
  • Take ownership of resolving operational matters within delegated authority, ensuring that the Head of Projects, Head of Division and Project Managers remain accountable for their respective responsibilities. Escalate matters requiring executive intervention in a timely manner, without unnecessarily transferring routine operational management responsibilities to the General Manager.

Planning, Project Controls & EPC Oversight

  • Oversee, through the Head of Project Controls and Head of Projects, the planning and project controls framework, ensuring baseline programmes, progress measurement and reporting are consistently applied across all projects.
  • Review portfolio-level schedule performance, critical-path risks and key milestones through regular operational reviews, challenging delays, unrealistic forecasts and deviations from approved plans.
  • Review, endorse and drive the implementation of recovery and acceleration strategies for projects at risk, ensuring that required resources, cost implications, contractual considerations and management support are adequately assessed, with approvals obtained in accordance with the company's Delegation of Authority.
  • Ensure effective integration of engineering, procurement and construction across the portfolio, intervening to resolve critical interface issues that threaten construction progress or project completion.
  • Intervene where key subcontractor or supplier performance threatens project objectives, and make strategic decisions on subcontracting, resource deployment and self-performance.
  • Hold project leadership accountable for construction productivity and resource utilization, using project controls data to drive operational decisions.

Commercial, Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Hold Head of Projects and Project Managers accountable for timely identification, notification and substantiation of variations, change orders, claims and EOTs, working with the Contracts function, which owns contractual entitlement and formal correspondence.
  • Support resolution of major subcontractor, supplier and commercial matters affecting project performance.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with senior client representatives, consultants, main contractors and key stakeholders, and represent EEIC in senior-level project and client meetings.
  • Act as the senior operational escalation point for critical project matters and support Head of Projects, Project Managers in resolving complex operational, contractual and stakeholder issues.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of clients e.g. ADNOC and other customers / main contractors’ requirements, procedures, expectations and project delivery standards.
  • Proactively lead senior-level operational and commercial engagement with clients to resolve material variations, extensions of time, claims, payment certifications and other outstanding matters affecting project profitability, delivery or cash flow, in coordination with the Commercial and Contracts functions.

People Leadership, Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead, coach and develop the Head of Projects, Engineering Manager, Project Managers, Head of Divisions and other senior project personnel, evaluating performance, addressing capability gaps and establishing clear accountability and a performance-driven culture.
  • Support recruitment of key project personnel, develop succession plans and strengthen EEIC's project management capability to execute progressively larger and more complex EPC projects.
  • Establish and maintain consistent project management standards, controls and governance across the project portfolio.
  • Ensure project risks are identified, assessed, mitigated and escalated appropriately.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, contractual obligations, HSE requirements, quality standards and applicable client procedures.
  • Promote lessons learned, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives across projects.
  • Support the General Manager in annual operational planning and resource planning.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • PMP or equivalent recognised project-management certification is preferred.
  • Postgraduate qualifications in Project Management, Engineering Management or Business Administration is an advantage.

Experience Requirements:

  • Minimum 15 years of experience in EPC project execution within the oil & gas, energy, petrochemical or related industries.
  • Significant contractor-side EPC experience is essential.
  • Demonstrated experience as an Operations Director, Project Director, Senior Project Manager or equivalent senior project leadership role.
  • Proven experience managing complex EPC projects through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and close-out.
  • Proven experience concurrently leading multiple EPC projects and Project Managers, with accountability for consolidated operational and financial performance across a project portfolio.
  • HSE leadership compliance and ability to work in multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience preparing and managing annual operational budgets and OPEX is preferred.
  • Significant GCC and UAE project experience preferred.
  • Previous ADNOC / ADNOC Group project experience (highly preferred).
  • Experience of both onshore and offshore oil & gas projects preferred.

Skills & Professional Requirements:

  • Demonstrated responsibility for project P&L, project budgeting, cost control, forecasting and profitability improvement.
  • Proven ability to manage project financial performance including revenue, GP, EAC, cost-to-complete, cash flow and working capital.
  • Strong knowledge of project controls, planning, procurement, subcontracting, construction and commissioning.
  • Sound commercial and contractual experience, including variations, claims, extensions of time and contractual risk management.
  • Strong track record of client engagement and management of multidisciplinary project teams.

Attributes and Behaviours:

  • Coaches, mentors and empowers others to make decisions within established parameters.
  • Is a champion and role model for ethical behaviour and compliance with applicable laws and policies.
  • Excellent personality with strong communication, interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Strong computer skills including knowledge of Microsoft office products, specifically Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

title: Mech and Robotics Tech
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Mechatronics & Robotics Technician - JLL

What this job involves:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will have the opportunity to mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures

  • Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation

  • Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more

  • Maintain a positive working relationship across all the Operations facility

  • Track and store department inventory

  • Move up to 49lbs as well as stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, with or without reasonable accommodation

  • Possible travel up to 20% at a minimum.

Required Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends, nights and/or holidays

  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment

  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus in the Mechanical or Electrical field

  • 2+ years of experience with automated conveyor systems and controls

  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading

  • 1+ year of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles

  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards

  • Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)

  • Experience with robotic or electromechanical operation and maintenance

  • Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions

Physical Demands

  • Repetitive bending, crouching, kneeling, reaching, twisting, sitting, standing, and walking

  • Lifting parts and tools weighing on average 20 pounds, occasionally weighing up to 49 pounds

  • Dexterity in eye/hand coordination, feet (foot pedals) manual (picking, pinching, holding, grasping), and wrist motion (repetitive flexion/rotation)

  • Working conditions may include small spaces, dust, fumes/odors, hot/cold temperatures, inside/outside noise, vibration, standing on concrete for long hours and wet or uneven surfaces

  • Standing/walking on concrete surfaces for 10+ hour shifts

  • Working at heights (as stated previously)

  • Pushing/pulling wheeled equipment and carts up to 100+ pounds

  • Maneuvering awkward or bulky equipment parts

  • Working in cramped positions under/behind machinery

title: Facility Executive
description:

title: Technical Product Manager - Payments
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
﻿
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission, serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
We are seeking a highly hands-on and technical Product Manager to lead the building and scaling of our next-generation payments platform, the infrastructure that moves money from the moment a customer funds a payment to the moment it settles with our banking partners. This role requires a unique blend of deep technical depth, platform-level strategic thinking, and a resourceful, bias-for-action mindset to build the payments platform that powers multiple Félix products requiring money movement, while improving conversion, authorization rates, and unit economics.
You will own our payment orchestration layer and the ecosystem around it: multiple payment processors, banking and settlement partners, tokenization, and reconciliation. You will be a doer, not just a delegator, working closely with engineering to build sophisticated real-time systems while owning critical business metrics like authorization rate, processing cost, and GMV. This is a role for a builder who thrives on extreme ownership in a high-growth, ambiguous environment.

What you'll focus on
  • Define & Execute Payments Product Strategy – Work with Product and Engineering leadership to develop and own the payments roadmap, focused on unifying our processors, banking partners, and payment methods into a single, scalable orchestration platform for pay-ins, routing, and settlement. This requires a platform-first, reusable-component mindset.
  • Own the Payment Orchestrator – Drive the evolution of our in-house orchestrator and its rules engine: intelligent routing across processors, and fallback and resilience logic. Balance authorization rates, cost per transaction, and reliability. Own reconciliation and settlement health across processors and banking partners, driving toward automation.
  • Hands-On Data Analysis & Experimentation – Own payment metrics and have a hands-on relationship with the data. You must be able to navigate complex dashboards, run simple to medium-complexity SQL queries to validate hypotheses, and partner with Data Analysts and Engineers to drive improvements in conversion, acceptance, and authorization.
  • Expand Payment Methods & Rails – Partner directly with engineering to design, build, and launch payment methods and integrations across cards, wallets, ACH, cash, and additional processors and settlement banks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with Engineering, Finance (reconciliation, treasury, revenue recognition), and Operations (payment ops, disputes) to develop scalable solutions.
  • Fraud Coordination – Partner with Fraud to monitor fraud performance by payment method and supply the data needed for fraud checkpoints.
  • Partner & BD Coordination – Partner with Business Development on processor and banking partner negotiations.
  • Stakeholder & Partner Management – Communicate payments strategy and impact to executive leadership, and manage relationships with payment processors, acquiring and banking partners, and card networks.

What you'll bring
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on payments, ideally in a fast-paced growth environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Proven technical fluency & resourcefulness. Ability to work with engineering teams on API-based payments solutions, demonstrated ability to run simple SQL queries, and a clear understanding of data pipelines and system resilience (e.g. timeouts, fallbacks, service dependencies).
  • Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem (payment orchestration, processors/PSPs, acquiring and banking partners, card networks, authorization and settlement flows, tokenization, and reconciliation), or a track record of rapidly acquiring deep domain knowledge in a new technical area.
  • Experience owning payment performance metrics (authorization rate, conversion, processing cost, GMV) and using them to drive product improvements.
  • Experience working with payment processors and orchestration, and familiarity with alternative rails (ACH, BNPL, wallets, stablecoins) is a strong plus.
  • Strong ownership and a bias towards action; comfortable working hands-on rather than delegating.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, especially with fraud, finance, compliance, and exec teams, as well as external partners.
  • Passion for fintech and digital finance innovation.
  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $170,000 and $220,000 USD in New York, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

title: Sustainability and Certification Engineer
description:
At Forte Opening Solutions, we don't just manufacture doors; we create pathways to possibilities. We empower our employees to shape the future of our industry. Join a team where craftsmanship meets cutting-edge technology, and where your ideas can open new doors. Together, we build not just products, but a culture of excellence and collaboration.

We are looking for a driven and detail-oriented Sustainability & Certification Engineer to own our environmental and product certification programs across our wood door manufacturing facilities. This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of sustainability compliance, product integrity, and process coordination. If you thrive on managing complex programs, keeping multiple certifications audit-ready, and driving process efficiency across teams — this role is for you.

What You'll Do


Sustainability & Green Building Standards
• Serve as our internal subject matter expert on LEED v4, v4.1, and v5, as well as alternative green building standards (WELL, BREEAM, Living Building Challenge, Green Globes), advising internal teams and customers on product compliance and credit documentation.

FSC Chain of Custody
• Serve as the internal subject matter expert for FSC Chain of Custody certification, providing guidance and responding to customer inquiries. Partner closely with Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) and 3rd party consultants to support certification compliance, audit preparation, and recertification across all wood door manufacturing facilities.

Environmental & Product Certifications
• Own the full certification lifecycle for Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), Health Product Declarations (HPDs), and Indoor Advantage Gold certificates — from initial issuance through renewal and recertification.
• Maintain a master certification calendar and coordinate quarterly reporting submissions.
• Partner with Accounts Payable to ensure all invoices from certification bodies and agencies are processed accurately and on time.

Technical Knowledge Center (TKC) Administration
• Administer the TKC platform, facilitate monthly meetings, capture technical data, and distribute reporting summaries to leadership.

Product Change Request (PCR) Process
• Run the PCR process end-to-end: facilitate meetings, manage Smartsheet workflows, assign tasks to the appropriate team members, and ensure product changes that affect certifications trigger the proper review actions.

Audit & Travel
• Travel to plant locations to support internal and third-party audits, deliver training, and verify certification compliance (up to 25% travel).

title: Senior Product Manager (Distribution Channels)
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

Kpler's customers access our data through a range of distribution channels, including CloudDB, our Excel add-in, sFTP and S3, Kafka feeds and data-sharing platforms such as Snowflake. Ensuring our data reaches customers reliably, efficiently and seamlessly is essential to delivering the full value of Kpler's intelligence.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager – Distribution Channels to own and develop these shared capabilities within our Data Platform tribe. You will define the product vision and 12-month roadmap, deliver and automate new distribution channels, ensure existing channels remain reliable and cost-efficient, and drive adoption across Kpler's product teams.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the intersection of data, product, engineering and partnerships. You will work closely with teams across Kpler to build scalable platform capabilities that support our products and the customers who depend on them.

Responsibilities

  • Own the platform distribution channels: Define the vision and 12-month roadmap for Kpler's distribution channels, including CloudDB, Excel add-in, sFTP/S3, Kafka, data sharing, marketplaces and the analytics platform as an internal channel. Drive the development of features and content across these channels.
  • Identify growth opportunities: Assess opportunities across the data ecosystem, evaluating growth potential through existing and new channels, additional data content and potential providers or solutions. Use data and stakeholder feedback to validate and prioritise opportunities.
  • Drive platform discovery: Engage with teams across Kpler to understand their requirements, evaluate opportunities and prioritise shared capabilities that deliver value across multiple product teams.
  • Own backlog and delivery: Lead the delivery of new, automated customer-facing and internal distribution channels. Provide clear direction to your product and engineering teams, manage and prioritise the backlog in Jira and Productboard, and facilitate effective refinement and grooming.
  • Drive adoption: Increase adoption of distribution channels across Kpler's product teams and tribes. Expand the content available through these channels while supporting teams and enabling them to own their corresponding data pipelines.
  • Improve reliability and efficiency: Partner with Engineering Managers and engineers to deliver against the roadmap, maintain reliable distribution channels and manage costs effectively. Identify opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.
  • Define and measure success: Establish success metrics for each channel, monitor performance and adoption, and develop action plans to drive continuous improvement.
  • Communicate vision and progress: Act as a key point of contact for the Data Ecosystem crew alongside the Engineering Manager, communicating the product vision, roadmap and priorities to internal stakeholders. Support customer-facing teams where required.
  • Manage partnerships: Assess and collaborate with external providers and partners to identify opportunities that strengthen Kpler's data distribution ecosystem.

Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years' experience in Product Management, including at least 3 years managing and delivering shared or platform products that require alignment and adoption across multiple internal teams.
  • Experience developing and delivering data distribution or data delivery products, such as file transfer, streaming, APIs, data warehouses or data-sharing solutions.
  • Strong product management capabilities, including discovery, defining product vision, building roadmaps and prioritising delivery based on customer and business needs.
  • Strong understanding of data products, data pipelines and streaming or event-driven systems.
  • Experience working with Agile and Scrum methodologies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning and delivery management, with proficiency in tools such as Jira.
  • Comfortable writing SQL against data warehouses such as Snowflake to measure adoption, cost and data quality, including account usage and query history.
  • Familiarity with data-sharing technologies and open formats, including Snowflake Data Shares and Marketplace, Iceberg and Delta Sharing, and data consumers such as Databricks and ClickHouse.
  • Understanding of observability, telemetry, dashboards and alerting tools such as Datadog or Costory, with the ability to define and measure reliability across distribution channels.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to produce clear assessments and roadmap documentation, influence stakeholders and present effectively to both internal and external audiences.
  • Comfortable using AI assistants and agents with internal data sources to accelerate analysis, documentation and product backlog activities.
  • Collaborative and customer-focused, with the ability to understand stakeholder challenges, build alignment and drive solutions across teams.
  • Strong ownership and problem-solving skills, with a data-led approach to decision-making and the confidence to prioritise effectively, manage constraints and challenge assumptions.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of maritime, commodities or energy data.
  • Experience working with data-sharing ecosystems and external partners, such as Snowflake.
  • Exposure to cloud cost management and FinOps.
  • Experience with B2B data or market-intelligence products sold to enterprise customers.
  • Experience managing vendor and partner relationships, including commercial and marketplace agreements.
We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?

title: Cyber Security Specialist – Associate (Cybersecurity)
description:
About Agile Defense
At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Requisition #: 2008
Job Title: Cyber Security Specialist – Associate (Cybersecurity)
Location: Fort Huachuca, AZ
Clearance Level: Secret, Must Have Clearance to Start
Required Certification(s): CompTIA Security+ CE, Cloud+, Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional, GIAC Security Essentials, Systems Security Certified Practitioner

Job Description

  • Responsible for the day to day operations of conducting routine IA Audits on all Information Systems (IS) to ensure the appropriate IA security controls have been applied and maintained
  • Evaluate IS for compliance in accordance with Risk Management Framework (RMF) 800-53 Controls and Special Directives
  • Assist with the continuous monitoring of RMF packages within eMASS (POA&Ms, Test Results, Risk Assessments, etc.)
  • Record and/or prepare artifacts associated with the audit to ensure a repository for all system RMF documentation is kept current
  • Provide Certification and Accreditation (C&A) support in the development of security and contingency plans by conducting risk and vulnerability assessments
  • Use the 800 Series NIST Special Publications as reference for C&A, system security plans, risk assessment, and other security requirements
  • Create, edit, and review organization and team level documentation for clarity and accuracy and assist with development of security related TTPs, SOPs, processes, plans, or diagrams
  • Use automated security scanning tools (SCAP, ACAS, Tychon, etc.) to identify potential vulnerabilities
  • Analyze and report findings to technical teams and leadership for appropriate tracking and mitigation
  • Research RFIs from technical teams regarding DISA STIG checklists, and DOD/Army regulations
  • Explain requirements to systems administrators in detail to ensure proper understanding and clarity
  • Review proposed courses of action from technical teams and recommend the most secure option while balancing operations and/or mission requirements
  • Assist in the identification, tracking and remediation of security risks discovered on information systems
  • Prepare and deliver detailed written reports and oral presentations to the Security Manger, Information Assurance Manager and other senior leaders or staff within the organization
  • Coordinate with both internal and external entities to improve established processes and procedures; ensuring efficient execution of all analysis, tracking, mitigation and reporting requirements
  • Coordinate directly with cross functional teams and management to resolve all compliance issues
  • Support and/or lead special projects as required
  • Complete other duties as assigned by management

Education and Background

Bachelor degree, and 4-5 years of experience, or equivalent relevant work experience
CompTIA Security+ CE, Cloud+, Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional, GIAC Security Essentials, Systems Security Certified Practitioner

Required Skills

• Active DoD Secret clearance
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Knowledge of network specific DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides and checklists
• Knowledge of asset scanning
• Experience performing audits within a DoD organization
• Experience with Risk Management Framework (RMF) and vulnerability management

Preferred Skills

• Knowledge of Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS)
• Knowledge of Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS), and Tychon Vulnerability scanning and reporting
• Knowledge of ePolicy Orchestrator (ePO) and Continuous Monitoring and Risk Scoring (CMRS)

Working Conditions

  • 100% on-site
  • Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods of time
  • Fine motor skills, with the ability to operate keyboards, phones, and controls
Our Core Values
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. title: Clinical Investigator Payment Associate
description:
Internal Job Description

Position Summary

The Payment Associate supports accurate and timely clinical site payments across the APAC portfolio. The role is responsible for defined payment processing, documentation review, reconciliation, issue follow-up, and communication activities using established procedures and controls. The position handles routine to moderately complex work with regular guidance and escalates non-routine, high-risk, or ambiguous matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Process assigned payments and invoices using established procedures, templates, and quality checks.
  • Perform routine contract-to-payment reviews, validate supporting documentation, and identify missing or inconsistent information.
  • Reconcile assigned payment transactions and vendor reports; investigate standard exceptions and escalate complex issues.
  • Communicate clearly with sites, vendors, and internal partners on payment status, documentation needs, and next steps using approved guidance.
  • Maintain assigned study and site trackers, meet service timelines, and provide accurate status updates.
  • Support purchase requisition and purchase order activities and coordinate with Accounts Payable under manager or senior associate guidance.
  • Contribute to process improvement by documenting recurring issues and suggesting practical improvements.
  • Work with regular guidance on defined assignments; use sound judgment to determine when escalation is required.
  • Support accurate setup, review, execution, and reconciliation of investigator grant and clinical site payments in accordance with executed Clinical Trial Agreements, approved budgets, company procedures, and country requirements.
  • Work with investigative sites, Clinical Operations, Clinical Site Contracts, Budget Development, Finance, Accounts Payable, and external payment vendors to resolve payment questions and discrepancies.
  • Maintain complete and audit-ready payment records, trackers, supporting documentation, and system data throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Use applicable systems and tools, which may include ClinRun, Greenphire, Oracle CTMS, Veeva, SAP, Ariba, Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Teams, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
  • Monitor invoices, payment status, aging items, and outstanding actions; escalate risks and delays according to established procedures.
  • Protect confidential information and follow company controls, segregation-of-duties requirements, and applicable financial and compliance procedures.

Regional Responsibilities

  • Apply country-specific payment, tax or invoice-documentation, banking, and communication requirements across assigned APAC countries.
  • Coordinate effectively across APAC time zones and culturally diverse site and stakeholder groups.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Typically 2+ years of relevant experience in clinical research, pharmaceutical operations, clinical site payments, accounts payable, finance, or investigator grants.
  • Working knowledge of clinical trial operations, site contracts, invoices, purchase orders, or payment processes.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, follow defined controls, and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Role purpose: The Workplace Change Manager will establish and lead an APAC Workplace Change Management Center of Excellence (CoE) to standardize and enhance change enablement across APAC site moves. The objective of this role is to create a consistent experience, reduce duplicated effort, and clarify change ownership across projects. This role will lead a CoE that provides structure, methodology, templates, quality control, and oversight, while project and delivery teams execute implementation. The CoE will operate through two parallel workstreams:

  • Build a controlled library of standardized change collateral within the first 90 days.
  • Deliver change support mapped to each site’s location, timeline, resource requirements, and language needs.

At JLL, we are committed to helping our people achieve their ambitions by enabling them to explore new opportunities, build expertise, create long-term careers, and succeed through inclusion. We value what makes each of us unique and help our people find a place where they can belong.

The Workplace Change Manager is accountable for the CoE methodology, governance, and execution support across six change management stage gates and tier-based engagement. The role will establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering, intake, stage gate governance, and quality control processes. It will also drive the creation and maintenance of a controlled collateral library and leadership cascade materials, while supporting project teams with scalable, high-quality change delivery across multiple locations and languages. This role requires a structured and process-minded leader who can standardize effectively without slowing delivery, and who can coach and enable local teams while maintaining strong quality oversight.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish the APAC change framework, including T1-T4 tiering and the six-gate methodology, with clear intake, tiering, gate approvals, and quality control.
  • Build and maintain the collateral library and leadership cascade pack by rebuilding existing APAC assets into a controlled library containing templates, worked examples, completion instructions, readiness checklists, and a lessons learned bank with quarterly updates.
  • Deliver change support aligned to the project pipeline, including engagement planning, content production, cascade and readiness activities, runbook execution, hypercare, handover, and local translation and quality assurance.

title: Technical Product Manager - Payments
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
﻿
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.

Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission, serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
We are seeking a highly hands-on and technical Product Manager to lead the building and scaling of our next-generation payments platform, the infrastructure that moves money from the moment a customer funds a payment to the moment it settles with our banking partners. This role requires a unique blend of deep technical depth, platform-level strategic thinking, and a resourceful, bias-for-action mindset to build the payments platform that powers multiple Félix products requiring money movement, while improving conversion, authorization rates, and unit economics.
You will own our payment orchestration layer and the ecosystem around it: multiple payment processors, banking and settlement partners, tokenization, and reconciliation. You will be a doer, not just a delegator, working closely with engineering to build sophisticated real-time systems while owning critical business metrics like authorization rate, processing cost, and GMV. This is a role for a builder who thrives on extreme ownership in a high-growth, ambiguous environment.

What you'll focus on
  • Define & Execute Payments Product Strategy – Work with Product and Engineering leadership to develop and own the payments roadmap, focused on unifying our processors, banking partners, and payment methods into a single, scalable orchestration platform for pay-ins, routing, and settlement. This requires a platform-first, reusable-component mindset.
  • Own the Payment Orchestrator – Drive the evolution of our in-house orchestrator and its rules engine: intelligent routing across processors, and fallback and resilience logic. Balance authorization rates, cost per transaction, and reliability. Own reconciliation and settlement health across processors and banking partners, driving toward automation.
  • Hands-On Data Analysis & Experimentation – Own payment metrics and have a hands-on relationship with the data. You must be able to navigate complex dashboards, run simple to medium-complexity SQL queries to validate hypotheses, and partner with Data Analysts and Engineers to drive improvements in conversion, acceptance, and authorization.
  • Expand Payment Methods & Rails – Partner directly with engineering to design, build, and launch payment methods and integrations across cards, wallets, ACH, cash, and additional processors and settlement banks.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Work closely with Engineering, Finance (reconciliation, treasury, revenue recognition), and Operations (payment ops, disputes) to develop scalable solutions.
  • Fraud Coordination – Partner with Fraud to monitor fraud performance by payment method and supply the data needed for fraud checkpoints.
  • Partner & BD Coordination – Partner with Business Development on processor and banking partner negotiations.
  • Stakeholder & Partner Management – Communicate payments strategy and impact to executive leadership, and manage relationships with payment processors, acquiring and banking partners, and card networks.

What you'll bring
  • 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on payments, ideally in a fast-paced growth environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Proven technical fluency & resourcefulness. Ability to work with engineering teams on API-based payments solutions, demonstrated ability to run simple SQL queries, and a clear understanding of data pipelines and system resilience (e.g. timeouts, fallbacks, service dependencies).
  • Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem (payment orchestration, processors/PSPs, acquiring and banking partners, card networks, authorization and settlement flows, tokenization, and reconciliation), or a track record of rapidly acquiring deep domain knowledge in a new technical area.
  • Experience owning payment performance metrics (authorization rate, conversion, processing cost, GMV) and using them to drive product improvements.
  • Experience working with payment processors and orchestration, and familiarity with alternative rails (ACH, BNPL, wallets, stablecoins) is a strong plus.
  • Strong ownership and a bias towards action; comfortable working hands-on rather than delegating.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, especially with fraud, finance, compliance, and exec teams, as well as external partners.
  • Passion for fintech and digital finance innovation.
  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $145,000 and $185,000 USD in Miami, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

Equal Opportunity Employer
At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy.

title: Manager, Quality Assurance
description:
At Kabam, we’re constantly raising the bar of excellence in free-to-play gaming. We hire for passion and diversity so that we can triumph in our collective skill. Our teams are made up of a fusion of personalities and interests bound together by a collaborative nature, fun-loving culture, and a drive to do what it takes to make great games. And this is where you come in…
The key function of the Manager, Quality Assurance is to serve as a strategic QA leader across multiple QA teams within the department. They collaborate with Senior QA leadership, development, and production to actively champion change and drive QA transformation to meet departmental goals and objectives. The Manager, Quality Assurance leverages data-driven insights to make informed decisions, challenging current processes and improving them. They play a leadership role within the team by developing QA leaders and fostering a knowledge-sharing and continuous innovation environment.
This role is a full-time, on-site position based 5 days a week at our Downtown Vancouver studio.

In this role, you can expect to:

Key Accountabilities
Team Management and Direction:
  • Oversee multiple QA teams within the department, providing clear direction, priorities, and strategic guidance to QA leads and analysts in each group.
  • Lead and coach QA Leads to manage their day-to-day teams with autonomy, fostering a high-performance culture grounded in a growth mindset.
  • Proactively evaluate and analyze team structures, skill sets, and operational gaps, restructuring coverage and roles to support evolving studio needs.
Coordination with Senior QA & Development Leadership:
  • Coordinate with the Senior QA leadership group to drive and improve the Certification and QA Engineering teams, ensuring alignment with department goals and studio objectives.
  • Act as an embedded strategic partner to Development, Production, and Studio Leadership, moving QA from reactive execution to an upstream quality partnership.
  • Serve as a change management champion across the department, challenging current processes, modernizing QA workflows, and adopting new tools and methodologies.
Task Coordination and Prioritization:
  • Collaborate with Production, Engineering, and Project QA Leads to determine task priorities for submitting builds to First Party partners.
  • Drive the creation, alignment, and execution of a Test Plan/Schedule for the multiple QA teams, ensuring effective coordination and updates for each project.
Certification and Automation Testing:
  • Take ownership of the Certification verification strategy of deliverables, ensuring compliance with industry standards and requirements.
  • Oversee and own Automation testing and validation of deliverables, ensuring effective test coverage and accuracy of results.
Resource Allocation and Budget Management:
  • Assess and forecast staffing to ensure each project receives the appropriate level of staffing and testing coverage from internal QA.
  • Build, forecast, and manage departmental and project QA operational budgets in collaboration with Production, Senior Leadership, and Finance.
  • Oversee and assess external vendor strategy, balancing cost with meeting targets.
Communication, Reporting, and Data-Driven Decision Making:
  • Communicate project status, progress, and high level trends regularly to senior leadership.
  • Architect and monitor key quality metrics to translate complex technical risks into actionable, data-backed business insights.
Risk Management:
  • Proactively identify and manage organizational and delivery risks related to, identifying potential issues and implementing mitigation strategies.
  • Partner directly with other production leads to identify and address recurring issues, driving structural solutions.
Career Development and Department Growth:
  • Drive the career development and progression of individual QA Analysts, providing guidance, feedback, and opportunities for growth.
  • Conduct regular performance and gap analyses across the team to provide targeted coaching and actionable feedback.
Quality Advocacy:
  • Promote a "quality first" approach to decision-making, emphasizing the importance of performance and player experience.
  • Champion continuous improvement, innovation, and high quality standards.
KPI Management:
  • Drive the assigned project to hit Key Performance Indicator (KPI) targets across teams, such as defect closure rate, test coverage, or release stability by holding teams accountable for quality benchmarks.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze relevant metrics to ensure project success and drive continuous improvement.
Coaching and Mentoring Team members:
  • Direct, develop, and mentor QA Leaders on best practices.
  • Create an open, knowledge-sharing environment where continuous learning and peer mentorship is encouraged.

To be successful in this role, your background includes:

  • High school diploma.
  • 8+ years of related game testing experience in a similar capacity, preferably for mobile games.
  • 4+ years in a QA leadership capacity.
  • Technical Abilities: Advanced understanding of Game Design.
  • Familiarity with both Android and Apple devices.
  • Strong aptitude to learn quickly and effectively.

Our success is due to the hard work of our people. We share our success with our people through flexible benefits and reward programs, sweet swag, snacks, and more. Here’s a look at some of the support we provide our people:

  • Extended Health Coverage: effective day one, no waiting period! Our benefits cover health, dental, life, disability, and extended paramedical services such as vision care, mental health practitioners, massage, physiotherapy, acupuncture, and much more.
  • DEIB Benefits: DEIB is important to us and to our people - that’s why our benefits include gender-affirming care, fertility care, and other hormonal treatments and drugs.
  • Flexible Spending Accounts: our benefits are built on a flex credit model, so you’re able to choose the coverage levels that are right for you, and allocate the rest to a group RRSP/TFSA, Health Spending account, and/or Personal Spending Account.
  • RRSP Matching: everyone retires eventually, and we help our people save for their futures with a contribution matching program once you reach 90 days with us.
  • Commuter Benefit: we believe in the power of in-person collaboration, and want to support you in making it work for you! We provide a flexible, monthly cash allowance to help cover the costs of transit, parking, or even personal logistics like childcare and pet care.
  • PTO and Parental Leave: we offer paid parental leave, flexible paid time off, paid time off for volunteering, sick leave, and holiday closures.
  • Employee and Family Assistance Program: this program provides crisis management support, immediate mental health care, and generalized support for emotional, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Telus Virtual Health: we provide increased access to remote healthcare providers for prescription refills or referrals from the comfort of your home.
  • Learning and growth: We encourage people to grow both personally and professionally, and support this through regular lunch & learns and an education stipend.
  • Pay transparency: We share with employees the pay range their role falls within and clear career maps to determine how they can grow within their role or level-up to a promotion.
  • Cool spaces: Our offices are in Vancouver, Montreal, Los Angeles, and San Francisco. Whether it’s summers on the rooftop patio in Downtown Vancouver, or watching the fireworks in Montreal’s South Shore - we want our people to feel like their time spent in office is worthwhile!
  • Giving back: Kabammers have a dedicated paid day off every year to volunteer to a cause close to their hearts. Some teams even band together for group volunteer days off-site!
Excited by this opportunity? Kabam is dedicated to growing our diverse and inclusive workforce, so if your past experience doesn’t perfectly match the listed requirements we encourage you to apply anyways - you could be a great fit for this or other positions.

We invite you to apply now and start the conversation with us. Together, we can create and support some of the best games ever made and entertain the world!

Kabam is a world leader in developing entertaining, immersive, and highly social multiplayer games, bringing high-quality graphics, next-generation technology, and revolutionary gameplay to players around the world.

Job Description

Job Title: Plan Deconversion Specialist

Department: Implementation FLSA Status: Non-Exempt Job Status: FT

Reports To: Manager, Plan Conversions

Positions Supervised: n/a Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:30 am - 5:00 pm

Position Summary

The Plan Deconversion Specialist supports the technical and operational execution of retirement plan exits, deconversions, outgoing transfers, plan terminations, and related asset and record movement activities. This role coordinates and completes assigned conversion-out activities while maintaining accurate records, compliant processing, clear communication, and timely case completion. The position serves as a key point of coordination among clients, successor providers, relationship owners, and internal operational teams by maintaining current case requirements, milestones, risks, status updates, and supporting documentation. Through effective case management, project coordination, and cross-functional collaboration, the Plan Deconversion Specialist helps deliver an orderly transition of plan records and assets from Slavic401k to the receiving provider.

Essential Functions

· Review plan documents, deconversion requests, participant records, census information, loans, notices, transfer instructions, successor-provider requirements, and plan-level considerations.

· Coordinate assigned outgoing plan transfers, deconversions, plan exits, and related asset and record movement activities using established procedures and timelines.

· Confirm the scope and type of exit, required deliverables, responsible parties, key dependencies, and target transfer dates.

· Identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant information and escalate concerns as appropriate.

· Research discrepancies and assist with resolving participant record, loan, liquidation, asset, documentation, and transfer-readiness concerns.

· Manage assigned conversion-out cases and support more complex exits as directed by leadership or senior team members.

· Track milestones, blackout periods, notice requirements, liquidation activity, outgoing files, transfer instructions, documentation, and issue resolution.

· Maintain accurate and current case information, including requirements, risks, documentation requests, status updates, owner assignments, and next steps.

· Prepare, coordinate, and validate outgoing participant records, plan data, reports, and deconversion files required by the successor provider.

· Support outgoing asset processing, including liquidation coordination, wire or transfer instructions, asset documentation, and related reconciliation activities.

· Review outgoing files, final reports, participant balances, loan records, liquidation activity, wire details, and accounting support for completeness and accuracy before submission for release or required approval.

· Reconcile outgoing assets and records, investigate differences, and coordinate necessary follow-up with internal teams, clients, and successor providers.

· Coordinate the resolution of residual balances, trailing activity, outstanding loans, forfeitures, and other items that may delay final transfer or case closure.

· Complete and document assigned conversion-out activities in accordance with applicable IRS, ERISA, DOL, plan document, provider, contractual, and internal requirements, and escalate potential exceptions or compliance concerns.

· Validate notice timing, participant records, transfer documentation, approvals, delivery evidence, and audit-ready support.

· Document potential compliance, operational, financial, or participant-impact risks, including required follow-up and escalation.

· Communicate assigned transfer requirements, open items, documented risks, and next steps to clients, successor providers, and internal stakeholders within established communication and escalation guidelines.

· Partner with Client Relationships, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Trading, Participant Services, and other internal teams to resolve issues and improve exit handoffs.

· Maintain accurate and timely case notes, task updates, documentation, delivery confirmations, and supporting records in applicable systems.

· Verify that required records and assets have transferred, document outstanding or trailing items, and complete or recommend operational case closure in accordance with established procedures and approval requirements.

· Participate in ongoing cross-training across deconversion and conversion processes and provide support for incoming plan transfers, conversions, and related team responsibilities as business needs and workload require.

· Complete work in accordance with approved SOPs, templates, checklists, quality standards, privacy requirements, and information-security requirements.

· Handle participant, plan, financial, and transfer data in accordance with applicable privacy, information-security, file-transfer, access-control, and records-retention requirements.

· Contribute feedback that supports process consistency, workflow improvements, and operational initiatives.

· Support additional projects, process initiatives, and related responsibilities as business needs and operational priorities evolve.

Skills & Abilities

· Working knowledge of 401(k) administration, deconversions, outgoing plan transfers, participant records, loans, successor-provider requirements, and asset movement.
