title: Technical Product Manager - Payouts
description:
About Us
At Félix, we are building the indispensable financial companion for Latinos in the US. We combine an AI-powered, conversational-first interface with real-time financial infrastructure to make cross-border money movement as easy as sending a text. Starting with fast, affordable remittances powered by AI and crypto rails, we are expanding into credit, savings, and wallet services to support the complete immigrant financial journey. Our ambition is to deliver a white-glove financial experience with the simplicity of a conversation to a community the traditional financial system has historically overlooked.
We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.
Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission, serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
Félix moves money for millions of transactions from the US to LatAm. The Payouts Platform is the shared service every Félix product uses to send money out, across bank transfers, instant payment rails, wallets, cards, cash networks, and crypto rails.
As PM for Payouts Platform, you'll own the vision, roadmap and results for how money gets to its destination. Your goal is to make paying out fast, reliable and low-cost for every product, in every market we serve.

What you'll focus on
  • Set the vision and roadmap. Define where the Payouts Platform goes next, and balance new capabilities, reliability and cost in your priorities.
  • Build a platform every product can use. Turn payouts into a shared, self-serve capability that any product team can adopt quickly, so Félix can launch new products without building payouts from scratch each time.
  • Expand reach. Decide which markets and rails to invest in next, across Latin America and beyond, including instant payments, wallets, cash networks and crypto rails. Lead the platform side of each launch with FX, Compliance and Treasury, and shorten the time to go live.
  • Shape partner strategy. Define what the platform needs from payout partners, compare their performance, and decide which ones to integrate or route more volume to. That includes building direct connections to major payout providers alongside aggregator partners. Make partner decisions for new capabilities alongside the Business Development team, which owns the commercial relationships.
  • Improve performance. Define the routing and validation strategy that raises success rates and speed while lowering cost per payout.
  • Reduce manual work. Prioritize product improvements that remove manual handling of failed and returned payouts, working with Ops and the Ops Platform. Give product teams real-time visibility into every payout.
  • Align across teams. Make sure every payout is compliant, funded and supportable. That means working with Compliance on screening, Treasury on liquidity, and product teams on the experience they build on top of the platform.
  • Set service commitments. Define the reliability and performance levels product teams can count on, and prioritize the work to meet them with the engineering team, which owns delivery. Report on the success, speed and cost of payouts.

What you'll bring
  • Product experience: 5+ years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Platform and API experience: you've owned a product whose main customers were other teams or developers.
  • Partner integrations: a track record of taking third-party integrations from evaluation to production, with engineering and commercial teams.
  • Data fluency: comfortable with SQL and with defining and tracking reliability and cost metrics.
  • Clear communication: you can explain trade-offs to engineers, ops teams and executives alike.
  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $170,000 and $220,000 USD in San Francisco tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

Equal Opportunity Employer
At Félix, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, nationality, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or disability. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Want to learn more about our privacy practices? Check out our Privacy Policy.

title: Project Manager Product Development
description:
As a Project Manager, you are responsible for delivering project results on time and within budget. In this role, you act as the link between engineers, testers, technical writers, product managers, procurement specialists, production staff, and the support organization. You ensure that the project's vision and objectives are clear to everyone so that all team members understand the direction and their responsibilities. Additionally, you coordinate and safeguard project activities.

The projects you will lead fall under product development. Within this department, we continuously work on improving our installed base of robots and developing new, innovative solutions to further encourage the adoption of robotics on farms.

You will be part of a team of 25 project managers, led by the lead project manager. This team is committed to further professionalizing project management within Lely. There is also a strong focus on personal development, for example, through peer reviews and intervision sessions. You can further develop yourself by attending training courses via the Lely Academy. We work hard but also enjoy a good time, which is why we organize several outings each year to engage in fun activities together outside of work. If you have a great idea for an outing, we would love to hear it!

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead a project with a multidisciplinary team of approximately 20 engineers, ensuring that everyone remains aligned and focused on the shared goals.

Your main tasks include:

  • Creating, implementing, and aligning project plans with relevant stakeholders, as well as coordinating all activities within the project;
  • Managing the budget and monitoring the cost price development of the machine;
  • Managing risks and overseeing suppliers;
  • Challenging and motivating engineers to deliver an optimal and technically high-quality product;
  • Providing progress reports for management and stakeholders;
  • Contributing to the further professionalization of project management within Lely.

You are an experienced project manager who thrives on independently getting complex projects and programs on track and bringing them to a successful conclusion. You speak the language of engineers but also demonstrate your added value in discussions with stakeholders. You excel at maintaining continuous contact with internal stakeholders, such as Product Managers, department heads, production teams, and suppliers, to ensure a successful introduction of product improvements in the field.

What else do you bring to the table?

  • A master's degree (WO) in a technical field;
  • Interest in robotics and the agricultural sector;
  • At least 5 years of experience as a project manager;
  • Proven experience in leading innovative product development projects;
  • As part of an international team, you have excellent proficiency in both Dutch and English, both spoken and written;
  • IPMA certification or an equivalent qualification.

Naturally, you thrive in a dynamic and innovative organization.

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You contribute to making the agricultural sector future-proof - and we make sure that you get all the space, resources and support you need to do so.

  • An international working environment with opportunities for own initiative and entrepreneurship.
  • Excellent working conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a good pension scheme.
  • A salary within the scale of €5700 - €8000 gross per month, in which we like to see opportunities for growth from your starting salary towards the future
  • Good growth opportunities: you are in control of your development and can choose from various training courses through our Lely Academy - from personal development to job-specific training.
  • Our modern Lely Campus offers daily access to extensive sports facilities: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, an outdoor basketball and volleyball court, table tennis and table soccer. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training - and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
  • Enjoy fresh coffee and tea from our own barista, with milk straight from our farm, as well as a healthy and affordable company restaurant.
  • A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid work policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible working hours and plenty of room to spend extra time on site (between 06:00 and 20:00).
  • A free shuttle bus will take you to and from the metro in Maassluis, so your workday starts and ends smoothly.
  • Successes need to be celebrated: from anniversaries to Christmas parties - at Lely we know how to do it!

We are also proud that our efforts and vision have been rewarded by winning the Rotterdam Entrepreneur Award 2025!

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or secondment agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we are looking for all our candidates directly. We understand that you, as an intermediary, want to present candidates for our great positions and thus contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

title: Statistical Programmer, Consultative COA Scoring
description:
Overview

IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. IQVIA has two teams focused exclusively on amplifying the patient’s voice and enhancing their experiences across their health journey: the Patient-Centered Solutions and Connected Technologies (PACT) team, and the Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient and Site Strategy (ILS & PASS) team. These teams work closely together to generate patient experience data (PED) through clinical outcome assessments (COAs; including digital health technologies), qualitative research, and patient preference research.


The ILS & PASS team has a small group dedicated to thought leadership and COA instrument development. This “science team” is focused on (a) ensuring that sound scientific principles permeate through the research completed by the PACT and ILS & PASS teams, and (b) leading the development, validation, and qualification of COA instruments to collect reliable and interpretable data from patients in medicines development and routine clinical care.


The ILS & PASS science team comprises dedicated qualitative scientists and COA development scientists.


Role & Responsibilities

The Statistical Programmer will be expected to:

(1) Empirically develop scoring rules & program scoring algorithms for existing COA measures

  • For instruments being added to IQVIA ILS library, generate standard scoring documentation, and program simulation datasets, Data Quality Evaluation (DQE), and scoring of domains on these datasets
  • Implement new statistical features in the random generation of data, to simulate real-world instrument data with certain psychometric properties
  • Implement new, more advanced statistical capabilities in user tools (Insights Hub, PROCore)
  • Work cross-functionally with non-statisticians/psychometricians in the PACT and ILS & PASS teams

(2) Provide programming support for the development of new COA measures & endpoints

  • Program classical and modern psychometric analyses and analyses of meaningful thresholds
  • Program high frequency and continuous DHT data
  • collaborate with data scientists to support algorithm validation, and verification of digital measure performance across diverse datasets and devices.

About You

Knowledge, skills and abilities

  • Candidates must have: (a) statistical and psychometric research skills; and (b) strong computer skills, including Base SAS with macro (R skills, API experience). Connecting to databases with SAS/R, and programming with validation/QC in a regulated environment would be an advantage.
  • Candidates should demonstrate: (a) excellent written and oral communication skills including grammatical/technical writing skills; (b) critical attention and accuracy with details; and (c) strong individual initiative, organizing skills, and commitment to quality.
  • Candidates must be able to: (a) work within a team environment, and to establish and maintain effective working relationships; (b) confidently communicate with, and effectively present information to, internal and external teams; and (c) work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and projects.
  • Candidates should have extensive familiarity and demonstrable experience with AI tools and their application to the topics mentioned above.

Education and experience

  • Candidates should have a relevant qualification in statistics or psychometrics, experience in statistical programming, and an interest in patient-centered research (including COA and/or DHT) and clinical research (pharmaceutical, or healthcare industry).
  • Consulting experience with pharmaceutical companies is desirable.


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The potential base pay range for this role, when annualized, is €27 400,00 - €41 000,00. The actual base pay offered may vary based on a number of factors including job-related qualifications such as knowledge, skills, education, and experience; location; and/or schedule (full or part-time). Dependent on the position offered, incentive plans, bonuses, and/or other forms of compensation may be offered, in addition to a range of health and welfare and/or other benefits.

title: Exempt to Permanent - 0931 - MANAGER III (E10196)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Under general administrative direction, incumbents in this class function as senior managers operating within a broad policy framework and typically manage a division of a medium/large department. Incumbents assume sole responsibility for a functional area(s) of service; coordinate and implement program planning; and define organizational structure, staffing requirements, resource allocation and identification of future resource needs. Incumbents also interface with all managerial levels of city/county government and outside agencies, and serve as representatives of the division or department in meetings involving administrative systems, policies or procedures; and perform related duties as required.

Supervision Exercised: Managers in this class typically manage mid-level staff or line managers.

Examples of Important and Essential Duties:

1. Plans, monitors, evaluates, and supervises the operation of a division of a city department; coordinates the work of the various subdivisions; advises and consults with section managers; meets with appropriate staff to identify and resolve problems or conflicts; makes or recommends final decisions regarding policy, operations, and administrative procedures.

2. Develops, implements and maintains procedures, administrative monitoring practices and controls in order to obtain smooth and effective operation of a division; coordinates work activities of one division with other divisions within the department to prevent delays in required actions or to improve programs or services; assists in the identification, development and implementation of departmental goals, objectives, policies, and priorities; assists in the determination of resource allocation and levels of service according to established policies.

3. Receives and analyzes division and departmental reports; directs the preparation of monthly and annual reports; directs the gathering and analysis of information and reports necessary to document and evaluate processes.

4. Monitors the work of and coaches subordinates to improve performance.

5. Directs the allocation of resources to achieve timely outcomes and measurable goals within budget; adjusts plans and programs to meet emerging or new programs, while continuing to address major departmental priorities.

6. Monitors and evaluates the effectiveness and efficiency of the division's service delivery system, organizational structure, staffing levels, financial systems, and other internal operations; identifies and recommends alternative approaches or improvements; implements revisions, adjustments and changes.

7. May serve as liaison for the Department with a variety of other City/County staff, policy-making officials, and officials of outside agencies; explains and justifies Departmental or administrative procedures, policies, or programs; negotiates and resolves difficult and complex issues and problems.

8. May plan, develop, implement or direct major or complex projects or programs which span a number of the department's established sections or divisions; directs the research of complex, highly technical issues; analyzes alternative solutions or approaches; recommends most effective course of action.

9. Participates in budget development by providing detailed justification and persuasive arguments for proposals or initiatives. Oversees and administers division budget; directs and monitors expenditures in accordance with the approved budget; directs the preparation and maintenance of a wide variety of statistical, fiscal, and operational reports and studies; and provides executive management with an early warning and practical options to potential cost overruns.

title: Cloud Software Engineer (Full-Stack and AI) - Junior Level
description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

Redhorse Corporation's Cyber Analytics team is seeking a motivated Junior Cloud Software Engineer to contribute to the development, deployment, and enhancement of enterprise-scale, AI-enabled data processing and visualization systems. This position supports mission-critical federal customer environments operating across hybrid, on-premises, and multi-cloud (AWS/Azure) ecosystems.

In this role, you will work alongside senior engineers and architects across the software development lifecycle. Responsibilities include building robust backend microservices, integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI/ML) capabilities, and developing clean, intuitive Web User Interfaces (UIs) for analysts and end-users.

The engineer will also assist with technical research, security analysis, and software component assessments. Successful candidates will bring a strong foundation in computer science, an eagerness to learn modern cloud and AI technologies, and solid communication skills to collaborate within a multidisciplinary team.

Position Description

  • Cloud Engineering & Development: Assist in developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining cloud-native microservices and applications primarily utilizing AWS and/or Azure (GovCloud/commercial).
  • Data Processing & Backend Systems: Support the implementation of resilient data processing pipelines, event-driven components, and APIs designed to handle high-throughput cyber datasets.
  • Full-Stack & Web UI Development: Develop, test, and maintain responsive Web User Interfaces (UIs), front-end components, and dashboards that enable intuitive data visualization, analytics, and operational workflows.
  • AI & Machine Learning Integration: Assist in connecting AI/ML models, cognitive services, vector databases, and Large Language Model (LLM) APIs into core analytics workflows under the guidance of senior technical staff.
  • Cyber & Vulnerability Support: Collaborate with technical teams to assess application security, inspect software/mobile components, and support the development of custom utilities for data recovery and extraction.
  • DevSecOps & Testing: Participate in CI/CD pipeline usage, write unit and automated integration tests, and utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates to support continuous delivery across secure environments.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: 1+ YOE in software development (including internships, co-ops, research labs, or professional production experience).
  • Core Languages: Foundational proficiency in at least one modern language such as Python, Java, C#, or C/C++,
  • Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to or hands-on experience with core cloud services in AWS (e.g., S3, Lambda, EC2, IAM) or Microsoft Azure (e.g., Blob Storage, Azure Functions, VMs).
  • Entry-level or associate cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Solutions Architect – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals / Developer Associate).
  • Familiarity with modern front-end frameworks and libraries such as React, Angular, Vue.js, or TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Basic experience consuming RESTful or GraphQL APIs and working with data visualization libraries (e.g., Chart.js, D3.js).
  • Basic knowledge of containerization concepts using Docker.
  • Exposure to relational or NoSQL databases, or familiarity with data platforms and messaging systems (e.g., Elasticsearch, Redis, Apache Kafka).
  • Coursework, personal projects, or hands-on experience experimenting with AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain) or commercial LLM APIs.
  • Basic understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and protocol analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark).
  • Familiarity with OS internals, reverse engineering fundamentals, or binary analysis tools (e.g., Ghidra) is a plus.
The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.
Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Architecture Modernization
description:
Remote position, open for professionals based in Argentina.
At Ryz Labs, we are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our client's Architecture Modernization initiative.
This role will focus primarily on backend development, contributing to the decomposition of the existing monolithic platform into independent microservices, developing and maintaining REST APIs, and delivering scalable, reliable software solutions.
The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, microservices architecture, SQL databases, and Microsoft Azure, along with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.
The Senior Software Engineer will work as part of an existing scrum team, collaborating closely with the Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, and other engineers to deliver production-ready software aligned with the platform's architectural standards.
Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and maintain backend services using C# and .NET.
• Contribute to the modernization of the platform by decomposing monolithic application components into microservices.
• Design, implement, and maintain RESTful APIs and service integrations.
• Define and implement service boundaries, API contracts, and integration patterns.
• Develop scalable, maintainable, and reliable software solutions within a multi-tenant SaaS environment.
• Work with SQL databases, including database design, queries, performance optimization, and migration activities.
• Implement automated unit and integration tests to ensure software quality and reliability.
• Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards and architectural guidelines.
• Collaborate with the Tech Lead and other engineers to identify technical challenges and propose effective solutions.
• Contribute to CI/CD improvements and automated build and deployment processes.
• Support application monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
• Follow secure software development practices and established SDLC procedures.
• Contribute to technical documentation and maintain traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
• Participate in all Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
• Demonstrate completed work during sprint showcases.
• Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools to support coding, testing, code reviews, and documentation.
Required Technical Skills & Experience
• 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
• Strong hands-on experience with C# and .NET in production environments.
• Proven experience designing and developing microservices-based applications.
• Solid experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
• Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based application environments.
• Strong knowledge of SQL databases, particularly SQL Server.
• Experience with Docker and containerized application environments.
• Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated software delivery, preferably using Azure DevOps.
• Experience with Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review workflows.
• Strong understanding of software design principles, architecture patterns, and clean code practices.
• Experience writing automated unit and integration tests.
• Familiarity with TypeScript and React Native for cross-platform integration and collaboration when required.
• Experience working within Agile/Scrum teams.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Nice-to-Have Skills
• Experience with monolithic application modernization and incremental migration strategies.
• Familiarity with the Strangler Pattern.
• Experience with event-driven architecture and asynchronous messaging.
• Knowledge of API gateways and service-to-service communication.
• Experience with distributed tracing, logging, observability, and monitoring tools.
• Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure as code.
• Experience with application resilience patterns, including retries, circuit breakers, and health checks.
• Experience working with Postgres SQL and document databases.
• Previous experience in regulated software environments, particularly GxP, life sciences, or quality management SaaS.
• Knowledge of data integrity principles, ALCOA+, audit trails, and change control.
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
AI-Assisted Engineering & Regulatory Compliance
Our client is an AI-forward engineering organization. The Senior Software Engineer is expected to incorporate approved AI tools into daily engineering workflows, including:
• Code generation and development assistance.
• Automated test generation.
• Code review and quality improvements.
• Technical documentation.
Engineers remain fully accountable for all delivered code and engineering artifacts. AI-generated outputs must follow the same code review, automated testing, SonarCloud analysis, and Definition of Done requirements as any other contribution.
Given the regulated nature of the platform, the engineer must also work within established compliance and governance requirements, including:
• CFR Part 11 compliance.
• Validated SDLC and change control procedures.
• Full traceability across the software development lifecycle.
• Human-in-the-loop oversight for AI-driven decisions.
• Immutable audit trails and data integrity.
• Appropriate technical documentation and release evidence.
• Previous experience in regulated environments is strongly preferred.

title: Director of Field Service
description:
The Director of Field Service leads the strategic and operational direction of the Foodmate USA’s aftermarket services business across the USA and Canada, with clear ownership for safety, quality, financial performance, and disciplined project execution. This leader owns P&L results, team leadership, and customer satisfaction across aftermarket field services, and project execution., and is central to a recurring, service-led partnership for customers.

This is a strategic leadership position responsible for the growth, profitability, and operational excellence of the after-market field service business. This role focuses on transitioning the service business from a transactional product-sale model to a recurring, service-led partnership that optimizes the total cost of ownership (TCO) and machine performance for our customers.

Who You Are:
You serve as a strategic partner to build, grow, and maintain profitable and long-lasting relationships with customer accounts through responsive and high-quality field service. An agent of positive change and leadership to the field service organization. You and your team will do the right things and do things right.

Strategic & Financial Leadership

  • Define and execute the service strategy for Foodmate service product line.
  • Support expansion and evolve service offerings (e.g., retrofits, upgrades, and maintenance agreements.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Director of Lifecycle Services to focus on cost management and budget planning.
  • Plan & Execute service, focusing on 911 proactive response, installations, maintenance contracts, and Help desk service.
  • Drive P&L performance for the field service division, owning service revenue growth and margin.
  • Own a multi-million-dollar P&L ( $12 million), with a track record of driving year-over-year growth.
  • Manage the Field Operations budget, driving efficiency and optimizing resource allocation.

Operational Excellence

  • Oversee delivery of safe, high-quality services across all active projects and service accounts.
  • Leverage operational tools (Salesforce, Power BI, etc.) to track KPIs and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Ensure efficient use of internal labor and subcontractors, and timely project and machinery rebuild execution.
  • Standardized service delivery protocols (e.g., 911 calls, Shutdowns, performance) for consistent customer experience.
  • Support the design of training curriculum focused on technical proficiency, safety compliance, diagnostic capabilities.
  • Track and report safety performance (TRIR, DART, or equivalent) alongside quality, cost, and schedule KPIs.
  • Optimize Technician utilization

Team Leadership

  • Lead a team of (10) Regional Service Managers, PMs, and Coordination team, site leads and Field Technicians.
  • Champion a culture focused on safety, quality, accountability, and excellent customer service.
  • Develop and mentor leadership and technical talent, with a focus on a certified workforce.
  • Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our health and safety requirements and customer regulations.
  • Partner with HR and Talent Acquisition training on workforce, hiring strategies, and technical development programs.
  • Ensure every issue is resolved in a timely, high-quality manner, with time to resolution.

Customer & Commercial Engagement

  • Support Sales on strategic customer accounts; manage escalations and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Drive alignment between operations and sales to deliver on service opportunities and expectations.
  • Participate in customer site visits and strategic planning meetings for larger scale commercial wins

Installation & Service Management

  • Manage field technicians : own customer relationships, control costs, and hold crews accountable to SOPs.
  • Ensure installations are completed right the first time for customer success and signed off properly.
  • Ensure the customer equipment functions reliably, shifting from reactive fixes toward proactive intervention.
  • Ensure compliance with our processes and standards for installing and servicing equipment.
  • Ensure site management or lead Technicians have leadership and the support needed to execute installs/rebuilds

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Frequent presence at industrial food-processing and manufacturing sites, with exposure to moving machinery, cold/wet processing environments, and noise; required PPE provided.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., stand or walk for extended periods, and safely navigate industrial plant floors.
  • Valid driver's license required; ability to pass a background check and drug screening per customer-site requirements.

title: Electrical Foreman (35547)
description:
CEC is one of the top specialty subcontractors in the country. With our rapid growth, we’re looking for passionate, talented, and creative individuals to join our team. If you’re ready for a challenge that will elevate your career, this is the right place, right time, right people.

Position Summary

As a Foreman, you will be the first line supervisor with crew level responsibility for employees involved in the installation, alteration, addition, and/or repairs of electrical systems, conductors, and associated materials and equipment on any type of project. This is a safety sensitive position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Responsible for all CEC field trades on an electrical construction crew or project.
  • Ability to supervise other employee's quality and productivity in a professional manner.
  • Coordinate with other contractors and trades on site to ensure smooth workflow of projects.
  • Lays out work for subordinate lead persons and is jointly responsible with the Project Manager for having material, tools, equipment, information, and appropriate manpower in the proper place in a timely fashion.
  • Manages man-loading charts and writes schedules.
  • Directs subordinate crew in installation of electrical feeders; equipment such as pumps, motors, and generators; control and distribution apparatus such as switch gear, relays, and circuit breaker panels; lighting fixtures and outlets; and related connections and terminations.
  • Monitors work as performed, directs subordinate crews, and schedules work according to the pace of the job and other trades.
  • May perform work being supervised for either production or instruction.
  • Manages office correspondence and administrative paperwork such as official forms, daily reports, time sheets, and safety reporting.
  • Responsible for crew or project safety performance. Assures employees are properly trained or instructed in performance of duties to which assigned. Assures compliance with all CEC safety processes and protocols. Investigates or assists in investigation and reporting of any accident or safety incidents involving jobsite employees.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned to ensure efficient and effective processes, completion of projects and smooth operation of department.

channels, creating engaging content, driving online lead generation, and enhancing brand reputation

  • Create, schedule and publish high-quality content daily aligned with brand guidelines and community calendar
  • Manage community engagement including responding to comments, messages and mentions
  • Monitor social media trends and incorporate relevant content themes and formats
  • Develop platform-specific content strategies optimized for each channel's audience and algorithm
  • Coordinate influencer partnerships and brand ambassador programs
  • Manage social media advertising campaigns with monthly budget allocation and ROI tracking
  • Grow follower base organically and through paid campaigns with monthly growth targets

Digital Marketing & Lead Generation

  • Develop retargeting campaigns for website visitors and engaged prospects

Online Reputation Management

  • Monitor and manage online reviews across Google, Facebook, Bayut and other platforms
  • Respond professionally to all reviews
  • Develop review generation campaigns encouraging satisfied residents to share feedback
  • Track online reputation scores and sentiment trends with monthly reporting
  • Coordinate with operations team to address service issues raised in online reviews
  • Implement reputation repair strategies for negative feedback
  • Showcase positive reviews and testimonials across marketing channels
  • Maintain review response templates aligned with brand voice and service recovery protocols
  • Monitor competitor reviews and benchmark performance
  • Report monthly on review volume, average rating and sentiment analysis

Website & Digital Platforms Management

  • Maintain and update property website with fresh content, imagery and leasing information
  • Ensure website is mobile-optimized and delivers excellent user experience
  • Monitor website analytics including traffic, bounce rate, conversion rate and user behavior
  • Implement website improvements based on analytics insights and user feedback
  • Coordinate with IT/web development for technical updates and enhancements
  • Manage resident mobile app communications including push notifications and in-app content
  • Develop digital brochures, e-flyers and downloadable marketing materials
  • Ensure website SEO optimization and local search visibility
  • Maintain website lead capture forms and integrate with CRM system
  • Conduct A/B testing on landing pages, CTAs and conversion elements

Campaign Planning & Execution

  • Develop monthly and quarterly digital marketing campaigns aligned with leasing objectives
  • Create promotional campaigns for special offers, seasonal deals and availability windows
  • Coordinate campaign launch across all digital channels with consistent messaging
  • Design campaign assets including graphics, videos, ad copy and landing pages
  • Set campaign KPIs and track performance against targets
  • Implement UTM tracking and attribution for all campaign links
  • Conduct post-campaign analysis with recommendations for optimization
  • Coordinate cross-functional campaigns with leasing, events and operations teams
  • Develop nurture campaigns for prospects at different stages of the leasing journey
  • Create urgency-driven campaigns to convert pipeline prospects and reduce vacancy periods

Analytics, Reporting & Performance Optimization

  • Monitor daily performance across all digital channels and platforms
  • Prepare monthly digital marketing reports including reach, engagement, leads and conversions
  • Track KPIs including follower growth, engagement rate, click-through rate, cost per lead and conversion rate
  • Analyze campaign performance and provide data-driven recommendations
  • Conduct competitor analysis and digital benchmarking
  • Report on ROI and cost-effectiveness of all digital marketing investments
  • Maintain marketing dashboard with real-time performance metrics
  • Identify trends, insights and opportunities from analytics data
  • Present quarterly digital strategy reviews with performance highlights and future plans
  • Continuously optimize content, campaigns and channels based on performance data

Community Engagement & Events Coverage

  • Provide social media coverage for all community events with live updates and highlights
  • Create event recap content including photo galleries, videos and resident testimonials
  • Develop event promotion campaigns to drive resident participation
  • Coordinate resident content contributions and feature resident stories
  • Build online community engagement through interactive content (polls, Q&As, contests)
  • Manage giveaways, competitions and engagement campaigns
  • Celebrate community milestones, achievements and cultural moments
  • Create behind-the-scenes content showcasing property management and team
  • Foster sense of community and belonging through digital storytelling
  • Encourage resident advocacy and word-of-mouth marketing through social engagement

Brand Development & Positioning

  • Develop and maintain Brand Standards Manual for digital channels
  • Ensure consistent brand identity across all digital touchpoints
  • Position property as premier residential compound in North Riyadh market
  • Develop brand messaging framework emphasizing lifestyle, quality and community
  • Create differentiation strategy highlighting unique amenities and service standards
  • Monitor brand mentions and media coverage across digital platforms
  • Coordinate PR opportunities and media partnerships
  • Develop crisis communication protocols for digital channels
  • Protect brand reputation through proactive monitoring and rapid response
  • Align digital brand strategy with Saudi Vision 2030 and ESG principles

Collaboration & Coordination

  • Coordinate with operations team to capture service excellence stories and resident satisfaction
  • Support community management team with event promotion and resident communications
  • Liaise with FM contractor for access to property for content creation
  • Coordinate with external agencies, photographers, videographers and content creators

  • Participate in weekly marketing and leasing meetings
  • Provide digital marketing training and support to property management team

The candidate will perform all functions and responsibilities which may not be expressly mentioned in the Clients contract, but that are necessary for the proper performance of services and the conducting of activities for the effective and efficient management of the property in accordance with good industry protocols and any applicable best international standards and codes of practice.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Arabic (bilingual content creation essential)

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media or related field

Key Competencies

  • Creative storyteller with strong visual and written content skills
  • Data-driven with analytical mindset and performance optimization focus
  • Highly organized with ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously
  • Proactive self-starter with ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Detail-oriented with commitment to brand consistency and quality standards
  • Trend-aware with finger on the pulse of social media and digital marketing evolution
  • Tech-savvy with quick learning ability for new platforms and tools
  • Culturally sensitive with understanding of Saudi market and diverse resident demographics
  • Results-oriented with focus on lead generation and business objectives
  • Collaborative team player with strong communication and coordination skills
  • Adaptable and flexible in fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Strategic thinker with ability to translate business goals into digital campaigns

title: Lead Shelter Monitor (9510)
location: TX-Austin Womens & Childrens Shelter - Austin, TX 78721
description:
Employee Benefits:

  • Affordable Health Insurance
  • Retirement Plan with Employer Match
  • 29 days Paid Time Off
  • 12 Paid Holidays

Job Summary:

Assists residents staying in the shelter overnight; performs client intake procedures and prepares client intake records; monitors the activity of residents on an assigned shift ensuring safety, security and compliance to house rules; maintains accurate and complete records and logs containing pertinent information; ensures that facility is maintained in a neat and proper order.

Schedule/Hours: Overnight, 11pm-7am, Sunday through Thursday

This Position is Responsible For:

  • Supervisory Responsibilities (10%)
    • Acts as the lead worker to the Shelter Monitor position; trains and instructs employees and volunteers in the proper methods and procedures; assists with scheduling; informs Manager of any staff issues requiring attention.
  • Intake and Discharge Responsibilities (25%)
    • Answers telephone and responds to questions regarding the shelter operations.
    • Performs client intake procedures including running sexual offender checks; checks clients into the shelter; prepares and monitors client intake cards; prepares and maintains resident roster.
    • Orients new clients to the program and prepares case records to facilitate case management; records daily statistics.
    • Inputs client information to HMIS accurately and in accordance with established timelines and procedures; updates client files as needed; obtains client’s signature on forms as well as house rules and regulations.
  • Housekeeping and Chore Distribution Responsibilities (25%)
    • Distributes towels, linens, and personal hygiene items to clients.
    • Assigns daily cooking, cleaning, and maintenance chores to clients and ensures completion of such; as needed, participates in the cleaning and maintenance of facilities, supplies, and equipment; inspects facility on a routine basis to ensure compliance with established standards; ensures return and accountability of The Salvation Army property (linens, etc.).
  • Building Security Responsibilities (20%)
    • Ensures clients comply with house rules; checks client’s baggage for drugs, alcohol, weapons and pornography; records incidents and notifies supervisor of any special circumstances or unusual problems; ensures security of facility and clients; arms and disarms alarms in accordance with lodge policy; locks and secures area inappropriate for client entry.
    • Conducts routine checks of the facilities to ensure that all doors are locked and that nothing is amiss; locks doors to ensure security of the facilities.
    • Responds to emergencies in a calm manner and initiates appropriate actions in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Cooking and Food Inventory Responsibilities (20%)
    • Participates in the selection and preparation of food; monitors expenditures ensuring compliance with budget constraints; purchases needed food items from the store; serves food and snacks to clients; assists clients in the cleaning of the kitchen after meals.
    • Maintains an adequate level of food and supplies inventory; prepares inventory records and ensure the accountability and security of inventory items.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Ability to meet attendance requirements.
  • Ability to read, write and communicate the English language effectively.
  • Ability to perform data entry into a computer.
  • Ability to respond to emergency situations quickly and calmly while maintaining control and initiating the proper corrective action.
  • Ability to perform combinations of sitting, standing and walking on a frequent change basis. Distance of travel is usually within the same building.
  • Limited amount of physical effort required associated with walking, standing, lifting and carrying light objects (less than 25lbs.) frequently.
  • Work is performed in a residential facility where there are little or no physical discomforts associated with changes in weather or discomforts associated with noise, dust, dirt and the like.

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.


Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.


Critical Facilities Technician


What this job involves:

As an Critical Facilities Technician at JLL, you will be responsible for the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of critical building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical equipment. You'll ensure optimal building performance through proactive maintenance, troubleshooting, and prompt response to service requests. This role requires hands-on technical expertise to maintain environmental comfort, safety standards, and operational excellence across assigned facilities. You'll work collaboratively with facility management teams, contractors, and vendors to deliver exceptional service to building occupants while maintaining compliance with all applicable codes, regulations, and JLL standards. Your contribution will be essential in supporting the overall functionality and sustainability of the properties under your care.


What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain HVAC systems, boilers, chillers, pumps, and related mechanical equipment to ensure optimal building performance and occupant comfort
  • Perform routine inspections, preventive maintenance, and minor repairs on building systems including electrical, plumbing, fire/life safety, and building automation systems
  • Respond promptly to service requests, troubleshoot equipment malfunctions, and coordinate with vendors or contractors for specialized repairs when necessary
  • Monitor and document equipment performance, maintain accurate logs, and track maintenance activities using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
  • Conduct daily rounds of assigned facilities to identify potential issues, ensure proper operation of all systems, and maintain cleanliness of mechanical spaces
  • Assist with energy management initiatives by monitoring utility consumption and implementing efficiency measures to reduce operational costs
  • Support emergency response procedures, including after-hours on-call responsibilities, to address critical building system failures or life safety concerns


Required qualifications:

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience operating and maintaining commercial building systems in facilities of 100,000+ square feet
  • Working knowledge of HVAC systems, electrical distribution, plumbing, building automation systems, and fire/life safety equipment
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, technical manuals, and building management system interfaces
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose equipment problems and determine appropriate corrective actions
  • Physical capability to perform job duties including climbing ladders, working in confined spaces, lifting up to 50 pounds, and standing or walking for extended periods


Preferred qualifications:

  • Valid stationary engineer license, boiler operator license, or equivalent certification as required by local jurisdiction
  • Associate degree in facilities management, mechanical engineering technology, or related technical discipline
  • Universal EPA Section 608 certification for refrigerant handling
  • Experience with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) such as Corrigo, Maximo, or similar platforms
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification demonstrating knowledge of workplace safety standards
  • Building automation system (BAS) experience with platforms such as Tridium, Johnson Controls, Siemens, or Honeywell

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer

  • Location: Global, fully remote
  • Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
  • Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired as long as there is activity.

We are looking for highly skilled Full-Stack Software Engineers to contribute to an AI training project involving software development, technical problem-solving, debugging, system architecture, and code evaluation.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging software-engineering tasks across front-end and back-end systems and helping with translating full coding builds from one particular language into another.

This role requires meaningful hands-on experience across both front-end and back-end engineering. Candidates should be comfortable working throughout the application stack rather than specializing exclusively in one layer.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Develop, modify, and debug front-end and back-end application components.
  2. Implement user-facing features and the services, APIs, and data models that support them.
  3. Trace requests and data across browsers, front-end applications, APIs, services, databases, and external integrations.
  4. Work inside unfamiliar repositories and understand existing application architecture.
  5. Diagnose failures involving application state, API contracts, authentication, persistence, networking, and deployment.
  6. Evaluate and improve code written in multiple programming languages.
  7. Review AI-generated solutions for correctness, completeness, performance, security, and maintainability.

Required Qualifications

  1. Strong professional experience developing production full-stack applications.
  2. Meaningful hands-on experience with bothfront-end and back-end engineering.
  3. Production experience with multiple programming languages.
  4. Strong knowledge of browser applications, APIs, application state, databases, and service integration.
  5. Experience understanding and contributing to the architecture of complete software systems.
  6. Ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases.
  7. Strong debugging and technical problem-solving skills.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum number of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.


A very attractive and competitive package is offered.

title: JJSE Program Coordinator
description:
Mission Graduates is a nonprofit organization that increases the number of K-12 students in San Francisco's Mission District who are prepared for and complete a college education. We work towards fulfilling our mission through a wide range of afterschool support services that serve over 4,800 children, youth, and families each year. Our vision is to transform the culture of our neighborhood so that college becomes the expectation for Mission families, rather than the exception.

Program Summary: Mission Graduates has been providing quality afterschool programming for its entire 50-year history. The organization is partnering with June Jordan School of Equity (JJSE) to develop and implement a quality afterschool program that blends extracurricular activities and builds a college-going culture on campus. Youth who participate in the program develop a sense of self-confidence in their ability to learn, to speak their voice, and contribute to their community. The program infuses college messaging throughout its curriculum to ensure both youth and parents develop or strengthen expectations for entering college.

Key Responsibilities & Primary Duties

Program Management & Evaluation (25%)

Assist in the maintenance of all program records, particularly maintenance of attendance.
Assist the Director in developing and managing the annual program budget.
Maintain knowledge of ExCEL policies and procedures.
Assist in program evaluation and the utilization of evaluation findings in program development to ensure positive outcomes.
Assist in the preparation of funding proposals and reports to funders.

Program Quality, Support, & Delivery (50%)

  • Work with program staff to deliver quality afterschool programming, including supervision of at least three clubs or programs.

    • Lead the JJSE leadership student group, meeting weekly. Create meeting agendas, lead activities, and support students in running school-wide events.

    • Manage the academic tutoring program and referral process.

    • Uphold all school-site policies for safety, supervision, mandated reporting, and risk management.

      • Assist in the preparation of internal marketing materials to be disseminated to students, parents, and the JJSE community.

      • Collaborate closely with community stakeholders including parents and caregivers, community-based organizations, and SFUSD.

      • Assist the JJSE Director in developing parent engagement activities and maintaining positive parent relations with current JJSE families.

      • Assist and lead summer programming in academics, enrichment, and/or recreation.

Supervise Consultants & Volunteers (10%)

  • In collaboration with other MG team members, oversee recruitment, training, and supervision of volunteers and program consultants.

  • Assist/Support the SFUSD teachers and staff who are given stipends to implement Extended Day clubs and activities.

Family Recruitment and Outreach (15%)

  • Engaging with families to facilitate two-way communication and information sharing, highlighting school and program activities at JJSE.

  • Attend high school tabling events at middle schools and positively represent JJSE to prospective families.

  • Reach out to prospective high school families in the neighborhood and middle schools to share JJSE programs and schedule school tours.

Required Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of proven experience and ability in working in education and/or youth programs.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of and experience with best practices in youth development program planning, curriculum development, teaching methods, and evaluation.

  • Familiarity with college access challenges that are specific to first-generation college students.

  • Familiarity and experience working with undocumented youth.

  • Bilingual Spanish/English fluency preferred.

  • BA or BS required.

  • Current CPR certification (or attained within 2 months of employment).

  • TB test clearance is required before hiring.

  • Experience working in communities of color with low-income populations.

  • Some weekends and evenings required

People do.

We’re building a team as bold as our mission. Engineers and scientists, designers and operators, storytellers and strategists all united by a shared belief: that the undesirable can become invaluable, and that industrial decarbonization can be both practical and economical.

At Utility, we see possibilities where others see limits. We believe progress happens when diverse minds collaborate toward a cleaner, smarter, more resilient world.

If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, join us and help build what’s next.

The Company

Utility Global is redefining how the world makes and uses energy. Through its breakthrough H₂Gen® technology, Utility transforms industrial off-gases and biogases into clean energy and sustainable fuels and feedstocks, helping industries decarbonize without compromise. The company’s proprietary technology delivers a scalable, economic pathway to a zero-carbon future, positioning Utility as a leader in the industrial decarbonization revolution.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Process Engineer, reporting to the Vice President of Engineering, to develop, validate, and maintain process simulation models supporting the design, optimization, and continuous improvement of Utility Global’s H2Gen® system. The role will focus on evaluating process concepts, developing heat and material balances, and assessing performance and energy efficiency to support business development, proposals, and conceptual engineering. The position will also provide simulation and process design support for project execution, troubleshooting, and plant operations as required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Process Simulation and Optimization: Perform rigorous process simulations and optimizations using Promax to evaluate and improve process efficiency, operability, and economic performance.
  • Execute conceptual studies and techno-economic evaluations for in-house decision making and/or projects.
  • Benchmarking of Utility’s technology and evaluation of competing and/or new technologies.
  • Support the Business Development function to better understand scope of customer requirements and develop process designs.
  • Develop and utilize in-house simulations and tools to generate conceptual process designs for customers.
  • Beginning with process design, define options for execution and perform trade-offs based on efficiency, capex, opex, and economics.
  • Support Technical Proposal manager with development of technical proposals for clients.
  • Proposal Development and Business Development Support: Assist in the preparation of technical content for Technical Proposals, client presentations, and commercial discussions, offering insights into technology and process design competitiveness.
  • Development of Engineering Deliverables: e.g. Basis of Design; Process Flow Diagrams, Heat & Material balances, Equipment sizing, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams.
  • Project Execution: Support projects during the execution of FEL phases.
  • Operational Support and Troubleshooting: Provide support during plant commissioning, startup and operational troubleshooting, helping clients maximize performance and reliability of units.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering.
  • 5-10 years in a process-related industry providing process design and support, preferably in the industrial gas, LNG, Refinery, or Petrochemical space.
  • In depth knowledge of process engineering and industrial plant design/unit operations.
  • Strong understanding of engineering principles and fundamentals with the ability to adapt previous knowledge to new applications and technologies.
  • Understanding of hydrocarbon technologies (e.g. reforming, partial oxidation), and other hydrogen production technologies (e.g., electrolysis, thermochemical processes, solid oxide , or emerging innovations).
  • Expertise in process engineering simulation software e.g. Aspen Plus, Hysys, Unisim, ProMax, VMG etc
  • Proven experience in development and optimization of process designs.
  • Demonstrated project management and leadership skills.
  • Experience working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and leadership skills.
  • Effective communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders and senior management.
  • Travel up to 20%.
Utility Global was created to bring forth sustainable business solutions, enabling an affordable energy transition to a low-carbon world. This is our passion, our drive and the reason we exist. Our team of experts combines the best of world-renowned technical proficiency and respected leadership with many decades of industry experience.
Our proprietary eXEROTM technology platform, extensive patent portfolio and successful track record of taking technology to engineering to market has produced an unparalleled competitive edge for us—and most importantly for our customers, investors and partners.

title: Statistical Programmer, Consultative COA Scoring
description:
Overview

IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. IQVIA has two teams focused exclusively on amplifying the patient’s voice and enhancing their experiences across their health journey: the Patient-Centered Solutions and Connected Technologies (PACT) team, and the Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient and Site Strategy (ILS & PASS) team. These teams work closely together to generate patient experience data (PED) through clinical outcome assessments (COAs; including digital health technologies), qualitative research, and patient preference research.

The ILS & PASS team has a small group dedicated to thought leadership and COA instrument development. This “science team” is focused on (a) ensuring that sound scientific principles permeate through the research completed by the PACT and ILS & PASS teams, and (b) leading the development, validation, and qualification of COA instruments to collect reliable and interpretable data from patients in medicines development and routine clinical care.

The ILS & PASS science team comprises dedicated qualitative scientists and COA development scientists.

Role & Responsibilities

The Statistical Programmer will be expected to:

(1) Empirically develop scoring rules & program scoring algorithms for existing COA measures

  • For instruments being added to IQVIA ILS library, generate standard scoring documentation, and program simulation datasets, Data Quality Evaluation (DQE), and scoring of domains on these datasets
  • Implement new statistical features in the random generation of data, to simulate real-world instrument data with certain psychometric properties
  • Implement new, more advanced statistical capabilities in user tools (Insights Hub, PROCore)
  • Work cross-functionally with non-statisticians/psychometricians in the PACT and ILS & PASS teams

(2) Provide programming support for the development of new COA measures & endpoints

  • Program classical and modern psychometric analyses and analyses of meaningful thresholds
  • Program high frequency and continuous DHT data
  • collaborate with data scientists to support algorithm validation, and verification of digital measure performance across diverse datasets and devices.

About You

Knowledge, skills and abilities

  • Candidates must have: (a) statistical and psychometric research skills; and (b) strong computer skills, including Base SAS with macro (R skills, API experience). Connecting to databases with SAS/R, and programming with validation/QC in a regulated environment would be an advantage.
  • Candidates should demonstrate: (a) excellent written and oral communication skills including grammatical/technical writing skills; (b) critical attention and accuracy with details; and (c) strong individual initiative, organizing skills, and commitment to quality.
  • Candidates must be able to: (a) work within a team environment, and to establish and maintain effective working relationships; (b) confidently communicate with, and effectively present information to, internal and external teams; and (c) work in a fast-paced environment with demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and projects.
  • Candidates should have extensive familiarity and demonstrable experience with AI tools and their application to the topics mentioned above.

Education and experience

  • Candidates should have a relevant qualification in statistics or psychometrics, experience in statistical programming, and an interest in patient-centered research (including COA and/or DHT) and clinical research (pharmaceutical, or healthcare industry).
  • Consulting experience with pharmaceutical companies is desirable.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.
