title: Senior Research Analyst, Development
description:
Major Function

World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Senior Research Analyst. The position leads strategic, proactive prospect development research that expands and strengthens WWF Development’s pool of principal, major, annual giving, planned giving, corporate, and foundation prospects. The position serves as a research partner and strategic advisor to frontline fundraisers, translating complex biographical, philanthropic, financial, and reputational information into accurate, actionable intelligence that supports donor strategy, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, and risk-aware decision-making. The Senior Research Analyst maintains current information on priority prospects and donors and helps strengthen Development Research standards, tools, training, and data quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct proactive research projects that identify, qualify, and prioritize a pipeline of new individual, corporate, and foundation fundraising prospects, including relationship-mapping and special initiative research.
  • Collect, evaluate, analyze, organize, synthesize, and disseminate information from public, subscription, internal, and vendor sources to support accurate and informed donor strategy development.
  • Connect information across an individual’s personal, family, corporate, foundation, donor-advised fund, board, and other institutional giving vehicles to inform prospect strategy, relationship mapping, and engagement opportunities.
  • Prepare high-quality written research deliverables, including donor and prospect profiles, executive briefings, event research, due diligence summaries, relationship maps, capacity and affinity assessments, and other research reports. Ensure materials are accurate, complete, source-grounded, well organized, and appropriate for leadership and fundraiser use.
  • Serve as an embedded research partner and strategic advisor to principal, major gift, corporate, and foundation fundraisers, providing deep research support for high-priority prospects, donor meetings, special fundraising initiatives, and leadership engagement.
  • Monitor news, market trends, philanthropic activity, business developments, nonprofit filings, legal and regulatory records, and other public information relevant to priority donors and prospects.
  • Maintain accurate prospect and donor information in WWF systems of record, including CRM and affiliated document storage platforms. Donor information includes research notes, ratings, source documentation, relationship intelligence, and other data that supports portfolio strategy and prospect management.
  • Assist with training, mentoring, documentation, and quality control for Development Research products, protocols, database use, due diligence standards, vendor resources, and research workflows.
  • Maintain strong internal relationships with Development, Executive Office, Board and National Council Relations, Legal, and other WWF colleagues to support accurate research interpretation and use.
  • Maintain productive external relationships with vendors, data providers, and peer organizations to strengthen research resources, practices, and benchmarking.
  • May guide or coordinate project work by temporary staff, interns, consultants, or junior research colleagues as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic research judgment: Applies strong analytical judgment to identify what matters, assess source reliability, distinguish confirmed facts from interpretation, and produce actionable intelligence for fundraising strategy.
  • Accuracy and evidence discipline: Maintains high standards for source verification, documentation, confidentiality, and careful interpretation of sensitive information.
  • Collaboration and advisory partnership: Builds productive relationships with fundraisers and cross-functional colleagues, and communicates research insights clearly for different audiences.
  • Project management: Manages multiple research projects and deadlines, balances urgent requests with proactive work, and keeps stakeholders informed of progress and priorities.
  • Communication: Writes clear, concise, and audience-appropriate research products and presents research findings, methods, and guidance to colleagues.
  • Mentorship and knowledge sharing: Supports consistent research practice by training colleagues, documenting procedures, and modeling strong prospect research standards.
  • Adaptability and continuous learning: Stays current on fundraising research practices, data tools, philanthropic trends, and the evolving information landscape.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required. Minimum of six years of relevant experience in prospect development, fundraising research, due diligence, intelligence, library/information science, development operations, or related research required; or a master’s degree and five years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of prospect research methods, including relationship mapping, peer screening, wealth and capacity analysis, philanthropic and affinity analysis, and in-depth news and legal review.
  • Experience with prospect development and research tools such as LexisNexis/Nexis Diligence, Relationship Science, Candid, iWave, Wealth-X/Altrata, SEC/EDGAR, IRS/Form 990 resources, court and public-record databases, business databases, news platforms, CRM systems, or comparable resources.
  • Knowledge of fundraising strategy, major and principal gifts, institutional giving (corporations and foundations), prospect management, moves management, portfolio development, and donor strategy development.

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to assess source quality, reconcile conflicting information, maintain clear documentation, and avoid unsupported conclusions when working with sensitive personal, financial, philanthropic, legal, or reputational information.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, organizational, and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adjust to changing needs.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to produce accurate, complete, and well-edited written materials for leadership, fundraisers, and other internal audiences.
  • Ability to teach and explain prospect research concepts, tools, protocols, and standards through presentations, documentation, mentoring, and informal coaching.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and confidentially with staff at multiple levels, including Development, Executive Office, Board and National Council Relations, Legal, and other colleagues.
  • Knowledge of conservation, environmental, climate, biodiversity, or related philanthropic issues preferred.
  • Committed to building and strengthening a culture of inclusion within and across teams.
  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values:
    • COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home.
    • INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve.
    • RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future.
    • COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation.

*** Please note that this position is eligible for our hybrid schedule of two days a week in the Washington, DC office or 100% remote. This position does not cover relocation.

US Remote – WWF employs in all states with the exception of: Hawaii, Kentucky, Nevada, Oklahoma.

Deadline Application: This position has a close date of December 14th. Please apply on or before this date for consideration.

Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

Relocation is not provided for this position.

World Wildlife Fund (WWF) promotes equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

title: Transfer Agent
description:
WHAT WILL YOU DO?

As a Transfer Agent, you are part of the Investor Administration team in our Amsterdam office and work closely with the other Funds teams to continuously exceed our clients' expectations. You independently perform Transfer Agency tasks in accordance with the applicable legislation and the internal policies and procedures. This includes: processing transactions, contributing to regular and ad hoc fund reporting, and serving as a point of contact for fund managers and investors. You are expected to continuously develop personally and professionally, delivering added value to our fund services and contributing to the further growth of our business.

Main responsibilities are:

  • Establishing and maintaining investor registers and records in the AssetCare Portal, our own platform in which the Transfer Agency process runs;

  • Keeping the investor portal up to date so investors and fund managers have real time access to data and investor reporting and documentation;

  • Reviewing PPMs, LPAs, side letters, and subscription agreements as a part of the due diligence efforts and reporting on any findings;

  • Processing and confirming subscriptions, redemptions and transfers;

  • Processing capital calls and distributions;

  • Issuing investor reports and notices;

  • Attending to ad hoc investor requests, including Corporate Secretarial assistance;

  • Providing feedback to fund managers;

  • Communicating, maintaining relationships with and meeting the expectations of investors, fund managers, auditors, etc.;

  • Collaborating with various teams, including Investor Client Due Diligence (CDD), Fund Accounting, Compliance and our Centre of Excellence;

  • Identifying improvement opportunities and actively contributing to product and process improvement initiatives, working closely with our product manager and software engineers on the further development of the AssetCare Portal.

HOW DO YOU FIT IN THE TEAM?

As of 1 January 2027, Trustmoore Fund Services continues as AssetCare. Our Investor Administration team supports fund managers and their investors, primarily operating Netherlands domiciled funds, but also Belgian, US and other international funds. In this position, you need to be a real team player, have a hands-on and can-do work mentality, and enjoy working in a dynamic, technology driven environment. You are proactive, know what you are capable of, possess good communication and organizational skills, and are not afraid of asking questions.

Other relevant qualifications for this profile:

  • Have a minimum bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business administration or law or equivalent level of working and thinking;

  • At least 2 years of relevant fund experience within the financial sector;

  • Experience in the field of private equity and venture capital is considered an advantage;

  • Hands-on experience with investor commitments, capital calls and distributions;

  • Affinity with technology and digital ways of working, and eager to master our AssetCare Portal;

  • Knowledge of relevant regulations such as AIFMD, Wwft and FATCA/CRS;

  • Excellent command of English, both spoken and written. Dutch is a plus;

  • Self motivated, quality focused, and business minded with the ability to deliver excellent service to our clients;

  • Willingness to develop your professional skills in an international environment;

  • Personal credibility, integrity, high moral standards, and

  • Highly meticulous and detail oriented.

Do you recognize yourself in this profile? We can’t wait to meet you!

description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Relocation Project Manager


What this job involves:

JLL is seeking an experienced Relocation Project Manager to lead corporate moves and relocation projects for our clients from initial planning through final execution. In this role, you will be the trusted point of contact who keeps every detail on track—budgets, schedules, vendors, and stakeholders—while delivering the kind of seamless, high-touch service our clients expect. At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way—for our clients, ourselves, and our fellow employees—and this role is an opportunity to bring that vision to every move you lead. We embrace more innovative ways of working and prioritize opportunities to strengthen and advance your career, so you will have the support and runway to grow as both a project leader and a trusted advisor to clients.


What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage all project activities for assigned accounts, overseeing planning, scheduling, and implementation of project scope from kickoff through completion
  • Facilitate project kick-off meetings with internal teams and key stakeholders to ensure roles and responsibilities are clearly understood
  • Collaborate with clients, facility managers, and construction managers to refine project goals, plans, and budgets

  • Identify and mitigate potential risks and liabilities throughout the project lifecycle
  • Procure and evaluate vendors, outside labor, and supporting suppliers, including technology, telephony, and furniture providers
  • Maintain accurate occupancy data within client systems and deliver project-specific reporting
  • Represent JLL at industry and networking events, partnering with business line leaders to support account and market growth

Required qualifications:

  • Proven success managing relocations involving 200+ employees
  • Proficiency in FM Systems move management module and/or comparable facilities management systems
  • Proficiency in Corrigo
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Project skills, with proficiency across the Microsoft Office suite
  • Strong working knowledge of architectural drawings, furniture, and space planning concepts
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to identify and manage competing priorities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executive-level internal and external stakeholders
  • Flexibility with work hours and travel as business needs require

Preferred qualifications:

  • Background in project management, construction management, architecture, or project strategy planning
  • Experience serving as a subject matter expert to support business development efforts
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving complex, cross-functional problems
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to multi-task independently and collaboratively within a team
  • Experience determining pricing for non-baseline work, such as construction needs or furniture reconfigurations
  • Familiarity with sponsoring or facilitating idea-sharing initiatives within a team, reflecting our belief that the most effective teams are built when everyone is empowered to thrive

title: Head of Medical, CEE
description:
The Head of Medical, CEE+ leads the CEE+ Medical Affairs agenda across affiliates, platform resources and partner markets. The role delivers strategic, scientific leadership and patient-centred value for external and internal stakeholders, in line with SOPs and Sobi Medical Playbook:

The role combines:

  • About 40%: Hands-on asset leader. For the assigned asset, the Head of Medical personally owns the regional scientific agenda, working directly with affiliates and top KOLs. This follows the working model of the Medical Lead CEE role: translating Sobi strategy into scientific communication, KOL engagement, evidence generation and field execution.
  • About 60%: Leader of the portfolio team. The Head of Medical builds, coaches and directs the CEE+ medical platform Medical Leads who are accountable for the remaining therapeutic areas in the Sobi portfolio, and ensures consistent standards, prioritisation and execution quality across affiliates and partner markets.

The role is a matrix leadership position. Success depends on partnership and stakeholder alignment around one coherent science agenda for CEE. The holder is expected to be agile, to anticipate change, and to bring clarity in a fast-moving environment.

Main responsibilities:

  • Lead the development, resourcing, execution, and follow-up of CEE+ Medical Affairs plans and support affiliate LMIP plans, aligned with global strategy, brand plans, launch priorities, partner-market needs, and business objectives, with 40% focus on driving designated asset & BD agenda
  • Provide matrix medical leadership to CEE+ affiliates and partner markets, leading CEE+MLT, support CEERJ Medical Agenda (participant in Core Medical Team), and support local planning, execution quality, prioritization, launch readiness.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the CEE+ medical platform team, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, objectives, KPIs, performance expectations, and development plans.
  • Ensure Medical Affairs delivers strong external and internal value through high-quality scientific engagement, impactful field execution, structured insight generation, evidence-based activities, and compliant medical communication.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Cross-functional team CEE+ and other Commercial, PACE, RDMA, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Quality, Geo-Expansion, Portfolio Management, Finance, HR, partner organizations, other functions.
  • Represent CEE+ Medical Affairs in relevant regional, global, and local forums, including CEERJ ELT, strategic projects (e.g. Field capabilities); back up line manager in CEE Grant committee, CEERJ LT & workflows ISS, MAP approvals, Veeva
  • Ensure governance and compliance across all CEE+ medical activities, including medical plans, deliverables, materials, external interactions, field engagements, partner-market activities, advisory boards, medical education, & cross-functional initiatives
  • University degree in a medical-science background or other relevant discipline; medical, clinical or research experience in the assigned disease area is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in both pre-launch and launch activities, in country and above country, with increasing responsibility.
  • Strong track record in engagement with KOLs locally and internationally.
  • Knowledge of health system and healthcare decision-making, including the regulatory, safety, legal and compliance environment.
  • Multi-stakeholder project management and leadership experience, delivering on time and within budget
  • Proven matrix leadership: influencing affiliates, general managers and global teams without formal authority.
  • In-depth people leadership: recruiting, managing and developing a medical team with a performance plan, including coaching across different capability levels and country maturity.
  • Personal accountability and ownership, with continuous focus on performance and operational excellence.
  • Ability to exchange scientific ideas with KOLs and HCPs and to present scientific data to small and large audiences.
  • Ability to quickly build therapeutic area competency of the assigned asset, and ability to oversee other disease areas through the team.
  • Experience with evidence generation, publications and scientific dissemination, .
  • Experience of reimbursed patient access projects is highly desirable.
  • Effective listening skills; ability to work in virtual and multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills; above-average computer skills.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English; other CEE languages are an asset.

Additional Information:

  • Frequent regional and international travel is required, approximately 30% of working time.
  • Availability for external meetings, congresses and internal meetings outside standard hours with advance notice.
  • Valid driver's license may be required depending on local role set-up.
  • The role may be home-based or hybrid depending on country, local employment set-up and business requirements.

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

title: Cash Application Jr Analyst
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Analista Junior de Cash Application – JLL

En qué consiste este puesto:

El Analista Junior de Cash Application forma parte del equipo de Controllership para la región de Latinoamérica dentro de JLL. Esta posición es clave para garantizar la correcta aplicación de pagos de clientes, la precisión de las cuentas por cobrar y la resolución oportuna de discrepancias financieras. El rol contribuye directamente a la salud financiera de la organización, asegurando cierres mensuales confiables y procesos de conciliación bancaria y contable sólidos. Es una excelente oportunidad para profesionales en formación que buscan desarrollar una base técnica robusta en finanzas corporativas dentro de un entorno dinámico y colaborativo.

Cómo será tu día a día:

  • Revisar, validar y conciliar los pagos recibidos de clientes contra las facturas pendientes en el sistema.
  • Aplicar pagos con precisión y oportunidad en las cuentas por cobrar correspondientes.
  • Actualizar y depurar la información de cuentas por cobrar, incluyendo saldos y datos de clientes.
  • Identificar y dar seguimiento proactivo a discrepancias de pago (sobrepagos, pagos parciales, descuentos no autorizados).
  • Coordinar con clientes y áreas internas para resolver diferencias y escalar casos complejos cuando sea necesario.
  • Apoyar en la preparación de conciliaciones bancarias y contables mensuales relacionadas con tesorería.
  • Colaborar con el equipo para asegurar el cierre mensual oportuno y la correcta documentación de partidas pendientes.

Calificaciones requeridas:

  • Bachillerato en Contabilidad.
  • Cursando los primeros años de la carrera universitaria en Contabilidad, Finanzas o afín.
  • Conocimientos sólidos de contabilidad básica y manejo de cuentas por cobrar.
  • Manejo básico-intermedio de Microsoft Excel.
  • Excelente atención al detalle y precisión numérica.
  • Habilidades de comunicación para coordinar con clientes y áreas internas.
  • Español nativo o avanzado.

Calificaciones preferidas:

  • 1 a 2 años de experiencia en centros de servicios financieros compartidos (Shared Services).
  • Experiencia específica en aplicación de pagos (Cash Application), cuentas por cobrar o conciliaciones bancarias.
  • Capacidad de aprendizaje de sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle u otros) y plataformas bancarias.
  • Comprensión de procesos de conciliación bancaria.
  • Conocimiento de métodos de pago corporativos (transferencias electrónicas).
  • Inglés básico-intermedio.
  • Capacidad de trabajo bajo presión en periodos de cierre.

title: Projectmedewerker Finance - EFA
description:
In de functie van Projectmedewerker finance is geen dag hetzelfde. Naast het beantwoorden van vragen uit de praktijk rondom de (financiële) administratie van individuele projecten kun je denken aan het uitvoeren van de volgende werkzaamheden:

  • Het bewaken en beheren van de financiële voortgang van opdrachten
  • Verbindt als eerste aanspreekpunt de praktijk met de achterliggende supportorganisatie;
  • Identificeert en lost projectmatig knelpunten in het financieel administratieve proces voor klanten en projecten op, bijvoorbeeld in het facturatieproces;
  • Signaleert tijdig eventuele verstoringen in het proces of eventuele andere afwijkingen ten opzichte van de richtlijnen en escaleert waar nodig;
  • Beoordeelt samen met de praktijk de overige werkzaamheden die gestandaardiseerd kunnen worden en wat de optimale procesinrichting daarvoor is, waarbij de samenwerking wordt gezocht met collega’s in India;
  • Brengt financiële/ SAP gerelateerde kennis over aan de praktijk;
  • Schakelt nauw met managers, partners en de COO’s om een constante feedbackloop te waarborgen.

Je bent in staat de vertaalslag te maken van (interne) procedures en richtlijnen naar concrete acties, oplossingen en procesverbeteringen. Daarbij weet je een goede balans te vinden tussen uitvoering, adviseren en kennisoverdracht. Dankzij jouw stressbestendigheid, flexibiliteit in het schakelen tussen diverse werkzaamheden en klanten, én je sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, ben je in staat om je vele stakeholders effectief te managen. Ook ben je een echte team player en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de aan jou toegekende taken en projecten.

Verder heb je als Projectmedewerker Finance:

  • een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding, bij voorkeur richting Finance;
  • enige ervaring in een finance (gerelateerde project) positie;
  • een goede beheersing van de Engelse en Nederlandse, in woord en geschrift;
  • uitstekende kennis van Excel.

Voor de projectteams ben jij als Medewerker Projectadministratie het onmisbare eerste aanspreekpunt en vervul je daarmee een sleutelrol voor onze projectadministratie. Je bent een deskundig adviseur als het aankomt op de richtlijnen, processen en systemen rondom de projectadministratie en fungeert als sparringpartner voor de praktijk voor wat betreft financiële vraagstukken rondom klanten en projecten. Het is hierin een hybride functie, waarbij je afwisselend vanuit kantoor Rotterdam en Utrecht werkt, maar ook de mogelijkheid hebt om thuis te werken. Binnen Finance krijg je de mogelijkheid om in verschillende richtingen te ontwikkelen en groeien.

title: PCT - Float
description:
PURPOSE AND SCOPE:

Functions as part of the dialysis health care team in providing safe and effective dialysis therapy for patients under the direct supervision of a licensed nurse in accordance with organization policies, procedures, and training and in compliance with regulations set forth by the corporation, state, and federal agencies. Responsible for the setup and operation of hemodialysis machines. Assist in the maintenance of a safe and clean working environment. Supports the organization commitment to the Quality Enhancement Program (QEP) and CQI Activities, including those related to patient satisfaction and actively participates in process improvement activities that enhance the likelihood that patients will achieve the organization Quality Enhancement Goals (QEP).

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Patient Related

Education:

  • Assist other health care members in providing patient specific detailed education regarding adequacy measures where appropriate - Online Clearance Monitoring (OLC), Adequacy Monitoring Program (AMP), Urea Kinetic Modeling (UKM), and regarding disease process/access.

Treatment:

  • Welcome assigned patients and inquire as to their wellbeing since their last treatment.

  • Evaluate vascular access for patency, perform vascular access cannulation, and perform administration of heparin as delegated or as allowed by state law.

  • Obtain necessary pre and post treatment vital signs and weight and perform vascular access evaluation pre- treatment

  • Initiate dialysis treatment according to prescribed orders including blood flow (QB) and dialysate flow (QD).

  • Evaluate intradialytic problems and provide intervention as prescribed by physician order or as directed.

  • Monitor patients’ response to dialysis therapy.

  • Obtain vital signs prior to reinfusion; perform all relevant functions necessary for the discontinuation of treatment - document.

  • Discontinue dialysis treatment according to established procedures and evaluate patient prior to termination of venous access - standing & sitting blood pressure

  • Obtain Hemostasis and apply appropriate dressings.

  • Evaluate the patient prior to discharge.

  • Perform and record Pre and Post dialysis evaluation, weight, and vital signs with initial identification

  • Responsible for calculating and entry of individual patients’ dialysis machine programming for Ultrafiltration (UF) goal; treatment time; and UF modeling as prescribed.

  • Responsible for ensuring appropriate safety alarms are enabled, including Narrow Venous Limits, (NVL) 160.

  • Record accurate and timely information regarding vital signs and treatment parameters onto the Hemodialysis Treatment Sheet with initial identification

  • Responsible for accurate documentation of information related to patient treatment including completion of Hemodialysis Treatment Sheet and, if applicable, progress notes.

  • Report any significant information and/or change in patient condition directly to the registered nurse or supervisor.

  • Observe patient and conduct machine safety checks according to facility policy. Report any change or unusual findings to the registered nurse or supervisor.

  • Perform and document any intervention for unusual patient status and document patients' response to intervention.

  • Evaluate patients’ vascular access during treatment including arterial and venous monitoring pressures, provide appropriate intervention as needed, document and report any unusual findings to the registered nurse or supervisor.

  • Obtain all prescribed laboratory testing and prepare specimens for collection.

  • Ensure that all blood spills are immediately cleaned with appropriate disinfectant according to facility policy.

  • Prepare, organize, and efficiently utilize supplies and equipment to prevent wastage.

  • Monitors patients performing self-care under the supervision of RN.

Staff Related

  • Assists in training of applicable direct patient care staff on appropriate programs under the supervision of a nurse.

Education/Communication:

  • Follows all organization business policies, procedures and systems incorporated into training, including compliance with ethical business practices

  • Maintain environmental integrity and aesthetics - ensure all areas are safe and clean.

  • Clean and disinfect dialysis machine surface, chair, equipment, and surrounding area between treatments according to facility policy.

  • Conduct all tasks necessary for preparation for dialysis treatment and document where appropriate and perform all required pretreatment dialysis machine alarm testing including Pressure Holding (PHT).

  • Initiate Solution Delivery System (SDS) system.

RECORD KEEPING:

  • Complete and document ongoing participation in Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) activities.

  • Enters all treatment data into the designated clinical application in an accurate and timely manner.

  • Review treatment sheets for completeness, ensure nursing signatures are documented, and ensure

omitted entries are completed or corrected by appropriate staff.

  • Prepare initial patient chart for admission and compile paperwork for appropriate placement in chart.

  • Prepare/print lab requisitions for prescribed or stat Lab specimens according to laboratory destination.

  • Collect, label, appropriately prepare and store lab samples according required laboratory specifications.

  • Ensure collection of lab specimens by appropriate lab courier.

INFECTION CONTROL:

  • Assists in collecting information for infection control audits.

  • Supports staff and patient Adherence to infection control practices.

  • Follows infection control Policies and Procedures

  • Participates in and reinforces infection control education of patients and families under the direction of the CM or designee as allowed by state law.

TRANSITIONAL CARE UNIT:

  • Follows all newly admitted patients through their first 4 weeks of dialysis and coordinating their transitional dialysis care

  • Reinforces all education and care related matters as it relates to the new patient as allowed by state law

  • Liaisons with appropriate FKC staff members to provide the best patient experience including making sure all disciplines are scheduled to see patient according to plan.

  • Assists in assuring patient understanding or home dialysis products, benefits of home and how home dialysis can work for them.

  • Sets and preforms a treatment on all machines used in the transitional care unit.

  • Assist in assuring patient understanding of treatment options including demonstration of the peritoneal dialysis set-up.

  • Assists with coordination of transition to patient’s modality choice.

  • Assists with supply ordering and inventory for TCU

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee

encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable

individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Employees are required to take the Ishihara's Color Blindness test as a condition of employment. Note that: Failing the

Ishihara Test for Color Blindness does not preclude employment. The Company will consider whether reasonable

accommodations can be made.

  • Day to day work includes desk and personal computer work and interaction with patients, facility staff, and physicians. The position requires travel between assigned facilities and various locations within the community. Travel to regional, Business Unit and Corporate meetings may be required.

  • The work environment is characteristic of a health care facility with air temperature control and moderate noise levels. May be exposed to infectious and contagious diseases/materials

  • The position provides direct patient care that regularly involves heavy lifting and moving of patients and assisting with ambulation. Equipment aids and/or coworkers may provide assistance. This position requires frequent, prolonged periods of standing and the employee must be able to bend over. The employee may occasionally be required to push and/or pull equipment, exerting up to 15 pounds of force. The employee may be required to lift and to lower solutions on a frequent basis of up to 30 lbs., and on an occasional lift basis up to 40 lbs., as high as 5 feet. There is a two-person assist program and "material assist” devices for the heavier items.

EDUCATION AND LICENSES:

  • High School diploma or G.E.D. required.

  • Must meet Center for Medicaid/Medicare Services (CMS)-approved state and/or national certification requirements within the required state or CMS timeline.

  • All appropriate state licensure, education, and training (if any) required.

  • Demonstrated commitment to organization culture, values, and customer service standards

EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • Previous patient care experience in a hospital setting or a related facility preferred.

  • Continued employment is dependent on successful completion of the organization dialysis training program and successful completion of CPR certification.

title: Internship Vision-Guided Robotics for Smart robot Calibration & Troubleshooting
description:
Imagine a robot that can not only perform predefined movements, but can also understand whether its physical environment is ready for operation. During this internship, you will develop a vision-based solution that helps make an automated packaging system smarter and more robust.

Within our development project, a robot handles bottles and crates using predefined positions and movements. Your challenge is to add an intelligent vision layer without making vision part of the robot's primary control loop. Instead, your solution will help the robot automatically calibrate relevant positions, verify that the starting situation is correct and provide valuable information when the normal process cannot continue.

This gives you the opportunity to combine robotics, computer vision and software development with hands-on experimentation. You will work directly on the prototype in the Innovation Factory at the Lely Campus in Maassluis, collaborating with experienced engineers from different disciplines. Your work will move from researching suitable technologies to seeing your own algorithms perform on a physical robot.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Evaluate suitable 2D and 3D vision technologies for the packaging setup.
  • Develop algorithms that detect objects and determine their position and orientation.
  • Create an automatic calibration approach that uses vision to determine and verify relevant robot positions.
  • Develop methods to recognise incorrect starting conditions and identify potential root causes when the process cannot continue.
  • Interface vision results with the robot environment and collaborate with engineers to integrate your solution into the existing system.
  • Test, refine and validate your solution on the actual packaging prototype.

You are studying Robotics, Computer & Embedded Systems Engineering, or a comparable technical programme and want to apply your knowledge to a real robotic system. You enjoy exploring how software, vision and physical hardware interact and are motivated by turning an idea into something you can demonstrate on an actual robot.

Additionally, you bring the following:

  • An interest in robotics and computer vision, with the motivation to deepen your knowledge of 2D and 3D vision technologies.
  • A proactive mindset. You take ownership of your work, explore technologies and actively involve the right people when you need input.
  • A creative approach to engineering. You enjoy experimenting with different ways to make a robot understand its physical environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, allowing you to move from observed robot behaviour to possible causes, experiments and practical solutions.
  • An interest in developing, programming and testing your work on physical hardware rather than limiting your solution to simulation.

At Lely, we offer you an educational and dynamic internship experience at one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You’ll become part of a driven team and have plenty of opportunities to further develop your talents.

  • An international working environment
  • An internship allowance of €650 per month based on a 40-hour work week
  • A student apartment if your commute is too long
  • Our modern Lely Campus gives you daily access to extensive sports facilities: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, a basketball and volleyball court, as well as table tennis and foosball. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training – and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
  • Enjoy fresh coffee and tea from our in-house barista, made with milk straight from our farm, and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.
  • A free shuttle bus takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
  • We’re also proud that our dedication and vision have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneur Award 2025!

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About the opportunity

AI Engineering builds the shared agent platform behind Xplor's AI capabilities: the agent runtime, model gateway, retrieval, guardrails, evaluations, and cost controls. We build the hard parts once, so every product team can ship AI features faster and safely.

We're looking for a hands-on Site Reliability Engineer to own how our agent platform behaves in production. AI workloads bring new reliability problems: long streaming responses, background agents, model-provider quotas, outputs that can fail silently, agents that take real actions, and spend that grow with usage. You'll treat them as first-class engineering problems. As AI agents take on more of our operational work, you'll decide what they're allowed to do and make sure they do it safely.

Why this role is exciting

  • Reliability for a new kind of workload. The playbook for running AI agents in production is still being written, and you'll help write it.
  • Scale with real stakes. A multi-tenant platform serving thousands of businesses, and AI features they depend on to run their day.
  • Greenfield foundations. Define the SLOs, alerting, game days, agent guardrails, and standard deployment paths that every product team will build on.
  • Cost is an engineering problem. Token economics, model routing and cost per task matter as much as uptime.
  • AI-native operations. Use AI agents to automate toil, speed up investigations and improve infrastructure code; with the approval gates, scoped permissions and audit trails that make it safe.

What you’ll do

  • Define SLOs and error budgets for agent APIs, streaming and background work, including quality signals like task success, tool-call failures and evaluation regressions, and alert on what matters to customers.
  • Own the platform's AWS infrastructure (ECS on Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, Redis and Amazon Bedrock) as Terraform delivered through Spacelift.
  • Build observability in Datadog and Coralogix with OpenTelemetry, including AI signals like token usage, provider latency and cost per task.
  • Make data stores resilient, with tested backups and restores, failover, defined disaster recovery targets (RTO/RPO) and safe migrations.
  • Build resilience into the model layer: provider failover, quota and rate-limit management, and safe rollout and rollback of model and prompt changes.
  • Protect the platform under multi-tenant load with per-tenant quotas, isolation and circuit breakers that stop runaway agents and runaway spend.
  • Partner with Security on operational controls for AI risks, including prompt injection, excessive agent permissions and unbounded consumption (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
  • Set the guardrails for AI agents that work on our infrastructure: what they can change, which actions need human approval, and how every action is audited.
  • Work with Security and Privacy to keep model inference and customer data in the right regions for customers in Australia, New Zealand, the US, the UK and the EU.
  • Lead incident response and blameless reviews, take part in on-call, and run game days for the failures that matter most.
  • Make deployments safe by default, and give product teams simple, standard ways to run agent workloads.
  • Track and reduce cloud and model spend.

Our stack

  • Cloud: AWS: ECS on Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL with pgvector, ElastiCache Redis, CloudFront, Route 53, Secrets Manager and SSM
  • AI: Amazon Bedrock and other model providers behind a multi-provider gateway
  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, delivered through Spacelift
  • Observability: Datadog, Coralogix and OpenTelemetry
  • Delivery: GitHub Actions, containers, Amazon ECR and preview environments

This position has an annual base salary range of $150,000 to $180,000 USD.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based anywhere in the U.S., excluding Hawaii and Alaska. We’d prefer candidates in the Eastern or Central time zones.

#LI-Remote

What would make me a good candidate?

  • 7+ years in SRE, DevOps or platform engineering, running multi-tenant SaaS in production
  • Strong AWS experience and Terraform at scale (Spacelift, Terraform Cloud, Atlantis or similar)
  • Experience building SLO-based alerting and observability with Datadog or similar tools, ideally with OpenTelemetry
  • A track record of leading incidents calmly and turning post-incident reviews into lasting fixes
  • Hands-on PostgreSQL operations: backups, point-in-time recovery, performance tuning and upgrades
  • Production-quality coding skills for automation and tooling
  • A least-privilege mindset and a disciplined approach to using AI tools

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience running LLM or AI workloads in production, or a real interest in learning how they fail differently from traditional services
  • Use of AI agents to automate operational work, such as incident triage, runbooks or infrastructure-code review, and a clear sense of where human review still matters
  • Experience in regulated environments such as SOC 2 or PCI DSS
  • Amazon Bedrock quotas and inference profiles, policy as code, LLM evaluation, AI security tooling, or multi-region data-residency requirements

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersection of differences - people of different cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you don’t quite tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

  • Paid Parental Leave benefit programs
  • #GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community
  • Ongoing dedication to Diversity & Inclusion initiatives such as D&I Council, Global Mentorship Program
  • Access to free mental health support
  • Flexible working arrangements

Ready to apply?

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad.

Before you apply

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is advertised. This applies to remote roles too. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.

Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.

We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .

Interview Recording and Background Checks

As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards.

EEO and Artificial Intelligence

We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.

Xplor is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We're dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status and age. We encourage applications from all sectors of the community. All Information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Xplor is committed to fully including all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Xplor will take steps to ensure people with disabilities receive reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us via talent@xplortechnologies.com.

We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.

title: Civil Technician III
description:
Advance your career with us and be part of a mission-driven team delivering critical telecommunications and recovery solutions.
At InfraServices, we’re more than a services provider — we’re innovators, problem-solvers, and collaborators. Our culture is built on a foundation of safety first, guided by a customer-focused philosophy, and defined by excellence and integrity.
Here, every voice is heard, fresh ideas are celebrated, and exceptional talent is valued. We’re committed to building an employee experience rooted in trust, respect, continuous learning, and growth opportunities. Whether you’re building cutting-edge infrastructure, supporting field operations, or driving business development, you’ll play a vital role in upholding our core values and delivering on our business objectives.

Job Summary: The Civil Technician III serves as the senior-level technician responsible for leading civil crews in general construction activities on wireless telecommunications sites, including the site layout, foundation, grounding, laying conduit and fiber, and general landscaping. This role requires advanced technical knowledge, strong leadership, and the ability to ensure work is completed safely, on time, and to quality standards. This position plays a key role in training team members, coordinating site activities, and ensuring compliance with all safety and regulatory requirements.
The Civil Technician III is responsible for assisting with the general construction activities on wireless telecommunications sites and related infrastructure, including the site layout, foundation, grounding, laying conduit and fiber, and general landscaping. This position works under the guidance of experienced civil technicians and foremen to develop the skills necessary for advancement in the field.
Interested in earning your CDL? InfraServices will help you build new skills and invest in your professional development by covering the cost of obtaining your Commercial Driver’s License.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Serve as the lead technician on site, directing daily crew operations and ensuring adherence to scope, safety, and quality standards.
• Lead and perform site layout for cell tower construction, including electrical and telecommunications infrastructure, with minimal supervision.
• Use and guide others in the use of hand and power tools to complete site work, including trenching, concrete placement, rebar installation, and grading/land clearing.
• Support and execute advanced civil work, including setting shelters, constructing culverts and access roadways, and performing basic soil stabilization and correction activities.
• Install, route, and connect jumpers and cables to ground equipment, verifying proper installation and system integrity.
• Construct, assemble, and inspect rebar cages for foundations and concrete structures in accordance with project specifications.
• Document site progress through photographs and field reporting, ensuring accuracy and completeness for project tracking.
• Interpret and ensure execution of construction drawings, site plans, and RF specifications.
• Perform advanced testing and troubleshooting, including sweep testing, PIM testing, and fiber/connector inspections.
• Conduct quality assurance checks and ensure all work is completed according to customer and Company standards.
• Maintain and inspect equipment to ensure proper use and safety.
• Model safe behavior on-site and ensure crew participation in all safety protocols, meetings, and briefings.
• Complete required documentation accurately, including daily reports, quality checklists, and site photos.
• Maintain and organize tools, equipment, and vehicles.
• Maintain a clean and organized job site, ensuring all tools, materials, and waste are properly handled and disposed of.
• Assist the foreman in training, mentoring, and supporting less experienced team members in both technical skills and safety practices.
• Travel regularly to job sites, which may include overnight stays.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

Education: High school diploma, general education degree (G.E.D.), or related trade school education

Experience:
• Three to five years of progressive experience in wireless telecommunications construction, maintenance, or field services
• Experience overseeing crews and supporting field operations
• Proven ability to complete complex construction and electrical work independently and guide others
• Must have or obtain and maintain OSHA 30 Construction Training Card
• Must have or obtain and maintain First Aid and CPR certification
• Other relevant certifications may be required per the scope of work being performed (i.e., NWSA Certification, Hazcom Certification, Blood Borne Pathogen Certification, RF Safety Certification, etc.)
• A CDL is not required upon hire. This position offers reimbursement for employees interested in obtaining their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL).
Technical Skills:
• Computer and Microsoft Office proficiency
• Applied mathematical skills and calculation ability
• Advanced knowledge of wireless communication infrastructure and equipment
• Working knowledge of RF testing equipment and the ability to support or perform cable and antenna system testing and interpret basic results
• Strong ability to interpret construction drawings, RF data, and customer specifications; ensures work aligns with project requirements
• Proficient in the use of hand and power tools
• Proficiency in operating heavy equipment such as excavators and skid steers
• Competence with GPS, test equipment, and site audit tools
Soft Skills:
• Strong leadership and decision-making skills
• Follows safety protocols and installation procedures with accuracy and care, and requires others to do the same
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Works effectively with crew members and foreman; supports a positive and collaborative work environment
• Ability to manage time and resources efficiently
• Ability to think analytically and solve complex problems
• Maintains awareness of surroundings and safety risks while working at heights and with heavy equipment
• Encourages continuous improvement and identifies areas for process enhancement
Physical Requirements:
• Must be able to pass pre-employment screening that includes background and drug testing
• Must have a valid driver’s license and a driving record that meets Company requirements
• Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 75 pounds regularly
• Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, reach, and grasp materials and tools with both hands
• Ability to work long hours in outdoor environments, including extreme weather conditions such as heat, cold, rain, wind, or snow
• Ability to stand, walk, and perform physically demanding tasks for extended periods of time

Employee Benefits:

At InfraServices, taking care of our people is a top priority. That’s why we’ve built a strong benefits program designed to support you and your family, giving you the security you deserve. We know benefits are an essential part of your overall compensation, and we’re committed to offering a competitive package that reflects the value you bring. Below is a quick look at what we offer.

Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits: We've got your health covered.
Short- & Long-Term Disability Benefits: Protection when you need it most.
Company Paid Basic Life Insurance: Additional voluntary benefits are available.
Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Plans: Added security for you and your loved ones.
Flexible Spending Accounts: Manage your finances with flexibility.
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Support when life throws challenges your way.
Wellness Program: Resources and programs designed to support your overall health and well-being.
401(K) with Company match: Building your financial future with us.
Paid Time Off, Paid Sick Time, & Company Holidays: Achieving that work-life balance.
Paid Parental & Paid Maternity Leave: Supporting your family is our priority.
Military Differential Pay: Income protection for employees serving in the military.
Employee Referral Program: Share the opportunities and reap the rewards.
Company Discount Program: Enjoy savings on everyday expenses.
Legal Assistance: Affordable legal support for employees.

title: Solution Architect (fulltime of parttime)
description:
Als Solution Architect binnen SSC-IT / Business Applications & Services geef je richting aan de ontwikkeling van ons applicatielandschap. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de business, Application Experts, projectteams en Enterprise Architecture. Je brengt businessbehoeften, inhoudelijke expertise en architectuurkaders samen en vertaalt deze naar samenhangende, toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Je maakt deel uit van het Solution Architecture-team en bent breed inzetbaar over verschillende businessdomeinen en projecten. Je primaire focus ligt in eerste instantie binnen Integrated Supply Chain, waar onder andere planning, sourcing, productie, logistiek en warehousing samenkomen. Tegelijkertijd blijft jouw rol domeinoverstijgend en kun je ook op andere vraagstukken binnen Business Applications worden ingezet.

Je kijkt verder dan technologie alleen. Je brengt strategie, processen, data, applicaties, integraties, infrastructuur, beheer, privacy en security samen in een toekomstbestendige oplossing. Daarbij zorg je dat keuzes niet alleen het vraagstuk van vandaag oplossen, maar ook passen binnen de langetermijnrichting van Lely.

  • Je vertaalt businessdoelstellingen en complexe vraagstukken naar heldere solution architectures en high-level designs.
  • Je stelt Project Start Architectures op en ontwikkelt deze gedurende projecten verder volgens het principe just enough, just in time.
  • Je vertaalt principes en standaarden vanuit Enterprise Architecture naar concrete en werkbare kaders voor projecten en oplossingen.
  • Je toetst detailontwerpen aan de afgesproken solution architecture en bewaakt de samenhang tussen processen, data, applicaties, integraties, infrastructuur, security en beheer.
  • Je brengt oplossingsalternatieven, afhankelijkheden, risico’s en trade-offs in beeld en adviseert over de functionele, technische, financiële en security-impact.
  • Je legt architectuurbeslissingen en eventuele afwijkingen zorgvuldig vast en houdt relevante architectuur- en technische documentatie actueel.
  • Je signaleert mogelijkheden voor standaardisatie, vereenvoudiging, integratie, rationalisatie en vernieuwing van het applicatielandschap.
  • Je bewaakt de consistentie van oplossingen over projecten en businessdomeinen heen.
  • Je volgt relevante markt- en technologieontwikkelingen en onderzoekt hoe deze waarde kunnen toevoegen aan Lely.

Verbinder en trusted advisor

Een belangrijk deel van jouw impact ontstaat in de samenwerking met anderen. Je bent een inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor business stakeholders, proces- en data-eigenaren, Application Experts, Enterprise en Domain Architects, projectmanagers, leveranciers en andere specialisten. Je begrijpt hun verschillende perspectieven en brengt deze samen in één consistente oplossingsrichting.

Complexiteit toegankelijk maken

Je brengt complexe technische onderwerpen terug tot de essentie en maakt de impact en consequenties begrijpelijk voor zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Zo creëer je een gedeeld begrip en maak je goede besluitvorming mogelijk.

Stakeholdermanagement

Je bouwt sterke relaties op, verbindt verschillende belangen en creëert draagvlak voor architectuurkeuzes. Je weet te adviseren, beïnvloeden en richting te geven, ook zonder formele hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur binnen IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Ruime ervaring als Solution Architect, IT Architect, Lead Consultant of in een vergelijkbare rol.
  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om complexe technische onderwerpen helder, toegankelijk en doelgroepgericht te maken.
  • Sterke stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden: je verbindt belangen, creëert draagvlak en helpt besluitvorming vooruit.
  • Het vermogen om te adviseren, beïnvloeden en richting te geven zonder formele hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid.
  • Ervaring met het ontwerpen en implementeren van complexe applicatie- en integratieoplossingen.
  • Een brede technische achtergrond, met aantoonbare verdieping in één of meerdere IT-disciplines.
  • Ervaring met requirements, solution design, oplossingsalternatieven, technologieselectie en ontwerpkeuzes.
  • Kennis van architectuur- en modelleringstechnieken, zoals TOGAF, ArchiMate, BPMN en UML.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

Een sterke pre: ervaring of aantoonbare affiniteit met supply chain-processen, zoals planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistiek of warehousing, en met de applicaties, data en integraties die deze processen ondersteunen.


Voor deze functie is een pre-employment screening van toepassing, bestaande uit een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) en een achtergrond- en integriteitsonderzoek. Omdat je in deze rol toegang hebt tot gevoelige bedrijfs- en klantinformatie, hechten wij veel waarde aan een zorgvuldige screening. De screening dient met succes te zijn afgerond voordat je in dienst kunt treden. De kosten voor de VOG-aanvraag worden door Lely vergoed. Uiteraard gaan wij zorgvuldig om met jouw persoonsgegevens en verwerken wij deze conform onze privacyverklaring.

Werken bij Lely betekent bijdragen aan duurzame vooruitgang binnen een van de meest innovatieve organisaties van Nederland. Jij draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de agrarische sector, en wij zorgen dat jij daar alle ruimte, middelen en ondersteuning voor krijgt.

  • Een internationale werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap.
  • Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder tot 8 weken vakantie per jaar en een goede pensioenregeling.
  • Een salaris binnen de schaal van € 5.867,- tot € 8.381- bruto per maand, waarin we graag zien dat er vanaf je startsalaris nog groeiruimte is richting de toekomst.
  • Tijdens de kerstvakantie is de Lely Campus twee weken gesloten (afhankelijk van je functie).
  • Goede doorgroeimogelijkheden, jij bent in regie over je ontwikkeling en kunt kiezen uit diverse trainingen via onze Lely Academy, van persoonlijke ontwikkeling tot vakspecifieke opleidingen.
  • Onze moderne Lely Campus biedt dagelijks toegang tot uitgebreide sportfaciliteiten, een indoor gym, outdoor padelbanen, een basketbal- en volleybalveld buiten, tafeltennis en tafelvoetbal. Je kunt meedoen aan Hyrox-workouts of je inschrijven voor personal training en je collega’s uitdagen tijdens een actieve pauze.
  • Geniet van verse koffie en thee van onze eigen barista, met melk rechtstreeks van onze boerderij, én een gezond en betaalbaar bedrijfsrestaurant.
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans dankzij ons hybride werkbeleid, je werkt minimaal drie dagen per week op de Campus, met flexibele werktijden en volop ruimte om extra tijd op locatie door te brengen tussen 06:00 en 20:00 uur.
  • Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan een preventief medisch onderzoek.
  • Een gratis shuttlebus brengt je van en naar de metro in Maassluis, zodat jouw werkdag soepel begint en eindigt.
  • Successen moeten gevierd worden, van jubilea tot kerstfeesten, bij Lely weten we hoe we dat aanpakken!

Recruitment & selectie bureau, consultancy en/of uitzendbureau?
We waarderen de interesse, maar we werven al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat je als intermediair kandidaten wilt aandragen voor onze mooie functies en wilt bijdragen aan onze ambities, maar dit is niet hoe wij ons recruitmentproces hebben ingericht. Dit betekent dat alle ongevraagde profielen die voor Lely vacatures worden aangeboden, zullen worden behandeld als directe sollicitaties.

title: Working Student – Software Verification & Software Implementation (m|f|d)
description:
• You will be part of the Analysis Instruments Software Department, supporting the verification of our next-generation devices and contributing to smaller software implementation tasks within the development lifecycle.
  • You will execute manual tests on prototypes, pre-series, and series devices, contributing directly to the quality assurance of innovative biomedical instruments.
  • You will analyze test results, document issues, and collaborate closely with software developers, QA, and hardware engineers to ensure a smooth development and release process.
  • You will take ownership of smaller, well-defined implementation tasks under guidance. These may include improving existing features, developing scripts or utilities, fixing smaller defects, and contributing to code reviews and technical documentation.
  • You will use approved agentic AI tools to support software development, for example by exploring solutions, drafting or refactoring code, generating test ideas, and automating repetitive engineering tasks. You will critically review and validate all AI-assisted output and follow applicable quality, security, and data-protection guidelines.
  • You are a registered student (Bachelor or Master) of Computer Science, Natural Science (e.g. Bioinformatics, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics) or similar.
  • You have initial experience in or a strong interest in software testing, test automation, and quality assurance.
  • You have an agile mindset, are solution-oriented, proactive, self-organized, pragmatic and prefer working in an international environment.
  • Your proficient language skills in English and/or in German round off your profile.
  • You are interested in software implementation and enjoy solving smaller, well-defined development tasks in a structured and collaborative environment.
  • You are curious about agentic AI and AI-assisted software development and can critically evaluate AI-generated code, tests, and documentation.
  • Experience with version control, debugging, software development workflows, or tools such as Git is an advantage.
  • Your work place is our office in Bielefeld.

What we offer

  • Cross-border intercultural cooperation and short communication channels.
  • A collegial corporate culture and flexible working hours enable time management on your own terms.
  • Personalized employee development program: specialist and personal training courses provided by our own training academy.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Opportunity Snapshot

  • Pay: $50–100
  • Time per task: 5 hours for trainers and 1.5 hours for reviewers
  • Engagement: Project-based — paid per approved task
  • Commitment: ~15 hours per week
  • Location: Fully remote
  • You’ll need: Hands-on expertise in at least one of Python, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript
  • Your tasks: Build challenging coding problems from real repositories, with reproducible environments and verifiers
  • Role Title: Software Engineer
  • Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)
  • Location: Remote

You’ll create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test a model’s ability to solve real software engineering problems: tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, refactoring, and optimizing performance. Each task means defining the problem, building a reproducible environment, and writing a reference solution.

Scope of Work

  1. Create realistic, challenging coding tasks for frontier AI models, drawn from repositories you know well.
  2. Design problems that require real engineering skill — subtle bugs, non-trivial features, meaningful performance work — not lookup or boilerplate.
  3. Build a reproducible environment for each task.
  4. Write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations, while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.
  5. Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.
  6. Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or unverifiable rather than submitting them.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  3. Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  4. Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
  5. Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery.
  6. Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
  7. Interest in AI and its technical challenges — previous AI experience not required.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required may vary depending on your experience and workflow.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client
  3. Profile review
  4. Onboarding — our Talent Ops team will get you set up

title: Tower Technician I
description:
Advance your career with us and be part of a mission-driven team delivering critical telecommunications and recovery solutions.
At InfraServices, we’re more than a services provider — we’re innovators, problem-solvers, and collaborators. Our culture is built on a foundation of safety first, guided by a customer-focused philosophy, and defined by excellence and integrity.
Here, every voice is heard, fresh ideas are celebrated, and exceptional talent is valued. We’re committed to building an employee experience rooted in trust, respect, continuous learning, and growth opportunities. Whether you’re building cutting-edge infrastructure, supporting field operations, or driving business development, you’ll play a vital role in upholding our core values and delivering on our business objectives.

Job Summary: The Tower Technician I is responsible for assisting in the installation, maintenance, and repair of wireless communication towers and related infrastructure. This role requires the ability to climb towers up to 500 feet, work safely at elevated heights, and follow strict safety guidelines and procedures. This position works under the guidance of experienced tower technicians and foreman to develop the skills necessary for advancement in the field.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
• Climb and perform work on communication towers and elevated structures up to 500 feet
• Assist with the installation and maintenance of antennas, radios, transmission lines, connectors, and mounts
• Assist with the assembly of various types of structures, including monopoles, self-support towers, and guyed towers
• Use hand and power tools to complete work at ground and elevated levels
• Follow Company and industry safety practices, including proper use of fall protection equipment
• Accurately complete timecards, safety checklists, and other documentation
• Maintain and organize tools, equipment, and vehicles
• Maintain a clean and organized job site, ensuring all tools, materials, and waste are properly handled and disposed of
• Support experienced tower technicians and foreman in all aspects of tower work
• Travel regularly to job sites, which may include overnight stays
• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty mentioned satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

Education: High school diploma, general education degree (G.E.D.), or related trade school education

Experience:
• Experience in construction, climbing, or outdoor labor
• Ability to climb and work at heights safely and comfortably
• Must have or obtain and maintain documented Authorized Climber or Competent Climber/Rescue Certification from an accredited institution
• Must have or obtain and maintain OSHA 10 Construction Training Card
• Must have or obtain and maintain First Aid and CPR Certification
• Other relevant certifications may be required per the scope of work being performed (i.e. Hazcom Certification, Blood Born Pathogen Certification, RF Safety Certificate

Technical Skills:
• Computer and Microsoft Office proficiency
• Ability to operate hand and power tools
• Basic knowledge of wireless communications systems and components
• Ability to use GPS and site audit tools

Soft Skills:
• Consistently demonstrates reliability, punctuality, and a strong commitment to completing work safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality
• Works effectively with crew members and foreman; supports a positive and collaborative work environment
• Follows safety protocols and installation procedures with accuracy and care
• Identifies and communicates issues clearly with team members
• Maintains awareness of surroundings and safety risks while working at heights and with heavy equipment

Physical Requirements:
• Must be able to pass pre-employment screening that includes background and drug testing
• Must have a valid driver’s license and a driving record that meets Company requirements
• Ability to climb vertically and pull one’s own body weight, along with necessary tools and equipment, up to 500 feet, and perform work at heights on towers and other elevated structures for extended periods
• Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 75 pounds regularly
• Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, reach, and grasp materials and tools with both hands
• Ability to work long hours in outdoor environments, including extreme weather conditions such as heat, cold, rain, wind, or snow
• Ability to stand, walk, and perform physically demanding tasks for extended periods of time
• Ability to wear the required personal protective equipment (PPE), including fall protection harness, hard hat, safety glasses, and gloves
• Ability to climb and work at heights while wearing a safety harness, maintaining a total combined weight (which includes body weight, clothing, equipment, and tools) between 130 pounds and 310 pounds in accordance with industry fall protection standards
• Must be physically and mentally fit to perform tower rescues and participate in safety drills and training exercises
• Comfortable working in confined spaces and at varying elevations
• Ability to work long and unpredictable hours
• Ability to travel away from home up to 75% of the time, including weekends and extended travel. Travel includes local site travel or national travel depending on business needs.

Employee Benefits:

At InfraServices, taking care of our people is a top priority. That’s why we’ve built a strong benefits program designed to support you and your family, giving you the security you deserve. We know benefits are an essential part of your overall compensation, and we’re committed to offering a competitive package that reflects the value you bring. Below is a quick look at what we offer.

Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Support when life throws challenges your way.
Wellness Program: Resources and programs designed to support your overall health and well-being.
401(K) with Company match: Building your financial future with us.
Paid Time Off, Paid Sick Time, & Company Holidays: Achieving that work-life balance.
Paid Parental & Paid Maternity Leave: Supporting your family is our priority.
Military Differential Pay: Income protection for employees serving in the military.
Employee Referral Program: Share the opportunities and reap the rewards.
Company Discount Program: Enjoy savings on everyday expenses.
