description:
Mobile Paramedical Examiner / Drug & Alcohol Collector

Position Overview
The nation's fastest growing paramedical services company, APPS Paramedical Services, is seeking dependable, self-motivated medical professionals to join our growing team as a Mobile Paramedical Examiner and Drug & Alcohol Collector. This dual-role position offers flexible scheduling and the opportunity to work independently while providing essential healthcare and workplace testing services throughout Tuscarawas County and surrounding areas.

As a Mobile Paramedical Examiner, you will perform insurance examinations for applicants in their homes or workplaces. As a Drug & Alcohol Collector, you will respond to client testing needs including random drug testing, reasonable suspicion testing, post-accident testing, and other workplace testing services.

Responsibilities:
Paramedical Examiner Duties:
  • Obtain and accurately document medical histories.
  • Measure and record vital signs including height, weight, pulse, and blood pressure.
  • Collect and process blood and urine specimens according to established protocols.
  • Maintain specimen integrity and chain-of-custody procedures.
  • Submit completed examination paperwork and daily case updates electronically.
  • Provide professional and courteous service to clients in their homes or workplaces.

Drug & Alcohol Collector Duties:
  • Perform DOT and non-DOT urine drug collections.
  • Conduct alcohol testing in accordance with applicable regulations and company procedures.
  • Respond to client requests for:
    • Random Drug Testing.
    • Reasonable Suspicion Testing.
    • Post-Accident Testing.
    • Return-to-Duty and Follow-Up Testing.
  • Complete accurate collection documentation and chain-of-custody forms.
  • Travel to client locations as needed, including occasional evening and weekend assignments.
  • Maintain confidentiality and professionalism at all times.

Qualifications:
  • Previous healthcare experience required.
  • Phlebotomy experience with a minimum of 200 successful blood draws preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Professional appearance and excellent customer service skills.
  • Reliable transportation and valid auto insurance.
  • Cell phone required.
  • Laptop, desktop computer, or tablet required.
  • Reliable internet access, email address, and printer required.
  • Ability to travel throughout assigned service area.

Training:
  • Drug and alcohol collection experience is preferred but not required.
  • Full training will be provided for qualified candidates interested in performing workplace drug and alcohol testing services.

What We Offer:
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Independent work environment.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Paid training opportunities.
  • Growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding company.
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful impact by serving employers, employees, and insurance applicants throughout the community.

Schedule:
  • Part-Time / Contract Position.
  • Flexible hours.
  • Day, evening, and weekend availability preferred.

Join Our Team
If you are a motivated medical professional looking for flexibility, independence, and the opportunity to expand your skills, we encourage you to apply today. Please forward a copy of your current resume in either Word or PDF format. Submissions without resumes will not be considered.

We are a hyper-growth Series C company, backed by over $300 million in funding from top-tier global investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, QED, Castle Island, Switch Ventures, HTwenty, Monashees, General Catalyst Customer Value Fund. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. Additionally, Félix was selected as an "Endeavor Entrepreneur" and was a recipient of the CrossTech Fintech Startups Award.
Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission, serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today.

About the role
Félix moves money for millions of transactions from the US to LatAm. The Payouts Platform is the shared service every Félix product uses to send money out, across bank transfers, instant payment rails, wallets, cards, cash networks, and crypto rails.
As PM for Payouts Platform, you'll own the vision, roadmap and results for how money gets to its destination. Your goal is to make paying out fast, reliable and low-cost for every product, in every market we serve.

What you'll focus on
  • Set the vision and roadmap. Define where the Payouts Platform goes next, and balance new capabilities, reliability and cost in your priorities.
  • Build a platform every product can use. Turn payouts into a shared, self-serve capability that any product team can adopt quickly, so Félix can launch new products without building payouts from scratch each time.
  • Expand reach. Decide which markets and rails to invest in next, across Latin America and beyond, including instant payments, wallets, cash networks and crypto rails. Lead the platform side of each launch with FX, Compliance and Treasury, and shorten the time to go live.
  • Shape partner strategy. Define what the platform needs from payout partners, compare their performance, and decide which ones to integrate or route more volume to. That includes building direct connections to major payout providers alongside aggregator partners. Make partner decisions for new capabilities alongside the Business Development team, which owns the commercial relationships.
  • Improve performance. Define the routing and validation strategy that raises success rates and speed while lowering cost per payout.
  • Reduce manual work. Prioritize product improvements that remove manual handling of failed and returned payouts, working with Ops and the Ops Platform. Give product teams real-time visibility into every payout.
  • Align across teams. Make sure every payout is compliant, funded and supportable. That means working with Compliance on screening, Treasury on liquidity, and product teams on the experience they build on top of the platform.
  • Set service commitments. Define the reliability and performance levels product teams can count on, and prioritize the work to meet them with the engineering team, which owns delivery. Report on the success, speed and cost of payouts.

What you'll bring
  • Product experience: 5+ years of product management experience in a fast-paced environment where you were a primary builder.
  • Platform and API experience: you've owned a product whose main customers were other teams or developers.
  • Partner integrations: a track record of taking third-party integrations from evaluation to production, with engineering and commercial teams.
  • Data fluency: comfortable with SQL and with defining and tracking reliability and cost metrics.
  • Clear communication: you can explain trade-offs to engineers, ops teams and executives alike.
  • These are the applicable requisites, although equivalent competencies in any of the above will also be considered.

What We Offer
  • The starting base salary for this role typically ranges between $145,000 and $185,000 USD in Miami, tailored to experience and skill set. Because we are all owners of Félix, equity is a core component of our total compensation package. Your recruiter will walk you through our complete benefits, health coverage, equity structure, and total compensation details during your first call.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, training, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ requirements. The CC team will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in all related installation, site inspection and contractor management, Prepare BOQ’s, Quantity Survey & Quantity Take Off, Cost Analysis for each of the line items in the BOQ as required for project to project, Benchmarking, Review & Standardize of Specifications, Sound Technical Knowledge on Civil / MEP aspects as applicable, Procurement from Cost Management perspective, Finalise Commercials with vendors, Rate Contracts as applicable,

Boosting client relationships

Helping clients achieve success is what JLL does best—and your role is an extension of this tradition. To effectively help our clients, you’ll identify their needs and constraints, and work around these challenges. You also have to effectively represent our clients throughout the whole duration of the projects. Do you have an enormous talent for promotion? If so, this is the perfect job for you, as you’ll also represent and promote the company throughout the project.

The Cost Manager is responsible for implementing administering and maintaining cost control systems and procedures to track budgets, commitments, expenditures and forecasts, and to assist in the preparation and review of cost estimates and schedules for projects of medium complexity and value;

  • Provide cost information to support decision and alternative selection
  • Evaluate contractor invoices prior to submission into client Finance systems for pre-approval
  • Utilize information from SAP (or similar) and input to cost report and validation of spending
  • Evaluate and analyze bids and provide recommendation for decision making
  • Provide forecasts and cash flow analysis
  • Maintain and manage the cost report and provide regular updates on financial position
  • Assist in the development, validation and maintenance of the project schedule
  • Assist in developing reporting tracking tools and generates cost reports on regular basis including evaluation of earned value
  • Support the coordination of the Change Management process for the project
  • Build intricate spreadsheets to enable fast and accurate data manipulation of large data sets
  • Extract data from several sources, transforming it to fit operational needs
  • Reconcile data to support complete accuracy and creates a clean audit trail

Pre-Contract

  • Developing cost plans and estimates through the design phase, delivering updated cost plans at appropriate design milestones.
  • Providing commercial input to design optioneering and input into value engineering exercises.
  • Reviewing contractor and subcontractor pricing and leading negotiations on behalf of the client to drive fair contract prices.

Post-Contract

  • Performing quantity surveying, cost controls and change management activities throughout the project life cycle.
  • Ensuring that post-contract cost variances and change control processes are managed effectively.
  • Ensuring that cost auditing and valuation work is managed effectively and that a robust process for cost validation is in place.
  • Carrying out the production of monthly cost reports for presentation to the client.
  • Ensuring that final accounts are negotiated and agreed in a timely manner.
  • Compiling as built cost estimate records for bench marking purposes.

A seasoned expert

Likewise, you should have established yourself as a professional within design, construction and cost management. Moreover, you should have a proven track record in profit planning, business development, networking and marketing.

An effective communicator

Are you considered a natural communicator? Alongside your native tongue, do you have a strong grasp of written and spoken English? You’ll need it in this role - strong communication skills will surely land you the job.

Likewise, you’ll be in charge of creating an environment where all team members are encouraged to contribute; as well as managing company staff to achieve enthusiastic and effective contribution to the project. title: Junior Systems Engineer

Breng structuur aan in complexe infraprojecten door heel Nederland.

Ga het maar doen!

Van aanbesteding tot oplevering houd je overzicht, verbind je verschillende disciplines en draag je bij aan succesvolle projectresultaten.

Als junior systems engineer breng je structuur aan, bewaak je de samenhang en help je projectteams. Zo lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan het succesvol realiseren van uitdagende infrastructurele projecten. Je werkt mee aan aansprekende projecten zoals de Markerwadden, de N206 Ir. G. Tjalmaweg, de OV-terminal Zuidas en de Meanderende Maas en ondertussen leer je dagelijks van ervaren collega’s.

title: Retail Salesperson New Plymouth (Part Time)
description:
• Join an amazing team with a great culture

  • Competitive hourly rate

  • Wide range of career and personal development opportunities

Love talking farm? Looking for part-time work where you can put your rural know - how to good use?

We're looking for a Retail Salesperson to join our New Plymouth team for 20 hours per week minimum. The usual weekday hours are 10 am–2 pm, Monday to Friday, and you’ll also need to be available for rostered weekend shifts.

Mō te whai waahi | About the opportunity

On any given day, you might help a farmer get sorted for lambing, talk fencing supplies with someone on their first lifestyle block, or carry a bag of dog food out to a customer’s ute. We’re looking for someone who enjoys a good yarn, asks a few questions to understand what the customer needs and follows through. If you don’t know the answer, you’ll find out and get back to them.

You'll also help the store run smoothly by:

  • Helping shareholder and customers choose products for sheep, beef and other dry stock, as well as general farm and lifestyle block supplies.

  • Putting sales through the till ordering stock and receipting deliveries.

  • Keeping shelves stocked, prices visible and displays tidy.

  • Lending a hand wherever it's needed, whether there's a queue at the counter or stock to put away.

Mōhou ake | About you

Maybe you’ve worked on a farm, run a lifestyle block or spent time behind a rural retail counter. We’d love to hear what you’ve learnt along the way. You’ll be just as comfortable talking with someone who’s farmed all their life as you are helping someone work out what they need for their first few sheep.

Retail or customer service experience is handy, especially in a busy store. If you know farming, enjoy helping people and are willing to learn, we can teach you the retail side. You’ll need basic computer skills and the ability to regularly lift and carry stock weighing up to 25 kg, including bags of feed and dog food.

A forklift licence or current first aid certificate would be a bonus.

Mō ngā painga | About the benefits

You'll be rewarded with:

  • Sick leave from Day 1

  • Paid birthday leave

  • Access to training through our online library, The Greenhouse

  • Staff discounts at Farmlands Retail Stores

  • Exclusive Farmlands shareholding offer providing access to a vast array of discounts with our Card Partners

  • Additional support for parents

Te Tono | How to apply

Apply online with your CV and cover letter and we'll do the rest. We'd love to hear from you and know you'll most definitely grow your career - and us - at Farmlands.

Mō matou | About us

At Farmlands Te Whenua Tāroa, New Zealand’s largest farming co-operative, we’re driven by three core values: Be You, Minds Open, and See It Through. We support NZ farmers and growers to boost profitability and productivity, aiming to be the trusted partner for everyone connected to the land.

With over 1,200 team members across 80+ locations, we offer diverse operations - from retail and feed production to ecommerce and fuel. Join us to be part of a Kiwi-owned brand that values your uniqueness, creativity, and teamwork in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

You must have the legal right to work in New Zealand. Pre-employment checks include references, Ministry of Justice check, right to work, driver’s licence check, and ACC history. Additional checks may apply for some roles.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (TE-DPS-AIM-2026-223-LD)
description:
Introduction

Help shape the future of healthcare AI, where innovation meets trust.

At CERN, you will develop cutting-edge AI solutions that help prevent disease, improve prediction, and deliver trustworthy healthcare insights. You will work on technologies that make it possible to unlock the value of sensitive data without ever moving or exposing it, enabling collaboration where privacy is essential.

As part of this role, you will help develop and deploy CAFEIN®, CERN's federated AI platform powering major European healthcare initiatives, including UMBRELLA and AIM-SAFE. You will design advanced federated learning algorithms and secure distributed AI systems that allow models to learn from data across institutions while keeping the data exactly where it belongs.

Recognised as a lighthouse example of "data stays, AI collaborates", CAFEIN® combines state-of-the-art federated learning with CERN's unique strengths in trust, open science, GDPR compliance, and international collaboration. The result is a pioneering framework that is redefining how AI can advance healthcare while safeguarding privacy.

Join us to build AI that learns globally, protects locally, and improves lives.

Functions

  • Develop and test federated learning software and algorithms.
  • Implement and evaluate privacy-preserving techniques, including differential privacy and homomorphic encryption.
  • Develop tools to optimise data ingestions and assess the quality of data and images.
  • Design and run machine-learning experiments using programming languages like Python with libraries as TensorFLow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
  • Analyse data using statistical methods and visualisation for exploratory data analysis (EDA).
  • Implement and benchmark state-of-the-art machine-learning methods, optimising federated learning for utility, communication efficiency, energy use and scalability.
  • Design and deploy Internet of Things (IoT)-based federated learning architectures.

Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Machine Learning, Computer Science or Data Science or a related field.

Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience developing and deploying federated learning solutions in real-world environments.
  • Proficiency in federated learning techniques, including aggregation algorithms, communication and network architecture, security and privacy features.
  • Hands on experience with network security, including certificates, encryption, access control, authorisation, and authentication.
  • Proven experience in coordinating or technically leading machine-learning deployments.
  • Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with software life-cycle tools and procedures (proficiency with Git and GitLab).
  • Excellent knowledge of programming techniques and languages: python, deep learning framework (e.g. TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Jax or scikit-learn).
  • Experience in data analysis in a health care environment would be an asset.

Technical competencies:

  • Knowledge and application of software life-cycle tools and procedures.
  • Knowledge of programming techniques and languages.
  • Testing, diagnosing and optimisation of software.
  • Knowledge of best practices for developing secure software.
  • Administration of computing systems, upgrades, application of security patches, system and data migrations, backup and recovery.

Behavioural competencies:

  • Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.
  • Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.
  • Working in Teams: cooperating constructively with others in the pursuit of team goals; balancing personal goals with team goals.
  • Communicating Effectively: ensuring that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
  • Learning and Sharing Knowledge: sharing knowledge and expertise freely and willingly with others; coaching others to ensure knowledge transfer.

Language skills:

Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility and closing date:

Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization. Employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all Member States and Associate Member States.

This vacancy will be filled as soon as possible, and applications should normally reach us no later than 12.12.2026 at 23:59 CET.

Employment Conditions

Contract type: Limited duration contract (3 years). Subject to certain conditions, holders of limited-duration contracts may apply for an indefinite position.

Working Hours: 40 hours per week

Job Flexibility: Hybrid

Job grade: 6-7

Job reference: TE-DPS-AIM-2026-223-LD

Field of work: Information Technologies

Benchmark Job Title: Computing Engineer

Global Benefits

  • A competitive salary (tax free), increasing in line with your years of relevant experience.
  • 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
  • Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
  • Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
  • A relocation package (installation grant, removal, travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
  • Possibility to extend your contract up to 8 years + eligibility for indefinite contract tenure.

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

  • Commitment: ~15 hours per week
  • Location: Fully remote
  • You’ll need: Hands-on expertise in at least one of Python, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript
  • Your tasks: Build challenging coding problems from real repositories, with reproducible environments and verifiers
  • Role Title: Software Engineer - Backend
  • Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)
  • Location: Remote

You’ll create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test a model’s ability to solve real software engineering problems: tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, refactoring, and optimizing performance. Each task means defining the problem, building a reproducible environment, and writing a reference solution.

Scope of Work

  1. Create realistic, challenging coding tasks for frontier AI models, drawn from repositories you know well.
  2. Design problems that require real engineering skill — subtle bugs, non-trivial features, meaningful performance work — not lookup or boilerplate.
  3. Build a reproducible environment for each task.
  4. Write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations, while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.
  5. Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.
  6. Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or unverifiable rather than submitting them.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  3. Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  4. Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
  5. Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery.
  6. Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
  7. Interest in AI and its technical challenges — previous AI experience not required.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required may vary depending on your experience and workflow.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

How the selection process works

  1. Apply and complete the screening questions
  2. Complete the AI interview for this role — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client

Additionally, Fresenius Medical Care works in community with its customers, patients, industry partners, and government leaders and agencies to realize the vision of better, simpler, more accessible renal care.

Position Summary:

Join a multidisciplinary team developing AI-powered engineering tools for medical device development. This role focuses on transforming complex engineering information into structured knowledge that can be queried, analyzed, and reasoned about using modern AI techniques.

The selected intern will assist in developing next gen tools and process to accelerate SW development in the Home HD Embedded SW group. The role will report to the Sr Manager Application Development, Home Hemodialysis. The intern will work collaboratively with several cross-functional departments including Digital Solutions, Systems Engineering, Software Test, and SQA as part of this role.

Responsibilities:

  • Process and organize engineering documentation, including product requirements, software requirements, test plans, verification reports, and related design-control artifacts.
  • Assist in developing AI-driven systems that enable engineers to ask natural-language questions about product functionality, requirements, verification activities, and traceability.
  • Work with engineering and AI teams to construct structured representations of software systems from development artifacts.
  • Help integrate software-derived knowledge with design documentation to create a unified engineering knowledge base.
  • Support development of retrieval, search, analytics, and agentic AI capabilities that connect software implementation details with requirements, testing, and system design information.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, and AI engineers to improve access to technical knowledge across the product lifecycle.

Education & Qualifications:

  • Candidate for Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related technical field.
  • A background or strong interest in Cognitive Science/Psychology, given the empathetic persona development focus.
  • LLM Fundamentals: Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python (specifically libraries like Pandas, NumPy, or frameworks like LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph).
  • Data Management: Experience organizing unstructured data and working with Knowledge Bases or Vector DBs. (ChromaDB, FAISS, etc)
  • QA: Familiarity with software testing methodologies; experience testing AI outputs for bias or hallucination is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct self-driven research, and eagerness to learn new tools and methods quickly
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS or other cloud platforms, at least familiarity is needed
  • Entry level knowledge of Dialysis industry helpful, but not required
  • Energetic, curious, learner/growth/problem solver mindset, positive attitude, and enjoys working in teams

title: Local Clinical Project Manager (m/w/d)
description:
The Local Clinical Project Manager - Sponsor dedicated (m/w/d) will be leading Local Study Teams at country level to deliver committed components of clinical studies according to agreed resources, budget and timelines complying with Sponsor Procedural Documents, international guidelines such as ICH-GCP as well as relevant local regulations.


In addition to leading the Local Study Teams, the Local Clinical Project Manager (m/w/d) may perform site monitoring as needed to support the flexible capacity model. The Local CPM is responsible to ensure that sites are identified, site qualifications performed, set up, initiated, monitored, closed and documentation archived.


Main Responsibilities

  • Has the overall responsibility for the study commitments within the country and for timely delivery of data to required quality.
  • Leads Local Study Team consisting of CRA(s), CSA(s), for assigned studies.
  • Leads the performance of the Local Study Team at country level ensuring compliance with Sponsor Procedural Documents, ICH-GCP and local regulations.
  • Ensures that clinical and operational feasibility assessment of potential studies is performed to the highest quality.
  • Coordinates the site selection process by identifying potential sites/investigators, performing initial Site Quality Risk Assessment, and conducting Site Qualification Visits to evaluate suitability and quality risks.
  • Ensures timely submission of application/documents to EC/IRB at start up and for the duration of the study. Works together with Regulatory Affairs to ensure timely delivery of application/documents for submissions to Regulatory Authority for the duration of the study, and in line with local regulations.
  • Ensures timely preparation of country financial Study Management Agreement (fSMA) and maintains accurate study budget in Sponsor clinical studies financial system.
  • Ensures timely preparation of local Master CSA (including site budget) and amendments as needed.
  • Ensures timely preparation of country level Master Informed Consent Form (MICF) and subsequent site level ICFs, including any relevant translations.
  • Ensures all country and site level trial essential documents required by ICH-GCP prior to study start have been collected.
  • Plans and coordinates applicable local drug activities (from local purchase or reimbursement to drug destruction).
  • Sets up and maintains the study in CTMS at study country level as well as local websites as required by local laws and regulations.
  • Oversees, manages and coordinates monitoring activities from site activation through to study closure at country and site level in accordance with the Monitoring Plans.
  • Reviews monitoring visit reports (as required and following Sponsor SOPs) and pro-actively advices the monitor(s) on study related matters.
  • Performs any required co-monitoring, Accompanied Site Visits/training visits with study CRAs.
  • Proactively identifies risks and facilitates resolution of complex study problems and issues.
  • Organises regular Local Study Team meetings on an agenda driven basis.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in related discipline, preferably in life science, or equivalent qualification.
  • At least 3 – 5 years of hands-on experience in relevant clinical operations roles (e.g. Project Lead, Clinical Operations Lead or equivalent).
  • Strong practical knowledge of the German clinical trial environment and country-specific requirements for the conduct of clinical studies.
  • Proven work experience in Clinical Project Management at the local level.
  • Prior experience in Oncology therapeutical area.
  • Strong project leadership, budget management, critical thinking and risk-management skills, with a solution-oriented approach and clear ownership.
  • Fluent German (C2/native level) and very good written and spoken English.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with local and global stakeholders, investigators and study-site teams.
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate cross functional teams to deliver clinical trials according to or ahead of time plan, budget and with required quality.
  • Excellent understanding of the Clinical Study Process including monitoring.
  • Excellent project management skills.
  • Good ability to learn and to adapt to work with IT systems.
  • Ability to travel nationally and internationally as required.

Please note: due to sponsor requirements for the role only candidates based in the listed location/s will be considered. Any applications from candidates based outside of these locations will not be considered.

title: Instructor - Carillon St Pete
description:
JETSET Pilates is a modern, music-driven Pilates brand redefining the boutique fitness experience. Our instructors do more than lead classes, they inspire confidence, build community, and create an environment where clients feel challenged, supported, and empowered to become stronger both physically and mentally. Through expert coaching, personalized attention, and genuine connection, JETSET instructors deliver an elevated fitness experience that keeps clients coming back.
Whether you’re an experienced fitness professional or looking to grow your coaching career, JETSET provides comprehensive instructor training, ongoing development, and opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly expanding brand.
As a JETSET Instructor, you’ll play an essential role in creating an unforgettable studio experience while helping clients build strength, confidence, and consistency through every class.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Deliver Exceptional Classes

  • Lead engaging, music-driven, 50-minute modern Pilates classes that deliver a safe, challenging, and consistent experience.

  • Provide individualized coaching, form corrections, and exercise modifications to clients of all fitness levels.

  • Inspire and motivate clients while maintaining energy, professionalism, and attention to detail throughout every class.

Create an Exceptional Member Experience

  • Build authentic relationships with clients and foster a welcoming, inclusive studio environment.

  • Learn clients’ names, celebrate milestones, and create meaningful connections that strengthen the studio community.

  • Deliver hospitality that reflects the JETSET brand before, during, and after every class.

Represent the JETSET Brand

  • Embody the values and culture of JETSET Pilates both inside and outside the studio.

  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, studio events, and community initiatives.

  • Support local marketing and community engagement efforts as needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional studio environment.

Continue to Grow

  • Complete the JETSET Instructor Training Program and participate in ongoing education and development.

  • Apply feedback from leadership to continuously improve coaching effectiveness.

  • Stay current on programming updates, coaching techniques, and JETSET best practices.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

You’ll be successful if you:

  • Bring energy, consistency, and enthusiasm to every class you lead.

  • Enjoy building genuine relationships that keep members engaged and connected to the studio.

  • Thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute positively to the broader studio team.

  • Take pride in representing the JETSET brand professionally and creating an elevated member experience.

  • Are curious, coachable, and committed to continuously improving your skills.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Passion for health, wellness, and helping others achieve their goals.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to confidently lead a fast-paced, music-driven group fitness class.

  • Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.

  • Previous group fitness instruction experience is preferred, but not required.

  • Current CPR/AED certification (or ability to obtain prior to teaching independently).

  • Willingness to successfully complete the JETSET Instructor Training Academy Program, including a 5-day on-site training, which may be held locally or at one of our Regional Training and Support Centers.

AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS

  • Ability to teach a consistent number of classes per week.

  • Availability to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

  • Willingness and ability to attend required team meetings, continuing education sessions, and studio events.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to stand and move throughout the studio for extended periods.

  • Ability to demonstrate Pilates exercises safely and effectively.

  • Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.

  • Ability to coach in a warm, fast-paced, music-driven environment.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Competitive per-class compensation

  • Performance incentives (where applicable)

  • Complimentary or discounted JETSET Pilates classes

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Ongoing education and development

  • Career growth opportunities*

Compensation, benefits, scheduling expectations, and employment policies may vary by franchise owner.

*JETSET is committed to developing future leaders. Instructors who demonstrate exceptional performance may have opportunities to grow as the brand continues to expand.

title: Manager, Primary Litigation Fulfillment
description:
Are you an operations-focused leader who thrives on keeping complex workflows moving, solving problems quickly, and ensuring clients receive accurate, timely deliverables?

Join Esquire as our Manager, Primary Litigation Fulfillment and help keep our Primary Fulfillment Services operation moving with accuracy, urgency, and exceptional client service.

Why Choose Esquire?

Esquire is a leader in legal support services, known for innovation, professionalism, and delivering exceptional quality. As part of our team, you'll receive competitive benefits and the opportunity to grow within a people-first culture.

At Esquire, we are focused on Getting it Right for our clients, our partners, and our employees. We understand that the client experience begins with us, and we're committed to delivering reliable, high-quality service at every stage of the process.

About the Role

As the Manager, Primary Litigation Fulfillment, you'll serve as the operational expediter for Primary Fulfillment Services, helping ensure work moves seamlessly from intake through delivery. You'll monitor workflows, anticipate bottlenecks, coordinate across teams, manage urgent production needs, and maintain a strong focus on quality, accuracy, and client expectations.

This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role for someone who can balance detailed execution with proactive problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the central point of accountability for Primary Fulfillment Services operations from intake through delivery.
  • Monitor queues, portlets, and workflow processes to identify potential bottlenecks and intervene when needed to keep work moving.
  • Coordinate closely with fulfillment teams and other departments to track commitments, verify quality, close the loop, and escalate service disruptions appropriately.
  • Manage detailed aspects of product delivery and maintain accurate records in NetSuite in accordance with organizational standards and client requirements.
  • Handle urgent and complex production tasks, making adjustments and identifying solutions to meet changing client needs and deadlines.
  • Lead quality-control efforts through regular follow-up, issue resolution, and process adjustments that support client satisfaction.
  • Analyze information, identify challenges, and make recommendations that improve workflow efficiency and delivery.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: At least 7 years of legal industry or law firm experience.
  • Operations: Experience managing workflow volume and coordinating operational processes.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across departments and support client interactions.
  • Technical: Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel, along with experience maintaining detailed records and reports in NetSuite or similar systems.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly identify issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Organization: Strong attention to detail and the ability to plan work effectively, manage competing priorities, and meet assigned deadlines.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work under pressure, adjust to changing conditions, and maintain a high level of performance and urgency.
  • Independence: Ability to work independently while taking direction from multiple leaders and maintaining accountability for timely delivery.
  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Personal Attributes: Detail-oriented, dependable, collaborative, client-focused, and committed to company objectives.

What Success Looks Like

  • Meeting productivity requirements documented in KPI reports at a level of at least 90%.
  • Meeting accuracy requirements documented in KPI reports at a level of at least 98%.
  • Maintaining consistent workflow movement and minimizing avoidable bottlenecks or delivery delays.
  • Providing timely solutions for urgent or complicated production needs.
  • Supporting strong quality control and client satisfaction through proactive follow-up and coordination.

We Offer a Comprehensive Benefits Package Including

  • Insurance: Medical, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability insurance, basic life insurance, and supplemental insurance for employees and their dependents.
  • Retirement: Eligibility to enroll in the company's 401(k) plan with match contribution.
  • Paid Time Off: Employees receive two weeks of vacation leave per year, or 80 hours annually.
  • Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year and 2 paid floating holidays per year.
  • Sick Leave: 5 paid sick days per year.
  • Tuition Reimbursement: Financial assistance to support your career development.

Work Environment

This position is eligible for remote work, with eligibility based on the ability to maintain specified productivity and quality metrics. The role may also involve working in an office environment.

Physical requirements can include lifting up to 50 pounds, along with pushing, bending, kneeling, and crouching. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Don't Meet Every Single Requirement?

We know that a truly inclusive workplace values potential just as much as experience. If you're excited about this role but don't match every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we're looking for.

Ready to Make an Impact in the Legal Community?

Apply now and bring your expertise to Esquire!

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

Esquire Deposition Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

title: DevOps Technical Lead with German
description:
We are looking for an experienced technical leader with a background as a Cloud/DevSecOps Architect or DevOps/DevSecOps Technical Lead to guide the design and implementation of secure Azure cloud platforms. This role combines architectural ownership with hands-on engineering and technical team leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Shape Cloud Architecture -> Own the technical architecture of Azure multi-tenant environments, including integrations with identity and access management systems.

  • Drive Infrastructure Governance -> Define Terraform governance, including repository structures, reusable module standards, and infrastructure delivery pipelines.

  • Build Secure CI/CD -> Design CI/CD architectures with security gates, policy enforcement, and multi-stage deployments.

  • Strengthen Identity & Access -> Define and implement identity and access controls using Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management.

  • Accelerate Cloud Automation -> Lead the development of cloud automation capabilities, including self-service portals, API integrations, and workflow automation.

  • Lead by Example -> Guide implementation through hands-on engineering, code reviews, architectural decisions, and mentoring.

  • Ensure Security & Compliance -> Ensure platform designs address security, compliance, and operational requirements in critical infrastructure environments.

  • Bridge Technical & Business Priorities -> Collaborate with Development, Security, and Management stakeholders, clearly communicating technical decisions and trade-offs.

  • Previous experience as a Cloud Architect, DevSecOps Architect, DevOps Technical Lead, or DevSecOps Technical Lead is required, with demonstrated ownership of architectural decisions and technical delivery.

  • Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure architecture, including multi-tenant environments and IAM integrations.

  • Hands-on Terraform experience, including reusable modules, repository design, governance, and pipeline integration.

  • Experience designing CI/CD architectures with automated security gates, policy enforcement, and multi-stage deployments.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, and least-privilege access principles.

  • Experience building cloud automation solutions using self-service portals, APIs, and workflow automation.

  • Proven ability to establish engineering standards, lead code and design reviews, and mentor engineers.

  • Strong communication skills and experience aligning technical decisions across Development, Security, and Management.

  • Experience working in critical infrastructure (KRITIS) environments and understanding their security and compliance requirements.

  • Good German and English communication skills, both written and spoken, are mandatory.

  • Work-Life Balance: home office, flexible schedule, parenting workshops, vacation package

title: Project Manager Product Development
description:
Als project manager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het op tijd en binnen het budget realiseren van project resultaten. In deze rol ben je de schakel tussen de engineers, testers, technisch schrijvers, product managers, inkopers, productie medewerkers en de supportorganisatie. Je zorgt ervoor dat de visie en de doelstellingen van het project bij iedereen helder zijn, zodat iedereen duidelijk heeft waar we naar toe gaan en wat hun taak is. Daarnaast coördineer en borg je de werkzaamheden.

De projecten die jij gaat leiden vallen onder product development. Binnen deze afdeling werken we voortdurend aan het verbeteren van onze geïnstalleerde basis van robots en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe innovatieve oplossingen om de adoptie van robotisering op boerderijen nog verder te stimuleren.

Je opereert in een team van 25 project managers onder aanvoering van de lead project management. Dit team is dagelijks bezig om het project management binnen Lely verder te professionaliseren. Ook is er veel aandacht voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling door middel van bijvoorbeeld peer reviews en intervisies. Je kunt jezelf verder ontwikkelen door o.a. trainingen te volgen via de Lely Academy. We werken hard, maar houden ook van een feestje op z’n tijd en daarom gaan we ieder jaar een paar keer op pad om naast het werk samen leuke activiteiten te ondernemen. Als jij hier een leuk idee voor hebt horen we het alvast graag!

Belangrijkste werkzaamheden
In deze rol zal je leidinggeven aan een project, waar een multidisciplinair team van ongeveer 20 engineers aan meewerkt en waarbij het jouw taak is om alle neuzen dezelfde kant op te houden.

Daarnaast zijn dit je belangrijkste taken:

  • Projectplannen maken, implementeren en afstemmen met de relevante stakeholders en coördineren van alle werkzaamheden binnen het project;
  • Budget beheren en kostprijsontwikkeling van de machine bewaken;
  • Managen van de risico’s en van de toeleveranciers;
  • Uitdagen en stimuleren van de engineers zodat er een optimaal en kwalitatief technisch hoogstaand product opgeleverd wordt;
  • Verzorgen van voortgangsrapportages voor leidinggevenden en stakeholders;
  • Het meehelpen aan de verdere professionalisering van project managent binnen Lely.

Jij bent een ervaren project manager die het een uitdaging vindt om zelfstandig complexe projecten en programma’s op de rit te krijgen en tot een goed einde te brengen. Jij spreekt de taal van de techneuten, maar laat ook in gesprekken met stakeholders je meerwaarde zien. Voortdurend in contact staan met de interne stakeholders, te denken aan Product Managers, afdelingshoofden en productie en ook leveranciers om een succesvolle introductie van de productverbeteringen in het veld te garanderen, daar blink je in uit. Wat je nog meer in huis hebt?

  • Een wo-master in een technische richting;
  • Interesse in robotica en de agrarische sector;
  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als project manager;
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het leiden van innovatieve projecten in productontwikkeling;
  • Het team waar je in komt te werken heeft een internationaal karakter en daarom beheers je naast Nederlands ook de Engelse taal in zowel woord als geschrift uitstekend;
  • IPMA certificering of vergelijkbaar.

En vanzelfsprekend kom je goed tot je recht in een dynamische en innovatieve organisatie.

Werken bij Lely betekent bijdragen aan duurzame vooruitgang binnen een van de meest innovatieve organisaties van Nederland. Jij draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de agrarische sector – en wij zorgen dat jij daar alle ruimte, middelen en ondersteuning voor krijgt.

  • Een internationale werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap.
  • Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder tot 8 weken vakantie per jaar en een goede pensioenregeling.
  • Een salaris binnen de schaal van €5700 - €8000 bruto per maand, waarin we graag zien dat er vanaf je startsalaris nog groeiruimte is richting de toekomst
  • Goede doorgroeimogelijkheden: jij bent in regie over je ontwikkeling en kunt kiezen uit diverse trainingen via onze Lely Academy – van persoonlijke ontwikkeling tot vakspecifieke opleidingen.
  • Onze moderne Lely Campus biedt dagelijks toegang tot uitgebreide sportfaciliteiten: een indoor gym, outdoor padelbanen, een basketbal- en volleybalveld buiten, tafeltennis en tafelvoetbal. Je kunt meedoen aan Hyrox-workouts of je inschrijven voor personal training – en je collega’s uitdagen tijdens een actieve pauze.
  • Geniet van verse koffie en thee van onze eigen barista, met melk rechtstreeks van onze boerderij, én een gezond en betaalbaar bedrijfsrestaurant.
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans dankzij ons hybride werkbeleid: je werkt minimaal drie dagen per week op de Campus, met flexibele werktijden en volop ruimte om extra tijd op locatie door te brengen (tussen 06:00 en 20:00 uur).
  • Een gratis shuttlebus brengt je van en naar de metro in Maassluis, zodat jouw werkdag soepel begint en eindigt.
  • Successen moeten gevierd worden: van jubilea tot kerstfeesten – bij Lely weten we hoe we dat aanpakken!

Ook zijn we trots dat onze inzet en visie zijn bekroond met het winnen van de Rotterdamse Ondernemersprijs 2025!

Recruitment & selectie bureau, consultancy en/of uitzendbureau?
We waarderen de interesse, maar we werven al onze kandidaten rechtstreeks. We begrijpen dat je als intermediair kandidaten wilt aandragen voor onze mooie functies en wilt bijdragen aan onze ambities, maar dit is niet hoe wij ons recruitmentproces hebben ingericht. Dit betekent dat alle ongevraagde profielen die voor Lely vacatures worden aangeboden, zullen worden behandeld als directe sollicitaties.

title: Clinical Manager, Quality Assurance
description:
Salary: $95,000-$115,000 annually (plus up to $30,000 in annual incentives based on performance)

ACES is a rapidly growing company of autism services that is dedicated to enhancing the quality of life for individuals and families impacted with autism or other special needs. We provide comprehensive, professional services to maximize individuals' potential in the home, school and community, throughout their lifespan.

ACES’ distinguished care is grounded in an industry-leading model of behavioral artistry – which combines the best clinical practice of traditional Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA) with humanistic elements that help our clients generalize their skills and gain independence. At 30+ locations, we are motivated to grow both so that we can serve more clients and close the significant supply gap that currently exists across the United States. We are committed to attracting and cultivating the very best team members who embody ACES’ values and culture and are passionate about our work. For more information, visit .

ACES offers our supervisors the flexibility and autonomy to deliver care where it’s most clinically appropriate—whether that’s in-center, in-home, or via telehealth—and to build schedules based on the individual needs of their clients.

Why Join ACES?

Compensation & Incentives:

  • Total Compensation Range: $95,000 to $115,000 (plus up to $30,000 in annual incentives based on performance)

  • Attractive Bonus Package: Up to $10,000 in sign-on and retention bonuses tailored to your location and our business needs.

  • Relocation Assistance: Considering a move? We offer up to $10,000 (where applicable) in relocation assistance to help make your transition smoother. This package provides a lump sum payment to cover your moving expenses, travel costs, and other support to help you settle within 10-15 miles of one of our centers.

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Benefit from up to 28 paid days off annually, including holidays, vacation days, and sick leave.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: Access medical, dental, and vision insurance within 30 days of joining, along with a 401k retirement plan, and more.

  • Referral Bonuses: Earn up to $3000 for referring qualified candidates to join our team.

ACES Achievements:

  • National Recognition: ACES is the sole autism provider recognized for quality care by Aetna/CVS’s Institute of Quality.

  • Expert Team: Join a team of over 400 Board Certified Behavior Analysts, renowned for their expertise and dedication.

  • Industry Accolades: Forbes has named us one of the Best Mid-Sized Workplaces, reflecting our commitment to excellence.

  • Legacy of Excellence: Benefit from the expertise of one of the longest-standing providers of ABA therapy worldwide.

JOB SUMMARY

The Clinical Manager, Quality Assurance (“CQM”) is primarily responsible for regularly evaluating the treatment progression of client programs through in-person observation, review of data, and direct communication with assigned staff. Verbal and written feedback is delivered to the staff in an effort to ensure the client is progressing in alignment with their treatment plan. This position reports to the local Clinical Director(s).


ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Working under the supervision of the Clinical Director(s), essential job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Maintain a small to moderate caseload
  • Assist Clinical Director(s) with intervention on clinical cases to influence positive outcomes
  • Collaborate with the Program Manager on client cohort progress and communication to payor
  • Evaluate clinical quality of assigned cases by providing consultation and supervision and communicating with Behavioral Interventionists (BI’s) and parents/caregivers to get additional feedback and input regarding treatment prognosis
  • Regularly provide collaboration on cases that are not progressing in alignment with their treatment plan (e.g., facing significant barriers to progress)
  • Participate on cases that need advanced clinical consultation by working alongside the treatment team to modify treatment plans
  • Communicating with parents regarding any clinical concerns related to the client program
  • Provide parent training workshops and services that provide opportunities for higher levels of parent participation
  • Attend IEP meetings (as approved by funding sources or as needed)
  • Monitor and provide input regarding outcome data, with support of the Director of Client Outcomes, in their region including but not limited to:
    • Standardized assessment trends
    • Level of service recommendation trends
    • Length of time in treatment trends
    • Transition status trends

The foregoing job responsibilities are illustrative only and are not meant to be exhaustive. ACES reserves the right to change, amend or modify the job description/responsibilities at any time and in its sole discretion.

title: Telehealth Clinician (Days, Thur-Fri)
description:
Position Summary:

The Tele Health Clinician is responsible for responding to and providing on-site and tele-video crisis assessments to ensure a patient receives the most appropriate level of care and treatment recommendation. The clinician is responsible for assessing and identifying behavioral, educational, developmental and psychosocial functioning of the patient and completing a clinical assessment using DSM criteria to determine best patient care. The clinician is responsible for facilitating the exchange of clinical collateral with referral sources to coordinate transfers and admissions. The clinician is responsible for completing medical necessity reviews with the insurance companies both for precertification and concurrent review.

Position Responsibilities:

Clinical / Technical Skills (40% of performance review)

  • Responds to initial notification within 15 minutes when receiving email notification of an assessment. Is prepared for tele-video assessment within 15 minutes of initial notification.
  • Confirms appt with patient and is able to connect via Zoom to complete assessment.
  • Completes the Intake Assessment within 45 minutes, preferably within 30 minutes.
  • Initiates clinical collateral gathering of referral source material within 30 minutes of notification.
  • Identifies need for the additional screenings to include: Substance Use Screening, Nutritional Screening, Abuse Screening and Functional Abilities Screening. For child and adolescent population, identifies needs for educational and developmental screens.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of admission criteria for inpatient, partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient levels of care.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of continued stay criteria for inpatient, partial hospitalization and intensive outpatient levels of care.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid and Managed Care Organizations to assist with the most appropriate disposition and care for the patient.
  • Demonstrates knowledge and competency in providing thorough and concise clinical information to the attending physician to secure treatment recommendation and disposition of the assessment.
  • Communicate effectively with providers, intake staff, Outpatient staff and fellow coworkers via teams group chat or verbally via phone.
  • Pre admits patients in Wellsky and sends message to appropriate Outpatient email group to notify them of patient who has been referred into their program.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of level of care criteria such that can provide treatment recommendations based upon clinical presentation
  • Ability to state local laws, ordinances, and practices governing involuntary hospitalization and ensure compliance with the same.
  • Ability to state the procedure for managing medical and psychiatric emergencies according to EMTALA guidelines along with facility policies and procedures.
  • Accurately documents all information related to a medical/psychiatric emergency transfer to include Memorandum of Transfers, consent/refusal for care, progress notes, MD consultation and signature.
  • Demonstrate understanding of tele health schedule to include working required shifts per month and request for time off policies.
  • Demonstrates an ability to be flexible, organized and function well in stressful situations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Safety (15% of performance review)

  • Strives to create a safe, healing environment for patients and family members
  • Follows all safety rules while on the job.
  • Reports “near misses”, as well as errors and accidents promptly.
  • Corrects minor safety hazards.
  • Communicate with peers and management regarding any hazards identified in the workplace.
  • Attends all required safety programs and understands responsibilities related to general, department, and job specific safety.
  • Participates in quality projects, as assigned, and supports quality initiatives.
  • Supports and maintains a culture of safety and quality.

Teamwork (15% of performance review)

  • Works well with others in a spirit of teamwork and cooperation.
  • Responds willingly to colleagues and serves as an active part of the hospital team.
  • Builds collaborative relationships with patients, families, staff, and physicians.
  • The ability to retrieve, communicate, and present data and information both verbally and in writing as required
  • Demonstrates listening skills and the ability to express or exchange ideas by means of the spoken and written word.
  • Demonstrates adequate skills in all forms of communication.
  • Adheres to the Standards of Behavior

Integrity (15% of performance review)

title: Property Associate
description:

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Job Title: Property Associate

Reports To: General Manager

Summary of Job Description:

Ensure organizational excellence by fulfilling administrative functions on the property team responsible for one or multiple buildings. Employee in this role will also provide accounting support. Property Associates maintain positive relations between tenants, client/property owner, and Jones Lang LaSalle, always providing superior customer service.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Participate in processing of A/P (accounts payable), reviewing and coding invoices for payment.
  • Participate in A/R (accounts receivable); preparing and distributing bills or statements, sending collection notices when appropriate, and preparing manual billing adjustments as needed.
  • Track administrative spend to not exceed budget and look for cost reduction opportunities.
  • Coordinate document management related to lease execution, distribution, and filing.
  • Track notification requirements as specified in leases to ensure that deadlines are not missed, and notifications are appropriately distributed.
  • Regularly monitor email, phones and work order system; ensuring prompt and courteous responses and directing correspondence to appropriate personnel as needed.
  • General office organization.
  • Sort, organize and distribute incoming mail. Prepare and send outgoing mail and packages.
  • Prepare and distribute general correspondence and memos.
  • Organize, compile and prepare reports for distribution.
  • Create and/or maintain physical and virtual filing systems in an accurate and organized manner.
  • Maintain and update employee, client, and customer contact databases.
  • Coordinate conference room reservations.
  • Organize department lunches, meetings, events and business travel.
  • Receive building access requests and coordinate access for visitors and vendors.
  • Ensure that tenant and contractor certificates of insurance are accurate and meet defined standards.
  • Track expiration dates for Tenant and Contractor certificates of Insurance and provide advance notice of upcoming expirations.
  • Support compliance with management audits and engineering operations audits by assisting in file preparation and record-keeping.
  • Participate in new tenant welcome and orientation program. Assist with move-in/move-out procedures.
  • Track and coordinate access card activation/deactivation as needed.
  • Assist property team in the development and implementation of property and employee manuals.
  • Keep regular contact with maintenance, security, and building staff to ensure that common areas such as lobby, elevators, exterior grounds, building-managed conference rooms, etc. are clean and secure.
  • As needed, document incidents of potential property and equipment liability (ex: any occurrence of an onsite injury), forward information to appropriate risk management personnel.
  • Gather W-9’s from vendors, and aid in new vendor set-ups as needed.
  • Assist team members with property budget preparation and recurring reporting, as requested.
  • Assist engineers with recording and billing, as appropriate, monthly utility meter readings.
  • Assist with vendor contract creation, execution and tracking as requested.
  • General and ad hoc administrative support of the property as needed
  • Any and all other duties and tasks assigned.

Skills/Qualifications:

  • High school diploma required
  • BA/BS preferred
  • Minimum 1 year in commercial real estate, property team experience, or office management experience
  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. Comfortable learning new programs and technology.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Self-starter, able to manage multiple projects simultaneously and under pressure.
  • Can work autonomously or as a member of the team. Interacts effectively with coworkers and internal clients at all levels and in multiple disciplines.
  • Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, proportions and percentages.
  • Capable of developing effective and constructive solutions to challenges and obstacles. Can cope with change, shift gears comfortably, decide and act without having the total picture, and comfortably handle uncertainty.
  • Ability to work, on occasion, flexible hours which may exceed 8 hours in a day, 5 days in a week or 40 hours in a week.

Physical Work Requirements and Work Conditions:

  • In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), the Sr Property Administrator’s responsibilities are such that in order to perform the required work in a safe and satisfactory manner, the following minimum physical requirements apply:
    • Is regularly required to sit for long periods of time
    • The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
    • Reading video display terminals, order forms and other written documents
    • Lifting a minimum of thirty-five (35) pounds
    • Using and accessing stairwells during emergencies
    • Using keyboards for typing and computer input
    • Hearing, speaking and answering the office telephone system
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disability the ability to perform the essential functions.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

50,000.00 – 62,000.00 USD per year

Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

On-site –Chicago, IL

Accounts Payable and Receivable, Accounts Receivable (AR), Administrative Support, Customer Service Operations, Facility Inspections, Lease Administration, Maintenance Coordination, Preventive Maintenance, Safety Compliance, Tenant Relationships, Vendor Management

title: Associate Project Manager, Payer & Employer Partnerships
description:
Trial Library is an AI-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine.
About Trial Library

Trial Library is an AI-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option - improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840+ clinics and 3,000+ providers nationwide.


About the Role

Reporting to the Head of Payer Strategy, the Associate Project Manager will support Trial Library’s payer and employer partnerships and make sure partners have a smooth experience from launch onward. This is a hands-on, client-facing role that requires cross-functional collaboration. You will be the day-to-day point of contact for active health plan and employer partners and keep every partner informed, supported, and engaged.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the main day-to-day contact for active health plan and employer partners: keep regular communication going, share updates, and gather feedback.

  • Lead implementation and launch of new partnerships, including eligibility file setup, referral pathways, member communication plans, and integration with existing care management or benefits programs.

  • Own all partner inquiries and troubleshooting, resolving issues quickly.

  • Work cross functionally with the operations, provider partnerships team, and products team leading efforts to ensure all client deliverables are executed on time and with superior quality in mind.

  • Deliver timely, accurate reports to partners on Trial Library’s performance, including member outreach, engagement, navigation, trial matching, and enrollment outcomes.

  • Help the Head of Payer Strategy develop value and ROI reporting that shows the clinical and economic impact of partnerships.

  • Prepare and lead partner presentations, from program launch to quarterly business reviews and renewal conversations.

  • Oversee all partner-facing materials, including member communications, benefit collateral, co-branded outreach, and performance documentation.

  • Track account health and flag chances to expand or renew to the Head of Payer Strategy.

  • Help build scalable processes for partner onboarding, reporting, and account management.

  • Make sure partner communications and data handling follow HIPAA and contract requirements.

  • Stay current on Trial Library’s product offering and value for health plans, employers, and their members.

Your Requirements:

  • 3–5 years of experience in health plan operations, employer benefits, care management, healthcare account management, or customer success.

  • Experience with payer or employer reporting needs, such as engagement and utilization metrics, outcomes, and value or ROI reporting.

  • Familiarity with health plan operations, employer-sponsored benefits, or population health programs.

  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and handling protected health information (PHI).

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners at once.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of professionalism with internal and external stakeholders.

  • An analytical approach, comfortable using data to drive action and tell a clear story.

  • A bias toward action, stepping in before issues arise.

  • Able to work autonomously.

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or a high-growth startup.

  • Familiarity with oncology, clinical trials, precision medicine, or patient navigation.

  • Experience supporting value-based care programs or payer partnerships.

  • Experience with CRM and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Looker).

Why Trial Library

  • Meaningful impact — helping patients access clinical trials faster through better technology and workflows
  • High ownership environment — autonomy to build, test, and influence strategy across the business
  • Collaborative team culture — low ego, high trust, and close partnership across functions
  • Opportunity for growth — join at an early stage with meaningful exposure to company-building and decision-making

Our Core Values

  • Ally is our favorite moniker
  • The broadest reach is worth the effort
  • Celebrate measurable improvements in access and outcomes
  • Fearless advocates for representation in research
  • Incentives matter to stakeholders choosing our products
  • Taking initiative is actually giving
  • We are accountable for the experience of patients and providers
  • Empathy and humility are the real dynamic duo

Our Benefits & Perks

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, along with disability, life, and supplemental insurance options designed to support your overall well-being.
  • Time Off & Workplace Support: Flexible paid time off, observed company holidays, and a one-time home office stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace within our hybrid environment.
  • Financial & Lifestyle Benefits: 401(k) program, pre-tax HSA and FSA options, commuter benefits, financial wellness resources, and access to legal protection plans to support both short- and long-term planning.
  • Additional Support & Voluntary Benefits: Access to voluntary benefit offerings including pet wellness support, domestic partner coverage, and additional programs that support the diverse needs of our team members and their families.

Our Interview Process

Our interview process typically includes four stages, followed by reference checks and an offer. Depending on the role, particularly for technical or senior positions, the process may vary slightly and can include a technical assessment, case study, presentation, practical exercise, additional interview conversations, or conversations with members of our leadership team and investors.

Trial Library, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, military status, medical condition, family or medical leave status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
