title: 1825 Principal DJJ Realignment Analyst II, ID# 168051, JUV
description:
The Principal Program & Policy Analyst II directs policy and program implementation for activities related to Division of Juvenile Justice (DJJ) Realignment across the San Franisco Juvenile Probation Department (JPD), in close collaboration with Department leadership, Juvenile Justice Center (JJC) Division, Probation Services Division, Administration Division, community-based and government stakeholders, youth, and families. Under the supervision of the Director of Grants, Analytics, and Planning, the Principal Program & Policy Analyst II acts as direct support to JPD leadership in implementing DJJ Realignment and leads strategy, prioritization, planning, coordination, implementation, and monitoring for efforts related to DJJ Realignment, San Francisco’s Secure Youth Treatment Facility, young people with long-term commitments to the JJC, and young people reentering the community after such commitments

Essential Functions of the position include:

  1. Oversees implementation of all components of San Francisco’s DJJ Realignment Plan in collaboration with all three JPD Divisions, government partners, and community-based organizations—including: procurement, partnerships, outreach, program development and implementation, and meeting coordination.
  2. Working independently, researches, analyzes, gathers input from internal and external stakeholders and makes program and policy recommendations on special projects, especially those related to DJJ Realignment, with significant financial impact, that are highly visible public issues, and have direct impact to young people, including administrative policies, practices, and procedures. Directs and supports JPD mission-critical operational activities; represents the department to city officials, outside agencies and the public; and provides administrative analysis to executive team including Chief Probation Officer, Assistant Chief Probation Officer, Deputy Director of Administrative Services, Director of Juvenile Facilities, Direction of Probation Services, and Director of Grants, Analytics, and Planning.
  3. Plans, develops, and directs the implementation of programs and policies that affect young people, JPD staff, and other system and community partners; directs and supports cross-functional project teams to implement the vision and strategy of the Chief while ensuring alignment with state legislation and regulations.
  4. Manages complex procurement that aligns with the needs of the Department, long-term committed youth, and state legislative mandates.
  5. Identifies, oversees, and implements new projects and systems that are necessary to serve long-term committed youth, both in custody and upon release, to fulfill the mission of the Department, and meet state legal mandates.
  6. Establishes, administers, monitors, coordinates and acts as program manager on complex grants; ensures compliance and reporting for grant-funded organizations; supports Finance Unit in reviewing, approving, and communicating funding expectations to grantees and other partners.

Education: Possession of a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university

Experience: Seven (7) years of full-time equivalent experience performing professional level analytical work. Qualifying professional-level analytical work includes analysis, development, administration, and reporting in major programs and functions of an organization in the areas of budgets, contracts, grants, policy, or other functional areas related to the duties of positions in the 182X Class series.

Substitution: Possession of a graduate degree (Master's degree or higher) from an accredited college or university with major coursework in specialized subject matter areas such as public or business administration, management, business law, contract law, public policy, urban studies, economics, statistical analysis, finance, accounting or other fields of study closely related to the essential functions of positions in the Class series may be substituted for one (1) year of required experience.

Additional experience as described above may be substituted for the required degree on a year-for-year basis (up to a maximum of 2 years). Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units equal one year.

Desirable Qualifications

  1. Prior experience identifying and spearheading new initiatives, piloting systems, and managing high-level, complex projects that have high financial impact and high public visibility.
  2. Prior experience supporting executive level staff in vision and strategy implementation and program and policy development and execution.
  3. Prior experience supporting and/or directing complex, cross-functional project teams staffed with professional-level employees who may not be direct reports.
  4. Prior experience applying for, securing funding, and reporting on state and federal grant opportunities as well as administering, monitoring, and managing grants to nonprofit providers.
  5. Prior experience working directly with juvenile justice involved youth in residential facilities.
  6. Prior experience collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders to implement new policies, procedures, and programs.
  7. Prior experience with system transformation, culture change, and program development and implementation in an institutional setting and/or law enforcement agency.
  8. Professional juvenile justice, criminal justice, or social services experience in the government or nonprofit sectors.

This role is accountable for a ensuring safe, compliant, reliable, and efficient housing unit experience, while managing service performance, vendors, budgets, employees, and continuous improvement at this critical location.


This position serves as the primary facilities and workplace experience contact for client leadership, employees, housed contractors, vendors, and service partners. The role directly manages the Field Coordinator Leads and Field Coordinators and provides operational direction to housing related operations personnel, contractors, vendors, and other service providers.

  • Lead daily facilities and workplace operations at this Monahans, (West) Texas location.

  • Monitor vendor performance against contracts, scopes of work, KPIs, SLAs, safety requirements, and quality standards.

  • Ensure appropriate staffing, service coverage, and coordination across all assigned locations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Real Estate, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated facilities or workplace management experience in a corporate, commercial real estate, or integrated facilities management environment.

  • Experience with operating budgets, forecasting, financial reporting, and capital planning preferred.
  • Working knowledge of building mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and life-safety systems.
  • Experience with CMMS/work order management systems and operational performance reporting.
  • Strong leadership, client relationship, financial management, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple employees, vendors, priorities, vendors, projects, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • The site is located in Monahans, TX. This is not a standard hybrid or remote position. Requires on-site presence managing multi-shift employees. Shift and coverage schedule will be flexible, but with enough overlap between day and night shifts to be effective.

  • Requires a visible, hands-on management presence across the assigned portfolio.

title: Family Visitation Program Supervisor
description:
Family Visitation Program Supervisor

Community Care is seeking a full-time Supervisor to supervise the Family Visitation Program in York and Cumberland Counties with a base of Biddeford. The supervisor will oversee District 1 and 2 staff which includes, Biddeford, Sanford, Bath, and Portland. The Supervisor will be responsible for supervising and supporting Visit Support Workers, reviewing and assigning visitation referrals, assisting in supervising visits when necessary, overseeing the visitation centers, reviewing documentation, and working as a member of a team to manage the Family Visitation Program. They will have availability during the peak hours of 2-7pm Monday through Friday, with the flexibility to adjust work hours as necessary to meet the needs of the program. An agency cell phone and laptop are provided.

The Supervisor must have reliable transportation and a State of Maine driver's license to provide transportation for youth to and from visits as necessary. To fulfill the duties of this position, you must be able to lift young children in and out of vehicles/car seats and carry infants in their car seats/young children to and from vehicles.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Minimum of 21 years of age or older;
  • Bachelor's degree in social work or related field;
  • At least 12 months of previously documented experience working with children and families
  • Minimum of one year supervisory experience.

We offer:

  • A competitive wage
  • Generous benefits package including fully paid dental insurance and medical insurance offered with a minimal employee contribution
  • Mileage Reimbursement
  • A supportive team environment
  • Excellent supervision and training
  • Company cell phone and laptop provided

To view all openings, visit our website at http://www.comcareme.org/Careers/CareersOverview.aspx

Community Care offers community-based support and mental health services to individuals and families throughout Maine. We are committed to excellence in service delivery and we value strong cooperative efforts between community providers. POSITION PURPOSE

Northern Texas Facial and Oral Surgery is seeking a skilled, dependable, and patient-focused Oral Surgery Assistant to join our team.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, team-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced surgical environment. This position plays an important role in supporting our surgeons, maintaining clinical efficiency, and providing a high standard of care and service to our patients.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

- Chairside Surgical Support: Assist surgeons during oral and maxillofacial surgery procedures, ensuring all necessary instruments, equipment, and materials are properly prepared and readily available.

- Patient Care: Prepare patients for surgical procedures, obtain and document necessary clinical information, provide reassurance, and review pre-operative and post-operative instructions as directed.

- Surgical Room Preparation: Set up and break down surgical operatories efficiently and ensure rooms are properly prepared for each patient and procedure.

- Sterilization & Infection Control: Clean, disinfect, and sterilize instruments and equipment while maintaining strict infection-control protocols and compliance with OSHA and practice safety standards.

- Radiography & Imaging: Obtain dental radiographs and assist with panoramic and CBCT imaging as needed and within applicable certification requirements.

- Clinical Documentation: Accurately document appropriate patient and procedure information in the patient's clinical record.

- Implant Tracking: Assist with maintaining accurate dental implant inventory, including monitoring implant sizes and quantities, documenting implants used during procedures, tracking lot and reference numbers, and ensuring appropriate inventory levels are maintained.

- Inventory & Supplies: Monitor clinical inventory, restock surgical rooms, and help ensure adequate levels of instruments, medications, materials, and supplies are maintained.

- Patient Flow: Work efficiently with the clinical and front-office teams to maintain appropriate patient flow and support the daily surgical schedule.

- Team Collaboration: Communicate and work collaboratively with surgeons, fellow Surgical Assistants, and administrative team members to support excellent patient care.

- Versatility: Support additional clinical and administrative tasks as needed to meet the needs of the practice.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Safety Adherent: Follow strict safety guidelines and procedures according to OSHA and office standards.

• Clear Communicator: Effectively communicate verbally with patients and staff in a clear and professional manner.

• Detail-Oriented: Work efficiently with a keen eye for detail.

• Flexible Worker: Adapt to changing job duties, work schedules, and traveling to all of our locations as needed

• Active Listener: Demonstrate active listening by fully engaging in conversations, understanding points being made, asking relevant questions, and avoiding inappropriate interruptions.

• Positive Attitude: have a team-oriented mindset and willingness to learn and grow

Certifications and Safety Requirements:

1. CPR and RDA Certification REQUIRED

2. Oral Surgery or Periodontal Surgery experience preferred

3. Oral and Maxillofacial Assisting/Dental Assistant Certification preferred

4. Hepatitis B Vaccination and Titer

6. TB Vaccination and Titer

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Competitive pay based on experience and qualifications

- Health, dental, and vision insurance

- Paid time off and paid holidays

- Retirement benefits

- Uniform allowance

- Opportunities for professional development and continued growth

JOIN OUR TEAM

If you meet the required qualifications and are interested in joining a professional, patient-focused oral surgery team, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to learning more about your experience and qualifications.

title: Exempt to Permanent – Manager I (0922) Citywide (E10194)
description:
Under administrative direction, incumbents in this class provide mid-level management functions in an operating department with responsibility for a section, program or defined functional area and may assume responsibility for one or more section(s) or operational area(s) or operationally-related services.

Incumbents in these positions make decisions which impact the daily operations and implementation of established procedures and policies of the related units/sections and solve problems requiring analyses of issues that may result in deviations from routine processes, new technology and/or additional resources. These Managers typically contact and/or establish working relationships with others at similar levels within the organization and coordinate budget preparation, monitoring expenditures and financial reporting for the assigned section; and perform related duties as required.

Incumbents in this class assume responsibility for multiple sections providing complex, related functions or services. In appropriate decisions at this level would impact the economic vitality, health, or welfare of a segment of the City’s population.

Incumbents make decisions which require discretion in applying general goal and policy statements and in resolving organizational and service delivery problems. At this level, inappropriate decisions may compromise the effective functioning of the section and result in a negative impact on the health or welfare of a segment of the City’s population. Managers in this class typically manage supervisors of clerical, maintenance and/technical employees.

Supervision Exercised: Managers in this class typically manage supervisors of clerical, maintenance and/or technical employees.

Examples of Important and Essential Duties:

  1. Manages programs, operational activities, or projects of assigned section or program area; supervises, trains and evaluates the activities of personnel and/or coordinates and monitors the work of consultants and contractors working for the department; works with other managers and staff to evaluate and implement goals, responsibilities, policies and procedures of the division.
  2. Monitors the work of and coaches subordinates to improve performance.
  3. Evaluates procedures, identifies and analyses problems and issues and may implement and document new procedures of the assigned section/program.
  4. Participates in budget development by providing detailed justification and persuasive arguments for proposals or initiatives.
  5. Coordinates budget preparation, monitors expenditures and financial reporting for assigned section; prepares reports, memoranda, and correspondence; and maintains statistical records. Implements and closely monitors budget expenditures; provides executive management with an early warning and practical options to potential cost overruns.
  6. Directs the allocation of resources to achieve timely outcomes and measurable goals within budget; adjusts plans and programs to meet emerging or new programs, while continuing to address major departmental priorities.
  7. Assists in developing and implementing operational policies to ensure the efficient operation of section or program.

Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications requirement by the final filing date unless otherwise noted.

  1. Current Category 16, 17, or 18 Exempt Employee in Class 0922 who has worked at least 2,080 hours in class 0922; AND

title: Payer Strategy & Contracting Principal
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Provider Contracting Principal is responsible for developing and executing on the payer strategy, leading contract negotiations, managing payer relationships, and driving operational implementation and financial performance for an assigned market/payer portfolio.

This role connects enterprise priorities related to payer mix, growth, network access, reimbursement, and economic sustainability with regional and market leadership and key cross-functional partners, including Sales, Operations, Finance, Revenue Cycle, Clinical, Legal, and Compliance. The Principal ensures payer agreements are strategically aligned, financially viable, operationally executable, and well-positioned to deliver measurable value.

The Principal independently leads assigned payer initiatives and negotiations within delegated authority and established governance and approval processes and serves as a key business partner to market and enterprise leadership.

The Payer Strategy and Contracting team leads the development, negotiation, implementation, and ongoing management of profitable national, regional, state and local payer relationships across episodic, fee-for-service, and value-based reimbursement models.

In partnership with Business Development and other enterprise stakeholders, the team evaluates and supports preferred provider and contracted business opportunities across the acute and post-acute continuum, including Medicare Advantage, Commercial, and other value-based payment models.

The Provider Contracting Principal translates enterprise payer strategy into market-level execution. The role evaluates payer opportunities, develops contracting strategies, negotiates agreements, leads cross-functional implementation, manages payer relationships, monitors contract performance, and identifies opportunities to improve reimbursement, access, volume, and financial outcomes.

Payer Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute payer-specific and market-specific action plans aligned with enterprise payer strategy, growth priorities, and operational capacity.
  • Evaluate payer opportunities using referral trends, membership and enrollment data, reimbursement, financial performance, market dynamics, operational capacity, and strategic fit.
  • Analyze current payer and market performance to identify growth opportunities, network gaps, underperforming agreements, renewal priorities, reimbursement opportunities, and potential termination risks.
  • Develop recommendations regarding payer participation, contracting priorities, reimbursement strategies, and preferred provider opportunities.
  • Partner with operational, sales, clinical, and market leadership to establish strategic objectives before negotiations and operational implementation.

Contracting & Negotiation

  • Lead the development, negotiation, renewal, and amendment of assigned national, regional, state and local payer agreements within delegated authority and established governance requirements.
  • Evaluate reimbursement methodologies and contract terms to determine appropriate financial and operational structures.
  • Partner with Finance and Operations to develop financial analyses, business cases, rate recommendations, and contract feasibility assessments.
  • Negotiate reimbursement, operational, administrative, and other material contract provisions in collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Revenue Cycle, Clinical, and operational stakeholders.
  • Coordinate stakeholder review, leadership approvals, agreement execution, renewal planning, and key contractual milestones.
  • Present contracting strategies, recommendations, risks, and business cases to leadership and governance forums as appropriate.

Operational Implementation & Execution

  • Translate contractual requirements into clear operational expectations for referral intake, authorizations, clinical operations, billing, reimbursement, and revenue cycle.
  • Lead cross-functional implementation of new and amended payer agreements, establishing accountable owners, deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and escalation pathways.
  • Partner with operational and functional leaders to develop workflows, communications, reporting, and other processes required for successful implementation.
  • Identify and coordinate resolution of payer-related issues involving referrals, authorizations, eligibility, denials, payment, reimbursement, or other contract requirements.
  • Lead or support time-sensitive payer initiatives and escalations that may materially affect patient access, revenue, reimbursement, or market performance.

Payer Relationship Management

  • Serve as a primary business and contracting contact for assigned payer relationships.
  • Develop and maintain productive relationships across payer contracting, network management, clinical, operations, and other relevant functions.
  • Establish and facilitate recurring payer business reviews focused on contract performance, operational issues, growth opportunities, quality, and strategic priorities.
  • Coordinate escalation and resolution of material payer issues.
  • Identify opportunities to expand network access, referral volume, preferred provider relationships, care coordination, quality initiatives, and value-based arrangements.

Financial Performance & Analytics

  • Monitor payer and contract performance against negotiated terms, reimbursement assumptions, volume expectations, and applicable financial measures.
  • Evaluate actual reimbursement against contractual expectations and identify reimbursement leakage, unfavorable trends, and operational drivers of performance.
  • Partner with Finance, Revenue Cycle, Operations, and other stakeholders to determine root causes and develop corrective action plans.
  • Assess the financial impact of proposed reimbursement changes and alternative payment methodologies.
  • Provide leadership with clear reporting and recommendations regarding contract performance, financial risks, growth opportunities, renewals, and corrective actions.

Governance & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across Operations, Sales, Finance, Revenue Cycle, Clinical, Legal, Compliance, Business Development, and other stakeholders throughout the contract lifecycle.
  • Ensure appropriate market, operational, financial, and functional input is obtained and documented before contract approval.
  • Prepare concise business cases, recommendations, and decision materials for established contracting and payer governance forums.
  • Maintain appropriate contract documentation, decision records, action logs, implementation plans, and renewal milestones.
  • Proactively identify and escalate material financial, operational, contractual, compliance, or implementation risks.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource to leadership and internal stakeholders regarding assigned payer relationships and contracting strategies.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Five or more years of experience in managed care, payer contracting, provider relations, payer account management, healthcare finance, business development, or healthcare operations.
  • Demonstrated experience interpreting payer agreements and reimbursement structures and leading contract negotiations.
  • Strong financial acumen and demonstrated ability to evaluate reimbursement methodologies, contract economics, and business cases.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in home health, post-acute care, and/or managed care.
  • Knowledge of episodic, fee-for-service, and value-based reimbursement payment models, authorization requirements, and revenue cycle processes.
  • Experience leading complex initiatives requiring coordination across multiple functional and operational stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple payer priorities, deadlines, negotiations, and implementation activities with a high degree of independence.
  • Experience with contract performance reporting, reimbursement analysis, and payer-provider issue resolution.
  • Experience presenting contracting strategies, business cases, and recommendations to senior leadership.

title: Investment Analyst
description:
At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. That means creating investment solutions that are well designed, carefully managed and focused on delivering good outcomes for customers.

As an Investment Analyst within AJ Bell Investments, you’ll play an important part in shaping and managing our discretionary portfolios. Working closely with the Head of Investment Solutions and colleagues across Investments, you’ll turn market insight, research and data into practical portfolio decisions, helping ensure our investment solutions remain robust, relevant and straightforward for the people who invest with us.

It’s a varied role combining investment analysis, portfolio implementation and product governance, with the opportunity to contribute ideas, challenge thinking and help us continually improve how we invest for our customers.

What you’ll do

  • Help shape our managed portfolios, supporting strategic and tactical asset allocation and translating investment thinking into effective portfolio implementation.
  • Turn research into investment decisions, working closely with the Research team to develop appropriate portfolio implementation strategies.
  • Support strong investment governance, helping design and monitor Investment Policy Statements and ensuring portfolios remain aligned with their objectives.
  • Bring investment data to life, developing meaningful management information, capital market assumptions reporting and clear insights that support informed decision-making.
  • Put portfolio decisions into practice, supporting fund trading, model portfolio updates and the ongoing maintenance of AJ Bell’s discretionary managed portfolios.

  • A forward-thinking mindset. You’ll be comfortable contributing ideas, looking for better ways of doing things and taking ownership of your work.
  • Most importantly, you’ll bring sound judgement, curiosity and a genuine interest in helping create investment solutions that deliver good outcomes for customers.

About AJ Bell

At AJ Bell, we believe investing should feel good. Whether you're looking for an ISA, pension or dealing account, whether you want to invest with the help of a financial adviser or do it yourself, we have easy-to-use solutions to suit people from all walks of life.

We're one of the UK's fastest-growing investment platform businesses, trusted by everyone from professional financial advisers to first-time investors.

Today, over 723,000 customers trust us to manage more than £108.7 billion of assets. By continually striving to make investing simpler and more accessible, we're helping more people take control of their financial futures.

We're proud to be recognised as one of the UK's Best 100 Companies to Work For for six consecutive years, and a Great Place to Work® in 2025 and 2026, a reflection of our supportive and collaborative culture.

  • 26 days holiday, increasing with service + buy/sell scheme + bank holidays

Our ways of working

At AJ Bell, our people are the heart of our culture. We believe in building strong connections by working together. For new team members, an initial period will be spent full-time in the office to help you immerse yourself in our business and build valuable relationships with your colleagues.

We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work.

We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.

title: Healthcare Assistant
description:
Healthcare Assistant


Do you have the passion to maintain high standards of care? The methodical approach to follow strict procedures? The dedication to help and support a team of colleagues?


We are seeking a pro-active individual, ideally from a healthcare background and preferably with an NVQ Level 2 in Health and Social Care to join our clinic as a Healthcare Assistant in Bath.


What does the role involve?


Under the supervision of a Registered Nurse, you will prepare, restore and maintain areas and equipment for clinical treatments and investigations, as well as generally ensuring that the treatment environment is safe for patients, relatives and visitors.


This is an active role which involves extensive walking between patients throughout the clinic and some lifting responsibilities. However, we will provide regular training and guidance, so that you can develop your knowledge of company practice, procedures and quality management. Computer skills are essential, with good interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong working relationships with the team.


Bath Dialysis Unit operates 16 haemodialysis stations, serving up to 64 patients, in partnership with North Bristol Trust using only the latest equipment.


This is a full time role of 37.5 hours a week. Current days are working various shifts between 7.00am to 11.30pm Monday to Saturday.

What can we offer you?


Here at Fresenius Medical Care we provide excellent and continuous Training and Development throughout your career.


We offer a competitive salary UPTO £26,000 - Progression through the pay scale will be underpinned by a Knowledge and Skills Framework (KSF) for each role, allowing employees greater career development potential, aligned to in-house training programmes.


Alongside this we offer a wealth of other fantastic benefits listed below:


  • No Sunday or Night Shift Working
  • Company Pension Scheme and Life Assurance
  • 33 Days Holiday (inclusive of 8 days bank holiday) increasing with service
  • Christmas Day and New Year’s Day off
  • Overtime (time and a half after completing full-time hours – 150 hours every 4 weeks)
  • Paid Breaks
  • Free Uniform, Tea & Coffee, Flu Vaccine and Christmas Meal
  • Health Shield – Company paid Health Cash Plan
  • Long Service Vouchers
  • Sick Pay
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Sponsorship for training where applicable for career development
  • bhsf RISE - our Health and Wellbeing hub with 24/7 access to GP’s and Counsellors
  • Blue Light Card - discounts online and in-store

Who is Fresenius Medical Care?


We are the leading provider of dialysis services to the NHS, operating 52 partnership dialysis units that together provide regular dialysis treatment to over 3,800 NHS patients in the UK. We are part of a global company treating over 344,000 patients worldwide across over 4,000 clinics.


We also operate 44 production sites on all continents to provide dialysis products such as dialysis machines, dialysers and related disposables. 1 in every 2 of all dialysis machines used around the globe are manufactured by Fresenius Medical Care and we are the 3rd largest medical devices company in the world.


For more information please visit Fresenius Medical Care’s provider website: www.nephrocare.co.uk


We are a growing and ambitious company who invests in talent and creates an environment where you can grow too. Come on our journey with us, see your skills develop and be rewarded for the exceptional care you give!

description:
INFICON is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead the successful delivery of deployment programs for our FPS product line in the EMEA region. In this strategic role, you will own the end-to-end deployment program management for customer projects, ensuring seamless execution, customer satisfaction, and alignment with organizational objectives. You will serve as the primary management escalation point and direct channel between INFICON and our customers in the EMEA region.

Program & Project Leadership

  • Own the deployment program lifecycle from initiation to closure, ensuring alignment with customer expectations and contractual commitments
  • Define, document, and track SOWs, schedules, milestones, issues, and resource plans for customer projects
  • Manage scope, budget, schedule, and resources; identify variances early and implement corrective actions

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary escalation point and direct contact for customer project managers across EMEA

  • Collaborate with the IFO consulting team, global and regional sales, and software development on all project aspects

Team & Delivery

Technical Deployment

  • Support the deployment and operation of FPS software and Industrial Engineering systems, including scheduling and process control
  • Contribute to ETL development and data migration to ensure successful system integration
  • Provide technical assistance, onsite training, and product demonstrations to customers and sales teams

Reporting, Governance & Improvement

  • Prepare weekly deployment status reports and KPI reporting (schedule and budget variance, quality, customer satisfaction)
  • Ensure adherence to standardized project management processes and best practices
  • Drive continuous improvement based on lessons learned
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong project management skills in planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution; PMP or similar certification is a plus
  • Knowledge of MES, data warehouses, ETL, and dashboards, plus hands-on experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., Oracle)

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to build strong relationships with customers and colleagues
  • Independent, analytical, and solution-oriented

  • Opportunities to share bold ideas and contribute creatively
  • Flexible work hours

title: Data Integrity Associate Specialist
description:
Major Function

World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Data Integrity Associate Specialist. This position plays an important role in WWF’s Fundraising Operations and Analytics team. This position ensures the quality and integrity of data across WWF’s fundraising and constituent systems, spanning multiple channels such as direct marketing, online fundraising, development, advocacy, events, travel, and more.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Investigation & Resolution:
    • Leverage constituent query and other analytical tools to investigate and resolve data anomalies.
    • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to gather necessary information.
    • Resolve issues in a timely manner.
    • Communicate findings and resolutions effectively.
  • Constituent Duplicate Management
    • Conduct ongoing identification and resolution of data integrity issues, including anomalies in constituent biographical data and potential duplicate records,
    • Investigate and execute merge requests in a timely manner, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
    • Proactively serve as a resource for other teams by providing guidance and resolution on potential duplicate records or related data integrity concerns.
  • Vendor & Data Exchange Management:
    • Assist in the data exchange with WWF’s vendors including direct mail, travel and telemarketing vendors.
    • Help review and update of existing documentation
  • CRM Expertise & Support
    • Serve as the point of contact for WWF’s email marketing system, Engaging Networks. Collaborate with the Digital Marketing Systems Manager, the eCRM Integrations Administrator, and the Online e-Marketing Managers to resolve unexpected data issues.
    • Develop in-depth knowledge of WWF’s CRM environment to resolve data integrity issues
    • Provide input to Data Integrity team and appropriate stakeholders on improving business processes. These areas include but are not limited to all constituent data, revenue, events, benefits, query and export.
  • Process Development
    • Collaborate with Data Integrity, CRM Services, and key stakeholders to assist in the development new processes and enhance existing business processes.
    • Focus on improvements that enhance the donor experience and increase efficiency for other teams. These initiatives should prioritize broader organizational impact rather than solely optimizing Data Integrity team workflows.
  • Documentation
    • Help maintain the team repository for documentation and supporting worksheets for significant data clean up.
    • Create, review, and update knowledge base articles for both new and revised processes.
    • Communicate these changes to relevant stakeholders.
  • Ticket Management & Troubleshooting
    • Monitor, trige, and resolve incoming Data Integrity tickets through ITWorks.
    • Escalate complex or systemic issues to the appropriate team members.
  • Project & Query Management:
    • Update and manage CRM queries and exports for all annual and ad-hoc projects.
    • Create and manage correction work plans for data integrity issues, including timeline development and task coordination.
  • Cross Departmental Collaboration:
    • Identify data-related challenges across departments and collaborate on scalable, efficient solutions.
  • General:
    • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Competencies

  • Attention to Detail & Accuracy: Detail-oriented while ensuring accuracy and quality when working with donor records and managing complex data anomaly issues. Works independently, applies expertise to manage assigned processes, troubleshoot issues, and ensure consistent, accurate execution.
  • Analytical Thinking & Problem-Solving: Proactively analyzes data to identify patterns and potential data issues, research solutions, and make informed operational decisions to resolve data anomalies. Maintains high standards for data quality and operational execution while identifying opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and effectiveness.
  • Collaboration & Teamwork: Works cross-functionally with WWF teams and vendors to build productive relationships, communicate effectively, and achieve organizational goals.
  • Communication & Decision-Making: Actively listens, discusses options, incorporates direction and feedback, and collaborates with others using effective written and verbal communication skills to make and implement informed decisions.
  • Continuous Learning & Improvement: Demonstrates curiosity, initiative, a willingness to learn and apply new skills, and identifies opportunities to improve processes and efficiency.
  • Resourcefulness & Organization: Ability to work independently and use resources effectively and efficiently to manage time, address complex challenges and to document and organize information and processes.

    Skills and Abilities

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
    • At least two years of relevant experience is required.
    • An innate curiosity about why data anomalies are occurring.
    • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, are required
    • Experience in Blackbaud CRM preferred
    • Experience in Engaging Networks helpful
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required
    • Must have ability to work both independently and effectively as a member of a team
    • Must be able to meet deadlines and prioritize work as needed
    • Ability and interest in learning new skills and tools.
    • Committed to building and strengthening a culture of inclusion within and across teams.
    • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values:
      • COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home.
      • INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve.
      • RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future.
      • COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation.

    Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

    Relocation is not provided for this position.

    World Wildlife Fund (WWF) promotes equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

title: Product Specialist (Hematology)
description:
To drive the successful launch, promotion, and growth of a new hematology product by executing effective territory plans, developing strong relationships with healthcare professionals, and delivering high-quality scientific product communication. The Product Specialist will contribute to achieving sales objectives, expanding product awareness, supporting market access initiatives, and improving patient care through appropriate product adoption.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

New Product Launch & Sales Execution

  • Execute territory launch plans and promotional activities in alignment with company objectives and brand strategy.
  • Identify and prioritize key hematologists, hospitals, and healthcare institutions to maximize product awareness and adoption.
  • Achieve assigned sales targets and launch objectives through effective territory management and customer engagement.
  • Identify market opportunities, competitive activities, and barriers to product uptake, providing timely feedback to management.
  • Monitor territory performance and collaborate with the Sales Manager to implement corrective actions when required.

Territory & Key Account Management

  • Develop and implement territory Plans of Action (POA) and key account plans in collaboration with the Sales Manager.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with hematologists, clinical pharmacists, and relevant hospital stakeholders.
  • Understand customer needs, hospital treatment protocols, formulary processes, and patient pathways.
  • Support hospital product listing and availability through coordination with relevant internal departments.
  • Ensure effective territory coverage and timely follow-up on customer commitments.

Scientific Product Promotion

  • Develop strong knowledge of hematology diseases, treatment guidelines, product clinical data, and the competitive landscape.
  • Deliver accurate, evidence-based product presentations highlighting approved indications, efficacy, safety, and clinical value.
  • Conduct effective face-to-face customer interactions and product discussions aligned with approved promotional materials.
  • Address customer questions professionally and refer medical inquiries to the appropriate internal teams when required.
  • Participate in scientific meetings, educational activities, and product launch initiatives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Medical, Regulatory Affairs, and Supply Chain teams to support successful product launch execution.
  • Share customer insights, competitor intelligence, and market feedback to improve territory performance.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to support product availability and resolve customer-related challenges.
  • Participate in regular team meetings, business reviews, and product training sessions.

Performance Management & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate customer profiles, visit reports, and sales activities within the CRM system.

title: Occupancy Planning Lead
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Location: Chandler, AZ or Hillsboro, OR (Onsite)


What this job involves:

As an Occupancy Planning Lead at JLL, you'll direct our team supporting a major technology client, serving as the trusted advisor for all occupancy planning services. This role blends strategy and execution—leveraging industry expertise and best practices to deliver exceptional outcomes while providing thought leadership that shapes how clients optimize their real estate portfolios. You'll lead a geographically distributed team across the United States and Latin America.


At JLL, we're shaping a brighter way for our clients, ourselves, and our fellow employees—and this role exemplifies that commitment. You'll balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem-solving, build critical relationships across JLL and client organizations, and champion innovative approaches to workplace planning. Your expertise will drive space utilization strategies, sequence complex moves, and resolve planning challenges that align with broader business goals.


What your day-to-day will look like:

  • Lead, develop, and mentor a team of 9 occupancy planners across the U.S. and Latin America, fostering collaboration and growth across geographies and cultures
  • Build strategic relationships with client leadership and internal JLL teams, serving as primary point of contact for occupancy planning and coordination across business units
  • Develop occupancy plans and move sequences that maximize space utilization, align with client objectives, and balance competing portfolio priorities
  • Analyze real estate data using Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, advanced calculations) and AI tools to uncover insights and inform strategic decisions
  • Collaborate with leadership to recommend space policies, develop site strategies, and guide workplace optimization and portfolio planning
  • Lead your team through ambiguous situations, setting clear direction and expectations to ensure timely, measurable results
  • Create persuasive presentations and executive communications that translate technical data and floor plans into actionable recommendations
  • Champion innovation using generative AI tools to streamline research and enhance deliverable quality
  • Navigate organizational change with resilience and strategic acumen, driving sustainable, risk-informed transformation

Required qualifications:

  • 5–7 years in strategic occupancy planning, interior office planning, or corporate real estate data analytics
  • Experience leading large-scale teams, with proven success managing geographically distributed, remote teams across time zones, cultures, and working styles
  • Strong communication skills, from active listening to persuasive presentations, engaging all levels from admin to executive
  • Advanced Excel skills: pivot tables, XLOOKUP, complex calculations, floor plan interpretation
  • Strong stakeholder management; builds relationships, coordinates across JLL, balances competing priorities diplomatically
  • Transformation- and execution-focused, with structured problem-solving and commercial acumen
  • Proven project management: structuring, staffing, setting clear expectations, and taking corrective action
  • Resourceful and resilient in ambiguous situations, with strong ethical standards
  • Collaborative, influential leadership style that drives urgency and unites teams around a common vision

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Management, Architecture, Design, Real Estate, Data Analytics, or related field
  • Experience managing P&L, or supporting transformation initiatives in corporate real estate or consulting
  • Deep expertise in occupancy planning, space optimization, and portfolio management, with a track record of driving sustainable change
  • Experience as a trusted advisor to executives or leading cross-functional teams in complex corporate settings
  • Experience managing international or cross-regional teams with cultural awareness and adaptability
  • Experience implementing workplace technologies, leading digital transformation, or serving as SME for CAFM/IWMS platforms
  • Track record developing SOPs or leading change management initiatives with measurable operational results

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

On-site –Aloha,OR, Beaverton, OR, Chandler, AZ, Gilbert, AZ, Hillsboro, OR, Mesa, AZ, Tempe, AZ

title: Senior QA
description:
Our client is a SaaS company building quality and compliance software for highly regulated industries such as life sciences. They're investing in two priority programs, a modernization of their platform to a microservices architecture and a new mobile app built in React Native, and they're adding senior engineering and quality capacity to their existing scrum teams to speed both up.
What You'll Do
The Senior Quality Automation Engineer is embedded in one of the client's scrum teams, either Architecture Modernization or Mobile, and owns automated quality for new services and mobile features. You'll build and maintain automated regression and performance testing, integrate quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, and make sure test coverage grows with every new service and feature. You'll work closely with developers, tech leads and product owners in an AI-forward engineering organization, following a validated SDLC for regulated product releases.
Key Responsibilities
Test Automation and Quality Gates
• Design and implement a risk-based test strategy and test cases for services and mobile features.
• Build and maintain automated API, UI, integration and regression tests using Playwright and similar tools.
• Run performance and load testing with k6.
• Integrate automation frameworks with CI/CD pipelines as quality gates.
• Perform contract and integration testing across microservices.
• Automate mobile testing and ensure device coverage on iOS and Android (e.g., Appium).
Defect Management and Release Evidence
• Triage defects and support root-cause analysis with developers.
• Maintain traceability and produce clear test and release evidence suitable for regulatory review.
• Proactively flag blockers, risks and quality concerns.
Team Collaboration
• Take part in all scrum ceremonies (planning, daily stand-up, refinement, review/showcase and retrospective) in two-week sprints.
• Demo completed work to product owners and stakeholders in sprint showcases.
• Use approved AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) for test generation, code review and documentation.
Required Experience and Technical Skills
• Senior-level experience in quality automation for production SaaS products.
• Proficiency in TypeScript, C# or another programming language.
• Hands-on experience with Playwright (UI/end-to-end) and k6 (performance and load).
• Experience with mobile test automation on iOS and Android (Appium or similar).
• Experience with API, UI, integration, regression and exploratory testing.
• Experience integrating test automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub or similar).
• Familiarity with contract and integration testing in microservices environments.
• Advanced English, with clear written and verbal communication with distributed US teams.
• Availability to work with overlap with US Eastern Time, covering all sprint ceremonies.
Core Competencies
• A structured, risk-based approach to testing and problem solving.
• Proactive ownership of quality, with early escalation of risks and blockers.
• Ability to work within established architecture, coding and quality standards.
• Comfort working in agile environments and presenting work to stakeholders.
Nice to Have
• Experience supporting validated or regulated software (GxP, data integrity, ALCOA+, audit trails, change control).
• Life sciences or quality-management SaaS experience.
• Experience with Azure DevOps and SonarCloud.
• Experience with AI-assisted testing workflows.

title: Working Foreman
description:
The Working Foreman must maintain the technical knowledge and mechanical ability necessary to support a heavy-duty truck dealership service operation.

Responsibilities include:

  • Perform mechanical, electrical, and diagnostic repairs as shop needs require.
  • Assist technicians with difficult or time-consuming diagnostic problems.
  • Provide technical guidance on Peterbilt trucks, PACCAR engines, Cummins engines, and other supported products.
  • Assist with troubleshooting engine performance, electrical systems, transmissions, drivetrains, brakes, suspension, steering, HVAC, and aftertreatment systems.
  • Assist technicians with the use of OEM diagnostic software, service information, wiring diagrams, and technical resources.
  • Help identify the root cause of recurring problems and prevent unnecessary parts replacement or repeat repairs.
  • Provide guidance on manufacturer repair procedures and technical service bulletins.
  • Assist with warranty-related repairs and documentation requirements.
  • Review difficult repairs before additional labor or parts are committed when appropriate.
  • Share technical knowledge with technicians to improve their skills and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Encourage technicians to follow proper diagnostic procedures instead of relying on guesswork or unnecessary parts replacement.

The Working Foreman should be available to assist technicians when technical challenges arise but should avoid taking over every difficult repair. The goal is to develop technician capabilities while maintaining shop productivity.

title: Product Owner
description:
Binnen ons Productontwikkelingsteam zijn we op zoek naar een Product Owner om zich aan te sluiten bij bestaande ontwikkelingsteams. Lely is wereldleider in automatisering voor de melkveehouderij; onze productontwikkelingsteams zorgen ervoor dat nieuwe producten voldoen aan onze hoge kwaliteitsnormen. Deze agrarische innovaties omvatten nieuwe producten voor nieuwe markten, evenals updates en ondersteuning.

Bij het proces van het brengen van de producten naar onze eindgebruikers hebben de ontwikkelingsteams te maken met veel invloeden. Het team wordt gevoed met informatie van testers, veldinstallaties, data-analisten, engineers, servicetechnici en het ontwikkelingsprogramma van het project. Het behouden van tevredenheid en afstemming onder al deze belanghebbenden is jouw belangrijkste doel.

Jouw rol en positie

Als Product Owner Product Development werk je in een softwareontwikkelingsteam. Jouw belangrijkste belanghebbenden zijn Technische Serviceondersteuning, veldtechnici, interne productontwikkelingsteams, de projectmanager, de productmanager, de eindgebruiker en teamleden van andere disciplines in het project. Met de belanghebbenden identificeer je de behoeften van het veld voor de specifieke producten. Je definieert de Product Backlog, organiseert het werk en bepaalt de beste manier om waarde aan het veld toe te voegen. Als Product Owner heb je een toegewijd team van Productontwikkelaars die met je samenwerken.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een Product Owner die weet hoe hij/zij zich moet profileren binnen een hybride wereld van projecten gecombineerd met agile werkwijzen. Alle belanghebbenden worden meegenomen en zijn even belangrijk bij het realiseren van de roadmap. Je bent een zelfstarter.

We lezen ook graag meer over je motivatie in je motivatiebrief.

Bovendien zoeken we iemand die zich kan identificeren met de volgende vaardigheden en competenties:

  • Drie jaar ervaring als Scrum Product Owner.
  • Een empirische en ondernemende mentaliteit met klantgerichtheid.
  • Een focus op het valideren en afronden van taken en het beheren van je Product Backlog dienovereenkomstig.
  • Leiderschap en eigenaarschap zijn jouw key competences.
  • Uitstekende plannings- en organisatievaardigheden: je weet hoe je prioriteiten moet stellen en overtuigen.
  • Je bent sociaal vaardig: je legt verbindingen, luistert en stemt af.
  • Je kunt 'nee' zeggen en keuzes maken.
  • Je bent een woordvoerder voor het team en beheert je interne en externe belanghebbenden nauwlettend.
  • Je creëert en deelt de Productvisie met het team.
  • Relocation is helaas niet mogelijk voor deze functie.

Pre:

  • Ervaring of affinititeit met robotics en embedded software.
  • Affiniteit met de agrarische sector.

Werken bij Lely betekent bijdragen aan duurzame vooruitgang binnen een van de meest innovatieve organisaties van Nederland. Jij draagt bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van de agrarische sector, en wij zorgen dat jij daar alle ruimte, middelen en ondersteuning voor krijgt.

  • Een internationale werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ondernemerschap.
  • Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder tot 8 weken vakantie per jaar en een goede pensioenregeling.
  • Een salaris binnen de schaal van € 5.015 - € 7.163 bruto per maand waarin we graag zien dat er vanaf je startsalaris nog groeiruimte is richting de toekomst.

title: IT Employee Engagement and BI Specialist
description:
JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Join us as the person who gets people set up to succeed, and who turns data into decisions. In this role you’ll be the friendly, reliable point of contact for colleagues navigating technology onboarding, equipment and training requirements, so they can hit the ground running on client and JLL systems. You’ll also work with our Account Management team, building the Power BI dashboards and automated reporting that show how accounts are performing. If you enjoy working with people and data in equal measure, this role offers both.


What You’ll Do


  • Act as the go-to contact for new and existing colleagues on technology setup, equipment logistics and training requirements.
  • Support technology onboarding for new joiners, working with the relevant teams so they’re ready to work on client and JLL systems from day one.
  • Manage day-to-day badge access and network setup for client systems, working with client IT to make sure credentials and connectivity are in place.
  • Run the rollout and return of client-issued laptops, including tracking assignments, coordinating logistics and keeping documentation accurate across the equipment lifecycle.
  • Follow up with new and existing colleagues to confirm required training is complete, maintain accurate records and escalate gaps to protect compliance.
  • Gather reporting requirements from Account Management stakeholders and turn them into clear analytics deliverables.
  • Cleanse and transform data using SQL, Python and other reporting languages, then build and maintain Power BI dashboards that track account performance metrics and client deliverables.
  • Use Databricks to automate recurring data processes and reporting workflows, improving efficiency and consistency across the team’s analytics output.


What We’re Looking For


  • A bachelor’s degree in information technology, data analytics or a related field.
  • A background in onboarding coordination, IT or systems access administration, or operations support. Familiarity with badge and access management systems and basic network setup is a plus.
  • Strong organisational skills and the discipline to keep equipment tracking and training follow-ups on course.
  • Hands-on skills in Power BI and Databricks, including writing queries, structuring data models and automating recurring reporting.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and Python, plus experience cleansing and transforming large or disparate datasets.
  • The ability to turn raw data into insights that support operational decisions, spot trends and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • An understanding of data governance principles and a careful, accurate approach to data and records.
  • Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset, with confidence following up with colleagues at all levels and working alongside client IT teams. Exposure to corporate real estate, facilities or workplace services, or to client-facing account management, is an advantage.

What we offer:

Competitive Rewards & Benefits Permanent contract after probationary period, private healthcare, cafeteria system, life insurance, and employee assistance program

Flexible Work Environment Hybrid model in premium Warsaw Spire workspace with state-of-the-art facilities and metro access.

Career Development & Growth Robust development opportunities with 80% employee participation in structured programs, AI upskilling, and professional training.

Stability & Recognition 78% employee recommendation rate, recognized for 18 consecutive years as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies.

Inclusive & Supportive Culture Strong commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion across multiple employee resource groups and initiatives.

Global Perspective 60 nationalities and 40 languages represented, offering rich cultural exchange and collaboration opportunities.

Location:

Remote –Gdynia, POL

description:
Inspire. Support. Lead. Make a Difference.

At the Boys & Girls Clubs of the Fox Valley, our mission is simple and powerful: to inspire and enable all young people - especially those with unmet needs - to reach their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring community members.

Everything we do is rooted in our values: Kids First, Caring Adults, Safe & Healthy Environments, Responsible Stewardship, and Opportunity for All.

We’re youth-centered, collaborative, and committed to leadership that strengthens our community. Every day, our team works to ensure young people experience supportive relationships, safety, recognition, opportunity, fun, and belonging.

If you’re energized by purpose-driven work and want to help build an organization where every kid can thrive - this is where you belong.


About the Role

As our Volunteer Coordinator, you’ll recruit, onboard and support the volunteers who make our programs possible, while also supporting the volunteer experience during corporate volunteer days and special events like our annual Turkey Trot. You’ll build lasting relationships with volunteers and partner across our organization to make sure the right people are in the right roles, doing meaningful work that supports our mission.


In this role, you will:

  • Recruit and welcome new volunteers, matching their skills and interests to where we need them most.
  • Lead orientation and training so volunteers feel prepared and confident.
  • Serve as an ongoing, trusted point of contact for our volunteer community
  • Coordinate the volunteer experience for corporate volunteer days and special events.
  • Recognize and celebrate our volunteers throughout the year.
  • Maintain accurate volunteer records and reporting.

This job posting reflects the primary responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be all-inclusive.

title: Strategic Project Lead - Physical Engineering
description:
About the Role

Appen’s Strategic Project Leads turn complex technical requirements into high-quality data and evaluation resources that help advance AI models.

As the Strategic Project Lead for Physical Engineering, you will bring deep engineering knowledge to projects involving the physical world and built environment. You will help translate real-world engineering work into structured tasks, expert-reviewed data and evaluations that support AI training and model assessment.

You will bring depth in at least one physical engineering discipline, such as mechanical, electrical, civil or structural engineering, while working with specialists across other areas as needed. You will partner with customers, Applied Researchers, Operations and technical experts to shape project requirements, establish quality standards and deliver technically credible results.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead through subject matter expertise and influence, rather than direct people management.

Your Impact

  • Translate customer requirements into realistic engineering tasks, data specifications and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Assess technical requirements, review source files and develop representative samples to establish project feasibility.
  • Shape the physical engineering domain strategy across areas such as CAD, BIM, CAE and electrical engineering.
  • Develop multi-step engineering tasks and reference solutions that reflect real-world technical challenges across models, drawings, calculations and specifications.
  • Lead pilots from sample development and expert onboarding through quality assurance and customer acceptance.
  • Partner with Operations to transition projects into production, maintaining technical standards and ownership of domain quality as delivery scales.
  • Build and qualify a network of specialist engineering contributors and reviewers.
  • Work with Applied Researchers and tooling teams to develop technical verification methods and improve the consistency of engineering evaluations.
  • Provide effort estimates and identify specialist requirements, tooling needs and delivery risks to support commercial proposals.
  • Turn successful projects into reusable engineering samples, task libraries and delivery methods.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in at least one physical engineering discipline, with a background in applied engineering work and technical problem-solving.
  • Practical experience with engineering tools and CAE workflows, including interpreting analyses and validating assumptions, constraints and results.
  • Experience working with technical artefacts such as CAD or BIM models, engineering drawings, schematics, calculations, simulations or specifications.
  • Experience leading technical projects from initial scoping and estimation through execution and delivery, with direct involvement in the technical work.
  • Ability to evaluate engineering outputs, identify technical inaccuracies and establish quality standards and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience assessing or guiding technical specialists, with the judgement to recognise when additional expertise is required.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex requirements into clear instructions and lead cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Master's or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience developing engineering data, technical tasks or evaluation resources for AI training, model evaluation or benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with CAD/BIM interoperability, open engineering formats or structured validation of engineering models and documentation.
  • Experience building specialist contributor networks or leading distributed technical delivery with external engineering experts.

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.

About Appen

Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.
